title: Sr. Platform Engineer-PH
description:
About the Role



Pandoblox delivers enterprise-quality data platforms to mid-market companies in weeks, not months — a lean team amplified by AI. We're hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to own the infrastructure the entire client-delivery pipeline runs on, and to evolve it so a small team can stand up and operate many concurrent, fully-isolated client environments without scaling headcount.





This is a senior IC role: ~70% hands-on platform/infra/DevOps, 20% architecture & security, 10% reliability. You live in Terraform, GCP IAM, CI/CD, and Cloud Run. The mandate isn't infrastructure for its own sake — it's infrastructure that gets client outcomes shipped faster, safer, and more repeatably.



This role goes deep on infrastructure, not up into the app layer. If you'd rather be shipping product features and UI, this is the wrong seat.



Responsibilities:



In this role you'll get to...



- execute and own the following:

   - IaC (signal-iac)— the Terraform/OpenTofu estate; provision a new client with a one-line flag flip. Every change is a PR with a plan diff; prod applies only through a gated workflow. Build the paved road so the delivery team onboards a client through a safe, gated path, not a ticket to you.

   - GCP multi-tenancy— a two-tier project model with one isolated project per client; physical, per-project isolation enforced by IAM.

   - Runtime isolation at scale— the shared services (signal-agents,signal-mcp, Supabase) serve every client at once, so one client's load can never degrade another: per-tenant quotas, fairness, noisy-neighbor protection.

   - Identity & secrets— the keyless model (Workload Identity Federation, impersonated service accounts). No long-lived keys, no secrets in Git, no path from laptop to prod.

   - CI/CD— GitHub Actions: build-once-promote, OIDC/keyless auth, trunk-based with environment promotion.

   - Observability & cost— SLOs, freshness/failure alerting, evidence-first i
 response, and per-client cost attribution so margin stays visible as clients stack up.

- collaborate with the project team 

- perform other duties or responsibilities  needed by the role



Requirements:



On day one, we'll expect you to...



- have 8+ years of platform / infra / DevOps / SRE, owning cloud architecture end-to-end

- have 3-4 years of experience in Terraform / OpenTofu — production modules, multi-env, gated apply

- have 3-4 years of GCP experience — IAM & SA design, WIF, Cloud Run, networking, Secret Manager, BigQuery admin

- have 3-4 yars of CI/CD experience — GitHub Actions (or equivalent), OIDC/keyless, build-once-promote, trunk-based

- have 3-4 years of experience in security & identity judgment — keyless, least-privilege, gated-prod posture you own

- have 3-4 years of experience in multi-tenant isolation at both the data and runtime tiers

- provide proactive observability & i
 response — alerting, SLOs, evidence-first debugging, on-call coverage

- have 3-4 years of experience in per-client cost attribution / FinOps instincts

- have worked with AWS alongside GCP (QuickSight reporting path, Secrets Manager) for 3-4 years

- possess a delivery-first mindset: infra right-sized to delivery outcomes, not over-engineered

- have excellent written and verbal English communication skills

- have a fully functional and up-to-date computer with which to perform duties

- be willing to install next generation end point protection on the computer

- be a current resident of the Philippines and can perform work from there

- be willing to work within US Pacific timezone (8am - 5pm PST, 12AM - 9AM Manila time) or during client hours as required

- be willing to undergo a 90-days probationary period upon initial hire



Required Stack: Terraform/OpenTofu, GCP (Cloud Run, BigQuery, IAM, WIF, Secret Manager), GitHub Actions, Supabase, Vercel,  AWS (Quick, Secrets Manager), Claude (Anthropic API), and modern, opinionated, no legacy click-ops.



These are preferred experiences:



Multi-client/consulting delivery pipelines

- Supabase/Vercel ops 

- Cloud Run cold-start & scaling tuning 

- AI-agent / LLM runtime infra (MCP, model APIs) 

- AI-augmented engineering workflows



This is a remote, work from home job.



TO APPLY: ** DO NOT SEND YOUR APPLICATION HERE IN INDEED** Follow the instructions below:



1. COPY & PASTE this link to your browser: 

2. Fill out the form and submit your resume to our system.



We will reach out to you via
 using our system!

Thank you!

title: REMOTE SALES CALLER / APPOINTMENT SETTER   Part-Time to Full-Time | Long-Term Position | Night Shift (US Hours)
description:
Part-Time → Full-Time | Long-Term Position



We're StayBooked, a US web design agency that builds websites for local businesses like med spas, dentists, plumbers, tattoo shops, HVAC companies, and more.



This is still cold calling. What is different is the list.



We put a lot of work into every lead before it ever gets to you. For most businesses we have already built a finished demo website — their name, services, reviews, and booking. You will not get a spreadsheet with a name and a phone number and a “figure it out.”



Inside GoHighLevel you get the brief: website, services, reviews, location, contact info, demo status, and the other data we collect so you know who you are calling and why they might be a fit.



The better you understand the prospect, the better the conversation. Our job is the information and the tools. Your job is to turn that into conversations, appointments, and sales.



Our system also flags when an owner opens their demo. First hour is for those people. You will often be calling someone who looked at the site we built them 20 minutes ago. The rest of the shift is still the job: voi
, follow-up, and getting the next link opened.



We're looking for one person we intend to keep long-term.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



1. Call demo viewers first



Most days you start with a same-day viewer list. Some days that is a handful of owners. Some days it is closer to 20. Call them within the hour, walk them through the site, handle objections, and either close the deal or book them onto our calendar.



2. Call businesses that haven't opened their demo



We have 15,000+ completed demos waiting to be opened. Your goal is simple: get them to open the site while you're on the phone.



3. Call businesses with no website



Confirm they don't have a website, get their best contact information, and we'll build their free demo.



4. Follow up



Most deals don't close on the first call. A text within 60 seconds of every hang-up, then a cadence in GoHighLevel. Most deals that close do it on touch 3–8.



5. Keep the CRM updated



Everything gets logged in GoHighLevel. If it's not in the CRM, it didn't happen.



EXPECTATIONS



4 hours/day, Monday–Friday.



Approximately 100 dials/day.



Initial targets:



• 1–2 booked appointments/day

• 3–5 appointments/week that actually show

• Close qualified prospects yourself whenever possible



Shows are more important than dials.



WHO WE WANT



• 1+ year cold calling US businesses

• Appointment setting or closing experience

• Excellent spoken English

• Hands-on GoHighLevel experience

• Comfortable talking to business owners

• Comfortable asking for the sale

• Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and good headset



Hours: 9 AM–1 PM US Pacific Time

Approximately 12 AM–4 AM Philippines time (1 AM–5 AM).



This is a night shift, so only apply if you're comfortable doing it long-term.



PAY



30-Day Paid Trial



$450/month base + $50 per closed deal



After Trial



$800/month base + $50 per closed deal + 5% recurring commission



You earn 5% of the monthly payments from clients you personally close, for as long as they remain active.



A 299/month client is about **15/month** to you, every month they stay. A book of 50 clients on that plan is about $750/month on top of base and the $50 closes.



Long-term performers get raises and more responsibility.



HOW TO APPLY



Applications missing any of the four items below will not be reviewed.



1. Start your application with: SUNSET



2. Record a 1–2 minute voice memo.



Pretend you're calling Maria, who owns a med spa in San Diego. We built her a free demo website and she opened it 20 minutes ago.



Call her. Explain why you're calling. She will say she did not ask you to build this. Handle that, sell her on what she's looking at, and ask for the booking.



Don't just read a script. We want to hear how you actually sound on the phone.



Loom, Vocaroo, Google Drive, etc. are all fine.



3. Tell us in 2–3 sentences what you've done inside GoHighLevel or another CRM. Name the screens. Do not write “I am a fast learner.”



4. Your best week of numbers: dials, connects, appointments set, and closes (or say “no closes, only sets”). One week. Real numbers.



We're not looking for 100 people.



We're looking for one great salesperson.

title: Be One of the First Senior Editors on a Fast-Growing 7-Figure Pet Brand
description:
How many hours have you poured into the *perfect* ad… only to get paid the same whether it printed money or flopped? You grind, you nail the edit, the ad scales to five figures, and your paycheck doesn't move. That's broken. That's not how we run things here.



Here, your work is tied to your reward. We built an **uncapped bonus structure** so editors get paid like the converters they are. The bonuses *stack*, one winning ad pays you at every tier it hits on the way up, and there's no limit to how many winners you can run. Stack winners, stack income. **Our top editors take home $5,000+ a month.**



And you won't do it alone. We're a tight-knit team that grows together; we share what's working, coach each other, and run the feedback loop as a unit. Come in early as one of our first senior editors and put your name on the foundation of something big.



**We're an 7-figure DTC pet brand on a mission to become the biggest player in the space.**



**Who We're Looking For**



We don't just want a video editor.



We want someone obsessed with their work, who won't settle for average, and who wants to keep improving.



Someone who lives and breathes AI, video editing, and direct response.



Someone who can think like a converter, not just an editor.



If you treat this as a basic 9–5, please click off now. This isn't for you.



**Our Values & Ideology**



**Take accountability.** Ad flopped? We want someone who thinks: *"I probably missed something. Let me run a feedback loop and figure out why."*



**Obsession over everything.** We're a mission-driven company. We want someone who matches that energy.



**Communicate, communicate, communicate.** We want someone constantly giving feedback, debating, standing their ground, and speaking up when they see a better way to do something.



**Self-starter mentality.** You should be able to work independently without needing constant supervision.



**Requirements**



- Worked with 7, 8, or 9-figure supplement brands before

- Strong AI video editing experience

- AI geek with hands-on experience in: Veo, Seedance, Kling, Higgsfield, HeyGen, ElevenLabs,

- Strong communication skills

- Self-starter mentality

- Takes accountability and improves from feedback

- Shares the values listed above



**How to Apply**



To apply, send us all three of the following:



1. A link to a personalized 1-minute Loom introducing yourself, your experience, and what you excel in.

2. A link to your portfolio.

3. The brands you've worked with.



**Screening Questions**



Please also answer these in your application:



- Do you have experience using Higgsfield? If yes, explain what you used it for.

- Share one example of an AI avatar ad you have made.

- What tools did you use to make the AI avatar ad?



?? No Loom = automatic rejection.

?? Not personalized = automatic rejection.

?? Missing portfolio or answer = automatic rejection.

?? Missing screening questions = automatic rejection.



**Compensation**



- Base monthly salary: $1,000/month

- **Uncapped performance bonuses** — top editors earn $5,000+/month ( total )

title: Hiring Senior ECommerce Video Editor ( Extra Performance Bonuses!!)
description:
About Us



We are a DTC eCommerce brand. We run paid social at a serious scale, and our creative is what separates us from everyone else in our space.



We are looking for a creative operator who understands *why* ads work, cares about performance, and takes real pride in the quality of their craft.



If you are the kind of editor who obsesses over the first three seconds, rewatches your own work to find what is not landing, this position is for you.



What This Role Looks Like



This is a **full-time, long-term position**. We do not hire editors to cycle through. We hire people we want to grow with, and we protect our best people.



**Hours:** 8 hours per day, Monday through Friday

**Output expectation:**

- 1 video per day if the project is a long-form VSL (up to 5 minutes)

- 3 videos per day for short-form ads



You will produce
 ad creative across multiple formats. You will have a clear brief, organized assets, and a team behind you. What we need from you is execution at the highest level.



What You Will Create



- Direct-response video ads built to drive purchases

- UGC-style ads that feel authentic, not produced

- AI spokesperson and presenter videos that look and sound human

- AI-generated B-roll that supports the script without looking artificial

- Motion-graphics ads with clean visual hierarchy

- Hook variations and creative iterations

- Testimonial, review-style, and listicle ads

- Product demonstrations and comparison ads



 What We Need From You



Direct-Response Editing

You understand what makes someone stop scrolling and what makes them buy. You can turn a script and a brief into a complete, conversion-focused ad. You know how to build a hook, carry tension through the video, and close with a call to action that actually converts.



UGC Editing

You can take raw creator footage and make it feel effortless. You know when to cut, when to leave imperfections in, and how to improve weak delivery without making the creator sound edited.



AI Video Production

You can use AI tools to generate or enhance spokesperson footage, voice-overs, and B-roll. You know how to catch the glitches, correct unnatural pacing, and produce an end result that does not feel artificial.



Motion Graphics and Sound Design

You can animate text, benefits, reviews, and offers in ways that aid clarity. You understand audio balancing, music selection, and how sound design affects retention.



Organization and Communication

You manage your own workload. You know what is due and when. You communicate blockers before they become problems. You submit clean, organized project files every time.



  Required Experience



- Professional video editing experience (senior level)

- Direct experience creating
 ad creative for 
 
 brands

- Experience editing UGC advertisements

- Experience producing or enhancing AI video content

- Strong motion-graphics skills (not just templates)

- Proficiency in at least one professional editing suite:

  - Adobe Premiere Pro

  - Adobe After Effects

  - DaVinci Resolve

  - Final Cut Pro

  - Capcut



**Preferred tools and platforms:** ( ALL TOOLS PROVIDED )

Kling, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Gemini, ChatGPT, Google Drive, Slack, Meta Ad Library



    Compensation



Base: $1,500–$2,000 USD per month depending on experience, speed, quality, and communication



Performance Bonus: 0.5% of ad spend on your top 5 performing ads each month, paid after the month closes



Our top editors earn **$5,000–$7,000 per month** when base and performance bonuses are combined. That ceiling is real. We have editors hitting it.



How to Apply



**Applications are accepted by
 only.**



Send your complete application to: **[jessicahiringmanager1
.com]**



Use the subject line: **Senior Video Editor Application – Your Full Name**



Everything must be in one
. Applications missing any component below will not be reviewed. Generic, copy-paste, or fully AI-written applications that do not address your specific experience will not be considered.



---



## Application Questions



Answer every question directly in the body of your
.



**1. Experience**

How many years of professional video editing experience do you have? How much of that has been direct-response or DTC eCommerce work specifically?



**2. Output and Workload**

How many video ads did you edit in the last 90 days? How many brands or clients were you managing at the same time?



**3. Tools**

List every editing, motion-graphics, AI-video, voice-generation, and image-generation tool you actively use. Which one are you strongest in and why?



**4. AI Video**

Walk us through your process for producing an AI spokesperson video. How do you make the voice, face, and B-roll look and sound natural? What do you check before you submit?



**5. Performance and Judgment**

Tell us about a specific ad you edited that performed well or failed. What happened? What do you think caused the result? What did you take away from it?



**6. Handling a Weak Brief**

What do you do when the brief you receive is incomplete or the assets provided are not strong enough to build a good ad? Walk us through exactly what you do.



**7. Communication**

Rate your written and spoken English from 1–10 and explain your rating honestly. Are you comfortable communicating via Slack, video calls, and Loom?



**8. Availability**

What country and time zone are you in? Can you work 9-5 EST? When can you start, and do you have any current commitments we should know about?



**9. Compensation and Long-Term Fit**

What base monthly rate are you seeking?  What would you need to see from us to stay for two or more years?  Why do you want to work here specifically?



10- Commitment

Do you have any other commitments that you would need to address first? Be honest



---

title: YouTube/Tiktok Video Editor - Long & Short Form
description:
Hello! We're looking for a professional and experienced video editor to join our team to handle partial to full video creation process, producing high-quality YouTube content/videos in length of around 15-30 minutes, 5 - 10 videos produced per month, depending on the cost per video, with potential for more.



*Please read this carefully before applying for this job.*



The ideal candidate/team will have worked on couples and DIY YouTube channels before with measurable success, have extensive knowledge of YouTube and Tiktok guidelines/copyright rules/fair use policies, strong editing skills, and access to Canva. Videos must be able to be monetized.



We Want to Work With You If:

- You have experience in producing bingeable content with YouTube.

- You have experience with couples and DIY YouTube and Tiktok channels.

- You understand how to keep viewers engaged with good pacing, transitions etc.

- You have experience working under tight deadlines

- You are committed to high quality without the need for lots of revisions.

- You are organized, communicative and has fast turnaround times.

- You can deliver items via Google Drive

- You have a sense of humor

- You have sufficient cloud storage



Video requirements:

- Video workflow: 10-second bait intro, channel intro, follow IG/TikTok/subscribe pop-ups, and then keep the content in the body edited in a way that is funny, engaging, and entertaining. Ending with channel end screens.

- Add in copyright-free sound effects/background music where applicable, not in excess.

- Source and use copyright-free clips and have stock footage access to use licensed clips.

- Edit the video in a bingeable type style that is captivating to the audience, CTR and retention rate focused, 1080p HD+, make use of lower-thirds/text/transitions where applicable. Professional video editing software only - Final Cut Pro.

title: AI UGC Video Creator for Shopify Products — Full Time, Remote
description:
We are looking for a creative and reliable AI Video Creator with experience producing UGC-style videos for Shopify and e-commerce products.



Your main role will be to create realistic, engaging short-form product videos that look like authentic TikTok, Instagram Reels, and
 
 content using the latest AI video and image-generation tools.



Responsibilities

Create UGC-style product videos for Shopify/e-commerce products

Generate realistic AI actors, creators, product demonstrations, testimonials, reactions, and lifestyle scenes

Create strong video hooks designed to capture attention in the first 1–3 seconds

Turn product images and references into realistic AI videos

Maintain product consistency between generated images and video scenes

Create multiple scenes and variations for the same product

Reverse-engineer successful UGC/product videos and recreate similar concepts without directly copying them

Write and improve prompts for tools such as VEO 3, Sora, Kling, Seedance, Nano Banana, Gemini, and similar AI tools

Extend, enhance, and fix AI-generated footage

Identify and correct common AI problems such as unnatural hands, product changes, strange movements, inconsistent characters, or unrealistic physics

Edit final videos in CapCut or similar software

Add voice-overs, captions, sound effects, transitions, and appropriate pacing when required

Follow creative briefs, reference videos, scripts, and structured workflows

Produce multiple high-quality videos consistently every day

Requirements

Previous experience creating AI-generated videos

Experience creating UGC, e-commerce, dropshipping, Shopify, or product advertising videos

Strong understanding of TikTok/Reels-style content and short-form video hooks

Experience with AI video tools such as VEO 3, Kling, Sora, Seedance, Runway, or similar

Experience with AI image tools such as Nano Banana, Gemini, Midjourney, or similar

Good CapCut or general video-editing skills

Ability to create realistic-looking AI humans and product interactions

Strong understanding of camera angles, movement, lighting, timing, reactions, and storytelling

Ability to maintain character and product consistency across multiple scenes

Strong attention to detail and ability to notice AI artifacts

Very good written and spoken English

Reliable internet connection and availability for daily work

Ideal Candidate



You are a strong fit if you:



Already understand how successful Shopify product ads and organic UGC videos are structured

Know the difference between a video that simply looks good and a video that can actually sell a product

Can analyze a reference video and reproduce its pacing, camera movements, hooks, emotions, and structure using AI

Can experiment with different hooks, actors, environments, angles, and concepts

Understand concepts such as problem → solution, product demonstration, testimonial, reaction, before/after, curiosity hooks, and visual hooks

Learn new AI tools quickly

Can work independently without needing constant supervision

Are interested in a long-term position and improving your AI video-generation skills

Work Schedule

Full-time remote

8 hours per day

Monday to Saturday

Long-term opportunity

Salary



$400 USD per month



Salary may increase based on performance, reliability, creativity, and ability to consistently produce high-quality videos.



How to Apply



Please send:



A short introduction about yourself

Your experience with AI video generation

Which AI tools you currently use

Examples of UGC, Shopify, e-commerce, or product videos you have created

Your experience with CapCut or other editing software

Your current availability



Important: Please do not apply if you have never created AI-generated product or UGC-style videos. We are specifically looking for someone with hands-on experience.

description:

• **Social Media Strategy & Content Planning** – Research content ideas and trends within my niche, help develop strategies for growing my personal brand, and create an organized content plan/calendar.



• **Analytics & Strategy Review** – Review social media performance and provide insights on what is working, what can be improved, and recommendations for future content.



• **Short-Form Video Editing** – Edit content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and other short-form platforms, including captions, text overlays, transitions, and appropriate audio.



• **Graphic Creation** – Create clean, professional, on-brand graphics, carousels, stories, and other social media content.



This will initially be a **part-time trial position** so we can evaluate our workflow, communication, content quality, and overall results. With proven performance and positive growth projections, there will be opportunities to expand the role. **Performance-based bonuses will also be offered for achieving agreed-upon growth and performance goals.**



I’m looking for someone who is creative, organized, proactive, and comfortable contributing ideas rather than simply completing assigned tasks. Ideally, I would like to develop an ongoing working relationship with someone who can become familiar with my brand and help shape the social media strategy over time.



If this sounds aligned with your experience, I’d love to learn more about your approach to social media management, the platforms and tools you typically use, and your availability.



If possible, please also send a portfolio or examples of social media accounts, short-form videos, or graphics you have worked on.

HOW TO APPLY



Send your application to 
 with the subject line "Legal Assistant Application — [Your Name]" and include:



1. Resume highlighting your legal background and CALIFORNIA law firm experience

2. Cover letter describing your relevant paralegal experience as it relates to this role

3. Expected hourly rate or salary range

4. Available start date



About Bay Legal, PC



Bay Legal, PC is a full-service California law firm combining expert legal counsel with modern technology to deliver seamless, results-driven representation.



Position Overview



We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Paralegal with a strong legal background and direct experience in a California law firm. The ideal candidate holds a law degree, is a currently practicing attorney, or brings extensive hands-on paralegal experience in a legal setting.



Our Practice Areas You'll Be Supporting



- Estate Planning (Wills, Trusts, Asset Protection, Power of Attorney)

- California Probate & Estate Administration

- Real Estate Law & Real Estate Disputes

- Construction Law

- Landlord-Tenant Law

- Business Formation & California Business Law

- Contract Law

- Immigration



Required Qualifications



- Law degree (JD or foreign law degree) OR currently practicing attorney OR minimum 4 years of substantive paralegal -experience in a California law firm — required

- Paralegal certificate from an ABA-approved program preferred

- Minimum 4 years of paralegal experience within a California law firm

- Hands-on experience with Lawmatics and Clio Manage

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple cases and deadlines simultaneously

- Reliable internet connection and home office setup for remote work



Key Responsibilities



- Prepare and organize formation and corporate documents (articles, bylaws, operating agreements, resolutions, governance consents) under applicable California requirements.

- Draft first-pass legal documents (bylaws, resolutions, agreements, contracts) from firm templates for attorney review and revision.

- Compile and organize supporting materials for matters (comparables, cost documentation, disclosure exhibits, regulatory filings) as requested by attorneys.

- Track and organize compliance materials, regulatory filings, ownership records, and deadline alerts relevant to client entities.

- Conduct factual research on entity status, licensing records, regulatory filings, and public records, subject to attorney review.

- Conduct client intake interviews and gather case information under attorney supervision.

- Communicate professionally with clients, courts, opposing counsel, and regulatory agencies.

- Manage and update case files, deadlines, and client records in practice-management systems (Lawmatics, Clio Manage, etc.).

- File documents with California courts and regulatory agencies, including e-filing systems, and coordinate execution, notarization, and e-signatures on legal documents.

- Draft, review, and proofread legal documents and correspondence; ensure accurate documentation of all case activities and maintain contemporaneous time records.

title: Real Estate Operations Manager
description:
# Real Estate Operations Manager | $4–$7/hr + Performance Incentives



We are a growing U.S. real estate company looking for a highly organized, experienced **Real Estate Operations Manager** to help oversee the day-to-day operations of our sales, lead generation, transaction, and administrative systems.



This is **not a basic administrative or virtual assistant position.**



We are looking for someone who understands how a real estate operation works, is comfortable managing people, numbers, systems, and processes, and can become the person management relies on to know **what is happening, what needs attention, and what needs to happen next.**



You will work across multiple parts of the business, including:



* Seller lead management

* ISA operations

* CRM organization

* Dialer campaigns

* SMS marketing

* Property underwriting

* MLS research

* Payroll tracking

* Transaction coordination

* Team accountability

* Reporting

* Process improvement



The ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership, solves problems proactively, and does not need to be reminded about every task.



## Compensation



**$4.00–$7.00/hour**, depending on experience, skill level, real estate knowledge, and familiarity with our systems.



There may also be opportunities for:



* Performance bonuses

* Commissions

* Increased compensation based on results

* Expanded responsibilities as the company grows



Candidates with strong experience in several of the following may qualify toward the higher end of the range:



* ReadyMode

* Smarter Contact

* Follow Up Boss

* Dotloop

* MLS

* Real estate underwriting

* Comparable sales analysis

* ISA management

* Real estate operations

* Wholesaling or investment real estate



Compensation and responsibilities may grow based on demonstrated performance and ownership of the role.



# Core Responsibilities



## Property Underwriting & Deal Review



You will help management and acquisitions quickly understand whether seller opportunities are worth pursuing.



Responsibilities may include:



* Reviewing incoming seller leads and property opportunities

* Researching property values and comparable sales

* Pulling and analyzing MLS comps

* Reviewing property history and prior sales

* Evaluating active, pending, and sold listings

* Assisting with ARV calculations

* Reviewing estimated repair information

* Helping determine potential offer ranges

* Reviewing equity and deal viability

* Organizing seller and property information for acquisitions

* Prioritizing opportunities based on motivation, equity, property condition, timeline, and potential value



You should be comfortable looking at property data and turning it into useful information for a sales or acquisitions team.



## Lead Management & CRM Operations



You will help ensure our seller leads are properly organized, assigned, worked, and followed up with.



Responsibilities include:



* Managing and organizing leads inside our CRM

* Monitoring lead stages and dispositions

* Ensuring follow-up tasks are being completed

* Identifying neglected or improperly managed leads

* Maintaining organized lead lists

* Creating follow-up categories

* Helping maintain nurture campaigns

* Monitoring lead flow through the sales pipeline

* Ensuring qualified opportunities reach the appropriate team member

* Identifying leads that need additional attention

* Improving lead organization and follow-up processes



A major part of this role is making sure **good opportunities do not fall through the cracks.**



## ReadyMode Management



Experience with **ReadyMode** is strongly preferred.



You may be responsible for:



* Uploading lead lists

* Organizing campaigns

* Creating dialing campaigns

* Managing campaign settings

* Managing lead distribution

* Maintaining dispositions

* Maintaining follow-up lists

* Monitoring ISA activity

* Reviewing campaign performance

* Helping troubleshoot basic dialer or campaign issues

* Ensuring leads are being distributed and worked correctly

* Helping management identify productivity or performance issues



Candidates with experience managing another high-volume outbound dialer may also be considered.



## SMS Marketing & Smarter Contact



You will also help manage our outbound SMS lead generation.



Responsibilities may include:



* Creating SMS campaigns in Smarter Contact

* Uploading and organizing prospect lists

* Segmenting leads correctly

* Writing and scheduling campaigns

* Monitoring replies

* Routing opportunities to the appropriate team member

* Tracking campaign results

* Maintaining clean contact databases

* Creating nurture and follow-up campaigns

* Helping test messaging and campaign strategies

* Preventing duplicate or improperly segmented contacts



Experience with **Smarter Contact** is a major advantage.



## ISA Team Operations



You will help support the day-to-day management of our Inside Sales Agent team.



Responsibilities may include:



* Monitoring attendance

* Monitoring schedules and hours

* Reviewing productivity

* Reviewing call activity

* Tracking KPIs

* Helping coordinate training

* Assisting with onboarding and offboarding

* Maintaining employee and contractor records

* Communicating procedures and expectations

* Helping identify performance issues

* Following up on accountability items

* Assisting management with performance reporting



You should be comfortable holding team members accountable in a professional and respectful way.



This does not mean micromanaging the team.



It means ensuring expectations are clear, numbers are visible, problems are identified early, and commitments are followed through.



## Payroll & Administrative Operations



You may also assist with operational payroll preparation.



Responsibilities may include:



* Tracking employee and contractor hours

* Reviewing time records

* Preparing payroll information

* Maintaining payroll records

* Tracking commissions

* Tracking bonuses

* Identifying inconsistencies before payroll is submitted

* Maintaining accurate internal compensation records



Accuracy and attention to detail are extremely important.



## Dotloop & Transaction Support



You will help ensure our real estate transaction files stay organized from contract through closing.



Responsibilities may include:



* Creating transaction files in Dotloop

* Uploading contracts

* Uploading disclosures

* Organizing amendments and addenda

* Monitoring documents for missing information

* Checking signature completion

* Helping maintain accurate transaction records

* Assisting agents and management with transaction organization

* Tracking important documents and deadlines

* Helping keep files complete and audit-ready



Direct transaction coordination experience is a strong advantage.



## MLS & Property Research



You should be comfortable working with MLS data or be experienced enough in real estate research to learn our process quickly.



Responsibilities may include:



* Pulling comparable properties

* Reviewing sold properties

* Reviewing active and pending listings

* Researching property history

* Reviewing prior listing activity

* Analyzing market activity

* Helping determine pricing ranges

* Assisting with underwriting

* Preparing property information for management, agents, and acquisitions staff



Strong attention to detail is essential when reviewing comparable properties.



## Seller Lead Nurturing



Some seller opportunities require weeks or months of follow-up before they are ready to move forward.



You may help ensure those opportunities stay active.



Responsibilities may include:



* Following up with seller leads

* Checking for changes in motivation

* Checking timeline changes

* Discussing updated pricing expectations

* Maintaining long-term relationships

* Documenting conversations

* Updating CRM information

* Identifying newly motivated sellers

* Returning qualified opportunities to acquisitions or sales



You should be persistent and organized without being unnecessarily aggressive.



# Systems Experience



Experience with several of the following is strongly preferred:



* **ReadyMode**

* **Smarter Contact**

* **Follow Up Boss**

* **Dotloop**

* **MLS**

* Google Workspace

* Google Sheets

* Real estate CRM systems

* SMS marketing platforms

* Lead databases

* Outbound dialers

* Property research tools

* Comparable sales analysis

* Real estate investor systems

* Wholesaling systems

* Transaction management platforms



You do not need experience with every system listed.



However, candidates with direct experience using multiple systems in an actual real estate operation will receive stronger consideration.



# Who We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



* Extremely organized

* Detail-oriented

* Reliable

* Comfortable managing several moving pieces at once

* Able to prioritize effectively

* Comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets

* Strong with technology

* Fast at learning new software

* Experienced with real estate terminology

* Comfortable researching properties

* Comfortable reviewing comparable sales

* Comfortable communicating with team members

* Comfortable holding people accountable

* Able to work independently

* Proactive about identifying problems

* Strong at documenting processes

* Comfortable improving existing systems

* Able to recognize inefficiencies

* Calm when multiple priorities compete for attention

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

* Someone who takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions



We especially value someone who thinks:



**“I saw the problem, figured out what caused it, fixed it, documented it, and made sure it does not keep happening.”**



# Preferred Background



We would especially like to hear from candidates who have previously worked as a:



* Real Estate Operations Manager

* Real Estate Office Manager

* Real Estate Operations Coordinator

* Real Estate Virtual Assistant Manager

* Transaction Coordinator

* Lead Manager

* ISA Manager

* Acquisitions Assistant

* Acquisitions Coordinator

* Real Estate Executive Assistant

* Real Estate Investor Operations Manager

* Wholesaling Operations Manager



Experience working with a:



* Real estate brokerage

* Real estate investment company

* Wholesaling company

* Acquisition team

* High-volume ISA organization

* Seller lead generation company



is highly preferred.



# What Success Looks Like



The successful person in this role becomes the person who can answer:



**Where do our leads stand?**



**Are our campaigns running correctly?**



**Are the ISAs working the right opportunities?**



**Which sellers need immediate attention?**



**What leads are falling behind?**



**What deals need underwriting?**



**Are our payroll numbers correct?**



**Are transaction files complete?**



**Are follow-ups happening?**



**What operational problems need management's attention?**



When this role is working well:



* Leads are organized.

* Campaigns are active.

* ISAs know what they should be doing.

* Follow-up is consistent.

* Seller opportunities are properly nurtured.

* Payroll information is accurate.

* Property numbers are reviewed.

* MLS research is completed correctly.

* Transactions are organized.

* CRM information is current.

* Management has visibility into performance.

* Problems are identified before they become emergencies.



Our goal is for management to be able to focus on higher-level decisions instead of personally chasing every operational detail.



# This Role Is NOT For You If



Please do not apply if:



* You need constant supervision

* You wait to be told about obvious problems

* You regularly forget follow-ups

* You struggle managing multiple systems

* You dislike working with spreadsheets or numbers

* You are uncomfortable learning new technology

* You have no interest in understanding real estate

* You avoid holding team members accountable

* You struggle with detailed administrative work

* You are looking for a simple task-based VA role

* You are uncomfortable taking ownership of results



This position requires someone who can manage both **details and the bigger operational picture.**



# How to Apply



Send your application to:







Use the subject line:



**Application – Real Estate Operations Manager**



Please answer the following questions:



1. Describe your previous real estate experience.



2. Have you previously managed operations for a real estate team, brokerage, investor, or wholesaling company? Please explain.



3. Which of the following systems have you personally used?



   * ReadyMode

   * Smarter Contact

   * Follow Up Boss

   * Dotloop

   * MLS

   * Other real estate CRMs or dialers



4. Describe your experience managing leads and CRM pipelines.



5. Have you managed an ISA or sales team? If yes, how many people and what KPIs did you track?



6. Describe your experience with MLS research and comparable sales.



7. Are you comfortable calculating or reviewing ARV and evaluating investment opportunities?



8. Describe your experience with transaction coordination or Dotloop.



9. Have you handled payroll, time tracking, commissions, or contractor payments?



10. Describe one operational problem you identified and solved without being specifically instructed to fix it.



11. What reports or KPIs have you been responsible for maintaining?



12. How do you make sure important tasks and leads do not fall through the cracks?



13. What is your current availability and preferred working schedule?



Please also include a **short voice or video introduction**.



Tell us briefly:



* Who you are

* Your real estate background

* Your strongest operations skill

* The systems you know best

* Why you believe you would succeed in this role



Applications with **specific examples, measurable results, screenshots, reports, process improvements, or descriptions of systems you personally managed** will receive stronger consideration.



We are looking for someone who wants to **take ownership of the position, become an important part of the team, and grow with the company.**



**Compensation: $4–$7/hour + potential commissions/performance incentives**

title: E-commerce Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist
description:
# E-commerce Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist

**Part-Time | 15–20 Hours/Week | Remote – Philippines | Long-Term**



## About the Role



We are a growing **Australian e-commerce business** looking for a proactive and experienced **E-commerce Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist**.



We already have a VA managing customer service, DMs/comments, order processing and general operations.



Your role is different: **you will own digital marketing and help us grow profitable online sales.**



You will manage paid advertising,
 marketing, social media content, AI-assisted creative production and e-commerce growth.



## Key Responsibilities



### Paid Advertising

- Manage and optimise **Meta Ads 
 & Instagram)**

- Manage/optimise **Google Ads, Shopping & Performance Max**

- Build and optimise retargeting campaigns

- Test audiences, creatives, products and offers

- Monitor ROAS, CAC/CPA, CTR, CPC and conversions

- Identify opportunities to scale profitable campaigns and reduce wasted spend



###
 Marketing & Retention

- Manage **Klaviyo and Shopify
/Messaging**

- Create regular promotional and educational campaigns

- Build and optimise Welcome, Abandoned Cart, Browse Abandonment, Post-Purchase and Win-Back flows

- Segment customers and improve repeat purchases

- Monitor
 revenue, conversions and campaign performance



**Klaviyo experience is highly preferred.**



### Social Media & Content Creation



You will own content planning, creation and publishing across:



**Instagram |
 | TikTok | Pinterest**



Responsibilities include:

- Develop a monthly content calendar

- Create and publish posts, Reels, Stories and short-form videos

- Create/edit product images, videos and UGC-style content

- Write hooks, captions and calls-to-action

- Create testimonial, educational, before/after and promotional content

- Research trends, competitors and content opportunities

- Schedule and consistently publish content

- Analyse content performance and improve the strategy

- Create advertising creatives for paid campaigns



### AI-Assisted Content Creation



We actively use AI to increase marketing quality and productivity.



**Premium AI tools will be provided by the company.**



You should be comfortable using tools such as **ChatGPT, Canva, CapCut and AI image/video generation tools** to:



- Generate content ideas

- Create/edit images and videos

- Produce social media creatives

- Create advertising concepts

- Write and improve marketing copy

- Repurpose existing content

- Work faster while maintaining high quality



We want someone who understands **marketing first and uses AI as a powerful tool to execute it.**



### Shopify Growth & CRO

- Analyse Shopify traffic, sales and customer behaviour

- Identify customer journey and funnel problems

- Improve conversion rate (CVR)

- Improve average order value (AOV)

- Recommend improvements to product and landing pages

- Develop/test promotions, bundles, upsells and cross-sells

- Identify opportunities to convert more existing traffic into customers



### Analytics & Reporting



You should be comfortable working with:



**Shopify Analytics | Meta Ads | Google Ads | GA4 | Klaviyo**



Key metrics include:



**Revenue | ROAS | MER | CAC/CPA | CVR | AOV | CTR | CPC |
 Revenue**



Provide a short weekly report explaining:



**What happened → What worked/didn't → What you changed → What we should do next**



We want insights and actions, not just screenshots and reports.



## Who We're Looking For



You should have hands-on e-commerce experience with several of:



- Shopify

- Meta Ads

- Google Ads

- Klaviyo

- Shopify
/Messaging

- Instagram/Facebook

- TikTok/Pinterest

- Canva/CapCut

- AI content tools

- GA4

- CRO/e-commerce analytics



Experience with **Australian, US, UK or other Western-market e-commerce brands** is an advantage.



You should be:



- Proactive and independent

- Commercially minded

- Data-driven

- Creative

- Comfortable with AI

- Strong in written English

- Reliable and organised

- Focused on results rather than vanity metrics



Most importantly, we want someone who identifies opportunities and says:



**“I found this problem. Here is what I recommend we do, and here is why.”**



## Working Arrangement



**Remote – Philippines**  

**15–20 hours per week**  

**Long-term opportunity**  

**Initial 90-day engagement**



There is potential for increased hours and responsibility as the business grows.



Please include your **expected hourly rate in AUD**.



# IMPORTANT: 3-Minute Video Is Mandatory



**Applications without the video will not be considered.**



Please record a video of **maximum 3 minutes** answering:



1. Briefly introduce yourself and your e-commerce marketing experience.

2. What experience do you have managing Meta and Google Ads?

3. What experience do you have with Klaviyo/email marketing?

4. What social channels have you personally created and published content for?

5. Give one real example where your work increased sales, ROAS or conversion.

6. How are you currently using AI for marketing/content creation?



A Loom, Google Drive, phone or webcam video is fine. Professional video production is not required.



## How to Apply



Start your application with:



**ECOM GROWTH**



Then provide:



- **3-minute video link – mandatory**

- CV/resume

- Portfolio/examples of content and previous work

- Screenshots/results from previous e-commerce or advertising work, where possible

- Expected hourly rate in PHP

- Weekly availability

- Platforms/tools you are strongest with



Finally, answer this in **maximum 3 sentences**:



Generic applications, applications without the required video, or candidates looking only for a social-media posting role will not progress to interview.



We're looking for someone who wants to become a **long-term part of a growing Australian e-commerce business and directly contribute to its growth.**

title: Creative Director - You tube (Davao Based)
description:
YouTube Creative Director — Davao City (Hybrid)



Location: Davao City — Davao-based applicants only

Setup: Hybrid (work-from-home + our Davao City studio)

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM PHT (occasional urgent-turnaround flex)



ABOUT THE ROLE



We're the team behind Shane Hummus, a leading career and finance YouTube channel, and we produce content for established business owners, YouTube entrepreneurs, and business coaches. We're hiring a Creative Director to own the creative engine behind that content.



This is a hands-on role, not management from the sidelines. You'll live in the edit, shape the story, and sit in the room where content decisions get made — working directly with Shane (CEO) and the production team on what gets made and why.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Edit long-form video — talking-head, podcast, and interview content — with strong pacing, hooks, b-roll, captions, and retention-driven structure

- Shape the video content roadmap directly with the CEO and team

- Develop and refine content ideas that serve each channel's brand and business goals

- Own content end to end — ideation, scripting support, editing, publishing — while protecting the creator's voice

- Fold YouTube growth strategy into content planning and optimize output for the algorithm

- Read performance data and adjust — views, retention, engagement, conversions

- Occasional ad hoc creative work, like turning client ideas into clean visual presentations (Miro, Google Slides)



NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS



- Proven long-form editing experience on talking-head, podcast, or interview content — your portfolio must include published videos, with links to the channels they ran on

- Strong command of YouTube-native editing: pacing, hooks, b-roll, captions, retention

- At least ONE of the following, with examples:

   – Thumbnail design: click-worthy YouTube thumbnails, OR

   – YouTube strategy: titles, packaging, SEO, analytics, channel growth

- Excellent English and comfort collaborating directly with the CEO and clients

- Data-driven but trend-aware — you work with numbers and taste

- Based in Davao City and available for the hybrid studio setup



BONUS POINTS



- Background in marketing, branding, or viral content creation

- Experience managing and growing YouTube channels

- Working knowledge of YouTube SEO and monetization

- Comfortable running multiple projects in parallel without dropping threads



WHAT WE OFFER



- 13th-month bonus from Day 1

- Performance bonuses tied to content growth

- HMO, dental, mental health & telemedicine coverage (after 6-month tenure)

- Paid week-long Christmas leave + PTO + birthday gift

- Trust-based culture — no time tracking, no micromanagement

- Workshops plus financial & credit support

- Real creative authority — your input shapes strategy, not just execution



HOW TO APPLY



Include in your application:

1. Your resume/CV

2. 2–3 long-form videos you edited (talking-head/podcast preferred) — links to the published videos, with the channel name and your role on each

3. If you're claiming the thumbnail or strategy leg: 2–3 examples of that work



Applying via OnlineJobs.ph?

Start your application message with the word "STORYTELLER" so we know you read this.



Applying via
?

Send everything to 
 with the subject line:

YouTube Creative Director (Davao Based) — [Your Full Name]



Applications without live video links will not be shortlisted.

title: L2 Tech Support Engineer
description:
Dear Technology Lover!

We're a small (but VERY efficient) 20-year-old MSP based in Arizona.

As a small company. we're VERY employee-focused, and believe that our team members are our MOST IMPORTANT ASSET!



Here are some of the things you can expect from working with us:

• Ongoing (monthly) manager review and feedback- you should never guess where you are "standing" and what you, AND THE COMPANY, can do better!

• Paid certifications- we will pay for your courses and tests and allocate time during business hours to help you achieve your desired goals

• Paid Time Off- it's important to us that you are happy, healthy, and have a work-life balance!

• Bonuses- when the company wins, you win!

• Raises- As we grow, we believe you should as well. We have to stay competitive as an employer to retain our awesome employees!

• Opportunities to grow- In our industry, we can't be on "cruise control"... We need to push our team members to stay ahead of the technology curve. Help you continually sharpen your skills with a focus on your career aspirations.

• Paid sick days- We understand life happens. We don't want you to feel that you have to drag yourself to work sick if your body tells you to relax...



You're the right fit if you:

• LOVE learning, working with, and experimenting with new technology

• Get excited when you save someone's day and provide great service

• Are a hard-working, fun person, and see yourself being in the IT industry for the foreseeable future

• Want to work in a GROWING environment, with STABLE income, Bonuses, and a great attitude!

• Want the opportunity to advance and learn more!



Some of the responsibilities that your position will include are:

Helpdesk (mostly escalations, but some basic if needed), cyber security related tasks/ audits, cloud hosting and virtualization (HyperV, SonicWall, VPN), MS365 management and automation, BCDR (Axcient), networking (UniFi, SonicWall), IT projects, Servers maintenance (Windows only), scripts creation, testing new technology, and other tasks related to IT.



IMPORTANT:

This position requires AT LEAST 2 years of MSP experience and at least 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory, or lead role. 100% clean background check, highly organized, technologically savvy, and can work diligently with little supervision. Several hiring steps will take place to verify the above requirements, including reference checking, employment verification, technical testing, and more.



Minimum technical level that you will need to be able to pass a test on:

• Explaining to a non-technical person what the "cloud" is

• Consulting with a new client on what BCDR solution you would recommend to an SMB, and why

• Explaining what the differences are between traditional anti-virus and XDR

• Creating a new Virtual Machine on a Hyper-V host, from an ISO file located on a different computer on the network.

• Explaining the differences and commonalities between SharePoint and OneDrive.

• Creating an Intune policy that will install Firefox on an Azure-joined VM, and make Firefox the default browser, with the specific home page we'll provide to you during the test.

• Several other situational and technical questions.

• CCNA certificate candidates preferred but not required.



MORE DETAILS:

• A PRE-EMPLOYMENT BACKGROUND CHECK is performed (at our expense). You must have 100% clean background check. Please do not apply if you don't have 100% clean background check.

• Personality is KEY for us. We are looking for an easy-going, yet professional, friendly, and HONEST person.

• You will be working from home. This means you must have a quiet work environment and no excessive background noise.

• FAST AND RELIABLE INTERNET SERVICE IS REQUIRED with at least 100Mbps download speed and 20+ Mbps upload speed.

• As part of this position requirement, you must have a computer that will be used exclusively for your work with us. This means we will be installing our security software on that computer, will remove admin rights from you, and monitor/ control it for security and compliance reasons. In return, we will pay you additional “rent” fees, on top of your salary, in the amount of several hundred dollars. Details about this “rental” will be discussed during your second interview. There are minimum requirements that your computer must have in order to be employed with us. You must have a Computer/Laptop with at least i5 minimum 9th gen processor (preferably a newer one) with 16 GB RAM or more, or Ryzen 5/7 (MUST include TPM support) as well as Windows 11 OS.

• You must have recently worked on a night shift for 2 consecutive years or more.

• We evaluate/ review employees monthly and provide consistent feedback.

• We offer raises and bonuses according to performance, certifications, attitude, and customer reviews twice/ year.

• Your manager (our IT director) will create a roadmap for your "KPIs" and certifications track. We always push our team to earn certifications and additional knowledge – even allowing “disconnect study time” during business hours!

• On-call rotation (after-hours) for a week at a time, once every 4-5 weeks. It's VERY rare that we get calls after-hours (the average is only twice/ year!).

• We're closed on major US holidays, and at the completion of the first 3 months of employment, you'll qualify for paid holidays.

• Work hours are Mon-Fri at 8 am till 5:30 pm (UTC-07:00 , MST, Arizona time zone)

• Every 4 to 5 weeks, you'll be working 1/2 day on a Saturday (project work/catch-up work) and get 1/2 day off the week after

• Mandatory 1-hour lunch and additional breaks (as you need those) throughout the day.

• Further details and information will be discussed with qualified candidates.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

• REQUIRED: Relevant minimum 3 YEARS of experience working for an MSP

• REQUIRED: With AT LEAST 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory or lead role.

• REQUIRED: Microsoft Azure AD/ M365 experience

• REQUIRED: Experience working with an RMM and PSA software (DATTO preferred)

• Preferred: Cyber Security education/experience

• Preferred: Hyper-V experience



Other tools we use:

Barracuda DNS filter, AutoElevate, Cylance, Infocyte, Syxsense, IT Glue, SonicWall, Unifi, and more



HOW TO APPLY?



Send an
 to 
 with the subject line "L2 Tech Support - August 2026".



In your
 body, you MUST include the following, and ONLY the following, please:

- An attachment of your resume in PDF format (Please update your resume before submitting it, as we use an AI-powered agent to review qualifications.)

- A confirmation (simple written statement) that you have a 100% clean background with no criminal history.

- A confirmation (simple written statement) that you understand the business hours (MST\ Arizona time zone.



Answer the following questions:

1. How many years of experience do you have working in an MSP company? Name of the MSP company/s you worked with.

2. Do you have at least 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory or lead role?

3. Do you have experience working with RMM and PSA software? What applications did you use?

4. Do you have experience working with Virtualization, servers, GPO, TCP/IP, hyper-v/vmware, conditional access, Intune, and Scripting such as PowerShell?

5. Have you recently worked on a night shift for 2 consecutive years or more? What time zone and when?

6. Are you okay with the computer requirements and the rental arrangement described in the job details?

7. Do you have an internet speed of at least 100Mbps download speed and  20+ upload speed?



- No other information/cover letter or attachments should be included, besides a simple salutation and signature if so desired.



NOTE: Please do NOT apply using other methods besides the above. Any applicants who reach out to us via phone, social media, or any method other than the instructions above will automatically be disqualified.

Only those who followed the above instructions will be contacted within 2 business days, with further instructions.





We're looking forward to having you join our family!

title: Full-Time Bookkeeper – Home Services Company
description:
# Full-Time Bookkeeper – Home Services Company



**Location:** Remote — Philippines  

**Schedule:** 40 hours per week, with occasional additional hours as business needs require  

**Working Hours:** [Insert required U.S. time zone and schedule]  

**Compensation:** [Insert salary range and payment details]



## About the Role



We are a growing U.S.-based home services company seeking a dependable, detail-oriented full-time bookkeeper in the Philippines. You will oversee the company’s day-to-day bookkeeping, payroll coordination, invoicing, collections, commissions, and financial records.



This is a hands-on role for someone who takes ownership, follows up consistently, and keeps financial information accurate and organized. You will work closely with company leadership, tea
mbers in the United States and abroad, and our external accountant.



## Key Responsibilities



### Bookkeeping and Financial Records



- Maintain accurate and organized records in QuickBooks.

- Categorize and reconcile transactions, accounts, and payments.

- Keep financial information current and identify discrepancies promptly.

- Prepare regular reports that give management a clear view of the company’s financial position.

- Maintain supporting documentation for financial transactions.



### JobNimbus and Invoicing



- Maintain the financial side of our JobNimbus CRM.

- Confirm that customer invoices are accurate, complete, and issued on time.

- Monitor outstanding invoices and follow up on overdue balances.

- Record payments and keep customer account information current.

- Assess applicable late fees according to company policies.

- Perform other collection-related activities to help ensure timely payment.

- Reconcile financial information between JobNimbus and QuickBooks.



### Weekly Payroll



- Verify hours submitted by tea
mbers in the United States and abroad.

- Identify missing, inaccurate, or unusual time entries before payroll is processed.

- Prepare and coordinate weekly payroll for U.S.-based and international tea
mbers.

- Maintain accurate payroll records and resolve payroll discrepancies.

- Protect confidential employee and payroll information.



### Commissions and Spreadsheets



- Maintain spreadsheets used to calculate commissions and other team compensation.

- Verify commission amounts against completed jobs, collected payments, and company policies.

- Provide accurate commission reports before payments are approved.

- Maintain organized and auditable spreadsheet records.



### Accountant Coordination



- Coordinate with our external accountant regarding filings and financial reporting.

- Provide requested records and supporting documents accurately and on time.

- Help ensure the accountant has the information needed for tax filings, compliance, and year-end reporting.

- Respond promptly to questions and resolve missing-information requests.



### General Financial Administration



- Manage other financial and bookkeeping responsibilities as needed.

- Improve financial processes and help maintain strong internal controls.

- Communicate financial concerns, overdue accounts, and discrepancies to management.

- Meet recurring weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual deadlines.



## Required Qualifications



- Previous bookkeeping or accounting experience.

- Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks Online.

- Experience processing or coordinating payroll.

- Strong spreadsheet skills, including Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

- Experience with invoicing, accounts receivable, and collections.

- High attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy.

- Excellent organization, time-management, and follow-up skills.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Ability to handle confidential financial and payroll information professionally.

- Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet connection, and a quiet workspace.

- Ability to work independently and communicate proactively with a remote team.

- Willingness to work the required U.S. business hours and occasional additional hours when needed.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience using JobNimbus or a similar home-services CRM.

- Bookkeeping experience with a U.S.-based company.

- Experience in roofing, construction, contracting, or another home-services industry.

- Familiarity with U.S. payroll and basic accounting practices.

- Experience calculating sales commissions or performance-based compensation.

- Experience working directly with an external accountant or CPA.



## What Success Looks Like



The successful candidate will:



- Keep QuickBooks and JobNimbus accurate and up to date.

- Ensure weekly payroll is prepared correctly and on time.

- Make sure invoices are issued promptly and actively followed up until collected.

- Maintain accurate commission calculations and supporting records.

- Give management timely visibility into financial issues.

- Provide complete, organized information to our accountant.

- Take ownership of financial tasks without requiring constant reminders.



## How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your résumé or CV.

2. A brief description of your bookkeeping experience.

3. Details about your experience with QuickBooks, payroll, invoicing, collections, and spreadsheets.

4. Any experience you have with JobNimbus or another CRM.

5. Your preferred monthly salary in Philippine pesos.

6. Your availability and ability to work [insert required U.S. time zone].

7. Your internet speed and backup plans for internet or power interruptions.

8. The names of two professional references.



Please begin your application with the words **“Organized Finances”** so we know you read the entire posting.

title: Operations Assistant
description:
Boosted Brains is looking for a detail-oriented Operations Assistant to support the administrative backbone of our ACT/SAT tutoring company. You'll help keep our student tracker accurate, our practice tests scored correctly, our files organized, and our families well taken care of during onboarding. This work directly frees up our coaches to focus on teaching.



Key Responsibilities:



You'll be responsible for scoring completed practice tests accurately against our answer keys, entering results into our systems and Student Tracker, and filling out diagnostic sheets based on student results. You'll process and organize practice tests and tutoring files, sorting and renaming shared materials so coaches can find what they need quickly, and keeping our shared drive consistently structured. You'll also own the day-to-day accuracy of our Notion-based Student Tracker: logging new students, updating statuses, keeping records consistent, and flagging anything that looks off or incomplete.



This role does not include refund disputes or contested parent negotiations, coach terminations or disciplinary matters, any written commitments on money or guarantees, or access to payment systems.



Qualifications:



We're looking for someone with excellent written English and a meticulous approach to data and detail, since scoring and tracker work need to be right every time. You should be comfortable with spreadsheets and open to learning tools like Notion and Claude, even if you haven't used them extensively before. Reliability and communication matter a lot in this role: we need someone who responds promptly and flags problems early rather than letting them sit. You should also be able to follow documented processes independently once trained, and be available for some overlap with US working hours.



Application Process:



We have a simple, two-step application process. Please follow instructions closely, attention to detail is part of what we're evaluating.



Step 1: Submit a short intro video

Record a video: a brief introduction, your past experience(s), and why you'd be a good fit.



Must be between 45 and 60 seconds. Videos outside this range won't be considered.

Title it exactly: "Boosted Brains - [Your Name]"

Send the video link and your resume to 



Step 2: Second-round task

Candidates who pass the initial screening will receive a short follow-up task, with full details shared at that stage.

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back

Executive Assistant

 inbox

s and identify priorities

s on my behalf

s and outstanding items

ing government departments

A college degree is strongly preferred.



A degree from a U.S. college or university is a major plus.



The Type of Person Who Will Succeed Here



You are someone who doesn’t stop at:



“I couldn’t find it.”



Instead, you figure out another way.



You search for it. You
 someone. You make a phone call. You find the right department. You follow up again.



I don’t want to provide step-by-step instructions for every assignment.



I want to be able to say:

You should also be comfortable following up with me.



If something requires my decision, I want you to tell me:



“I need your answer on this today or it’s going to delay the project.”



Organization, ownership, resourcefulness, and follow-through are extremely important for this position.

Monday–Friday

title: Video Editor - Church and Ministries Video
description:
Faith Culture. Purpose-Driven. Growth-Oriented.



**About Ruah Creative House**



Ruah Creative House is a remote, faith-driven creative studio helping churches, Christian nonprofits, and values aligned leaders communicate with clarity and excellence. We produce reels and sermon cuts, podcasts, event promos, bumpers, and social content designed for real impact, not vanity metrics.



**What we’re about**



- **Purpose over hype:** helpful, truthful, on mission storytelling.  

- **Craft and systems:** solid editing fundamentals, clean organization, reliable handoffs. We give you everything you need to do your job well.  

- **Teamwork:** clear briefs, quick feedback, zero drama. We grow people, not just projects.

- Multisite churches and ministries  

- Faith based coaches, entrepreneurs, and communicators  

- Community nonprofits and events

We have a small team of 9 that you would make a great addition in! You’ll receive real briefs, real feedback, and people who care whether your work is good.

- Consistent, faith aligned work  

- A kind team that invests in training and tools  

- Clear deadlines, realistic scopes, and room to grow  

- Flexible atmosphere

- Paid PH holidays plus your birthday off; bonuses for urgent or weekend sprints when offered 

- Paid time off - Holidays and Sick time

- 13th Month Pay

- Direct training and 1:1 Meetings with Owner



**Role at a Glance**



- **Title:** Video Editing Specialist (Full Time)  

- **Compensation:** Starting $600/month USD, paid bi weekly via Wise  

- **Hours:** 40 hrs/week, fully remote

- **Probation:** Paid 2 week training period with one month probation, converting to full-time benefits on successful completion  

- **Schedule:** Light flexibility, keep your deadlines. One mandatory weekly tea
eting, Mondays at 9 AM PHT.
