You’ll edit short form and long form projects for faith based organizations and purpose?led clients:



- Sermon Reels (short, social first clips)  

- Sermon Cuts (longer excerpts for YouTube and web)  

- Podcasts (video first, simple edits)  

- Bumpers and Openers (series and welcome intros)  

- Event Promos and Event Recaps  

- Coach and small business content (training, VSLs, social)  



On output: this is a full time seat, so we think in terms of a full day’s work rather than a quota. Volume shifts with complexity. Some days that’s a handful of simple to moderate reels; other days it’s one larger edit that takes your whole block. We’ll set expectations per project in the brief.



**What You’ll Do**



- Edit short form and long form video in Adobe Premiere Pro  

- Apply clean motion basics: pacing, captions, light effects, tasteful transitions  

- Source music and B roll from licensed libraries (we provide the subscriptions)  

- Follow project briefs closely and keep style and tone aligned to each client  

- Own your queue in Motion, our project?management tool: your tasks, your deadlines, your handoffs  

- Upload exports, organize folders, archive projects properly  

- Work with QA for quick, accurate revisions  

- Communicate proactively in Chat and Motion comments  



**What Great Looks Like**



- On time delivery against clear deadlines  

- Accurate spelling and graphics, strong hooks, clean color and audio  

- Organized projects any teammate can pick up  

- You raise risks early, suggest solutions, and keep 
ntum without being chased  



**Requirements**



- **Editing:** Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe CC proficiency ONLY, strong English comprehension  

- **Internet:** Reliable connection, 50?Mbps down / 20 Mbps up minimum, plus a backup hotspot  

- **Hardware:** Apple Silicon or i7/Ryzen?7, 16 GB+ RAM, SSD storage (2TB total working space recommended), dedicated GPU preferred  

- **Workflow:** Comfortable with Google Drive, Motion (we train you), Loom and 
 for reviews  

- **Communication:** Daily check in and check out message, responsive in Chat during your work block, respectful of faith friendly content  



**Nice to Have**

 subject: *Ruah Creative House EDITOR, Your Name, Your Favorite Color*

title: Amazon Listing & Creative Optimization Lead - Part-Time
description:
Own Amazon listing creative end to end for our pizza-making accessories brand: the research, the direction, the production and the tests. Part-time, remote worldwide, working directly with a founder with 10+ years in e-commerce.



You own the direction and the call on what to test. This role does not manage PPC campaigns.



Apply here: tally.so/r/PdJKOb



Compensation: Up to USD 25/hour, depending on experience, demonstrated results, and level of ownership. We are looking for the best fit, not the lowest bidder.

Initial commitment: 10-15 hours per week; exact monthly capacity agreed before the start.

Engagement: Part-time independent contractor. The first 90 days are the initial engagement.

Location: Remote. Worldwide.

Collaboration: Mostly asynchronous, with 1 weekly decision call.

Time zones: You choose your hours. We agree on a recurring window you can keep, plus a slot for the weekly call. We plan in Europe/Warsaw time.

Works directly with: Founder.



________________





The opportunity



Most Amazon listings lose the customer for a single reason. The main image says the wrong thing, the gallery answers the wrong question, or the copy repeats what every competitor writes. Your job is to find that reason and remove it, with evidence.





Atlanti Brands has built and sold e-commerce brands, mostly on Amazon. You work on the brands we are building now: Pizza-making accessories brand for customers in the US, UK, EU and Canada, plus 2 smaller brands. 





You own this loop:





evidence → purchase barrier → creative direction → brief → production → QA → publish → test → decision





The founder owns the product, the positioning and the budget. You focus on one main priority and one smaller task at a time.





You also help choose what we sell next. For product ideas on the founder's shortlist, you review customer and market evidence and recommend what to test.

What you own

* Turn evidence into priorities. Use reviews, search and performance data, competitor research, and customer tests such as PickFu to identify the biggest opportunities across current listings, ad creative, and upcoming launches. Build a clear, capacity-ordered backlog.

* Own the creative direction. D
 the listing SEO approach, message order, and direction for main images, galleries, A+ Content, product videos, video ads, and static ads.

* Make small edits yourself using our tools and AI. Create wireframes and mock-ups, revise copy and layouts, localize existing assets, and generate or refine AI images. Brief specialists when the work requires advanced retouching, photography, 3D, or video production.

* Lead production through publication. Find, brief, and manage freelancers, specialists, and UGC creators. Accept or reject their work against our product facts, claims, and usage rules. Upload approved assets in Seller Central and verify that they appear correctly in each marketplace and placement. You remain accountable for the final result.

* Test, d
, and record. Run A/B tests of listing and ad creative, supported by creative-level ad reporting. Distinguish decision-ready results from early signals, and keep a light, AI-assisted record of what changed, what happened, and what we learned.

What success looks like by Day 90

* Deliver creative packages for 3 new product launches. Lead each package from customer and market research through SEO copy, main image, gallery, A+ Content, product video, ad creative, and final QA. If the third product is not ready, complete the agreed backup project instead.

* Improve our priority listings and ad creative. Use an AI-assisted portfolio audit and focused customer research to identify the biggest conversion gaps and complete the highest-priority improvements.

* Build a scalable video and ad creative library. Develop strong master concepts, reusable footage, and efficient variants, then localize the agreed listing videos and ad creative for priority European marketplaces with a video editor.

* Create a repeatable testing and decision system. Start useful A/B tests when traffic and eligibility allow. Turn completed tests into clear decisions to keep, improve, or stop, and record early signals and blockers when a final result is not yet available.





By Day 90 you should manage day-to-day creative priorities, briefs, specialist feedback, publication and follow-up without daily direction.

How the engagement works

* Capacity. We reserve and pay for about 10-15 hours per week during the first 90 days. We agree on the exact time allocation before the start, together with a recurring working window that fits your time zone. Extra hours are agreed in advance.

* If a blocker is on our side. If something we owe you stops the main task, we still pay the agreed hours. You stay available and complete other ready work. Tell us early when something on our side is holding you up.

* After Day 90. Our goal is a long-term working relationship. After the first 90 days, we review the results and how we work together, then agree on the next scope and capacity in writing.

* Contract and payment. This is an independent contractor engagement. You invoice us monthly in USD.

Why work with us

* Real ownership. Work directly with the founder, learn from 10 years of building e-commerce brands and see your impact across multiple marketplaces.

* Support, not bureaucracy. We give you product facts, templates and AI workflows. We fund approved research and specialists. You get direct feedback and fast decisions.

* Paid reserved capacity. We pay for the capacity we reserve, not only for completed deliverables.

* Room to improve how we work. We expect direct communication. If a part of our process is wrong, say so, propose a better way, and help us implement it.

What you need

* You have owned Amazon listing creative outcomes. You have led Amazon listing creative work from direction through production. You can brief and manage freelancers, give clear feedback, and accept or reject their work against defined standards. SEO-only experience, support work, or producing assets from someone else's brief is not enough.

* You know the Amazon creative craft. You understand listing SEO, conversion copy, main images, galleries, A+ Content, product video, and ad creative.

* You can defend and execute a creative direction. You have strong visual judgment and can explain the evidence behind your decisions. Using Canva, Photoshop, AI image tools, or equivalent software, you can create wireframes and mock-ups and make simple asset edits yourself - such as a new main image variant, copy or layout changes, localized versions, and AI-generated or refined images.

* You use data and AI responsibly. You understand basic commercial math and attribution, and use AI for research, audits, and creative work. You check sources, apply your own judgment, say what the data cannot prove, and record decisions for future use.

* You can work in English. You can write a clear brief and discuss decisions live. Accent and occasional grammar mistakes do not matter.





Useful but not required: experience with PickFu, Intellivy, ProductPinion, or Amazon Manage Your Experiments. Pizza-making experience or a genuine interest in the category is also a plus.

How to apply and what to expect

1. Application. Tell us about your relevant experience and describe 1 relevant project.

Apply here: tally.so/r/PdJKOb

2. Shortlist screen. Selected candidates complete a short, unpaid simulated task. Some candidates are invited to a brief follow-up discussion.

3. Paid finalist case. Finalists complete a 4-hour case for USD 100. We pay the fee regardless of whether an offer is made. Selected candidates then have a 30-minute discussion. We hold a final mutual-fit conversation with the preferred finalist and may, with permission, contact 1 reference if a specific question remains.

You source creators, sign them, walk them through onboarding and warm-up, keep them posting on schedule, and make sure they get paid, across several client campaigns at once. When a campaign needs 10 or more creators posting a video a day, you are the person who knows at any moment who posted, who did not, and who is stuck.



Everything runs through 
. The best fit here is a strong ops person who is also good with people: fast, accurate, organized, and fine with strategy changing mid-contract.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Research and discovery. Find creators on discovery platforms using filters like US-based, niche, and account performance, and check whether their existing content formats match what we are actually trying to produce. Also watch TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram directly for viral formats and rising talent.

- Outreach. First contact via DM,
, or 
, pitch the opportunity, and run the relationship from there.

- Negotiation. Most UGC creators land on one of two standard rates, so day to day this is simple. On micro-influencer campaigns you will negotiate real deals creator by creator: rates, deliverables, usage.

- Onboarding and warm-up. Guide creators through onboarding in 
, including our bot-guided flow. Review warm-up videos and confirm creators are warming their accounts correctly before they post campaign content.

- Content review. Check creator content in 
 against campaign requirements, including that every video uses the right campaign hashtag so it gets tracked. Flag what needs redoing and explain why.

- Posting ops and reporting. Keep daily posting on track across every active campaign and maintain clean reporting on who posted, who did not, and who needs a nudge. Current and accurate, not reconstructed at the end of the week.

- Creator support. Be the first line for creator questions and unblock people fast. Advice has to be right and it has to be quick, since a correct answer six hours late still costs us a post.

- Payments. Run creator payouts on payment platforms like Grade and track what has been paid against what is owed.

- Spreadsheets and process. Work in our existing Google Sheets templates: updating them, fixing errors, keeping campaign data clean. If you can make our sheets run better, even better.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Strong ops instincts. You hold a lot of moving pieces without dropping any and always know the current state of a campaign.

- You know creator ops language (CPM, base pay, tiered bonuses, caps, deliverables) or can pick it up fast.

- You understand how social platforms actually work: hashtags and tracking, algorithms, formats, why a short-form video lands.

- Comfortable in 
. Servers, roles, channels, threads, tickets, bots.

- Software-native. You use a lot of apps, pick up new ones fast on mobile and web (a PC for desktop apps helps), notice UI and UX details, and can take clean screenshots to build walkthroughs that guide a creator through an app they have never opened.

THE BAR

title: Senior (L3 / Technical Lead)
description:
We’re hiring an L3 Technical Lead to drive escalations, standards, and technical execution in an MSP environment. This is a hands-on senior role for someone who can solve complex issues end-to-end, communicate clearly on client calls, and lead/support L1/L2 technicians.



Non-negotiables:



Excellent spoken English (you will be on calls).



MSP-level expertise across Microsoft products, virtualization/hypervisors, backups, and RMM/PSA operations.



Ability to work CST 8am–5pm consistently.



Responsibilities

L3 Escalations / Engineering



Resolve advanced issues across Microsoft 365, Windows Server, identity, networking, virtualization, and backups.

Perform root cause analysis (RCA), implement permanent fixes, and reduce repeat tickets.

Lead or support projects: onboardings, migrations, remediation, standardization.

MSP Tooling & Process (RMM/PSA)

Work efficiently inside a PSA: proper ticket updates, time entries, SLAs, client communication.

Use RMM tools for monitoring, remediation, patching, scripting, and automation.

Improve documentation and SOPs/runbooks for consistent service delivery.



Technical Leadership

Provide guidance and mentoring to L1/L2; raise quality and speed of resolution.

Help define standards and best practices across client environments.

Communicate clearly with clients and internal stakeholders (verbal + written).

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

3–5+ years MSP experience (or equivalent multi-client support).

Strong verbal English with confidence on calls (clear accent, professional tone).

Deep knowledge of Microsoft stack, including:

Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive)

Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS/DHCP

Strong troubleshooting discipline (logs, structured diagnosis, documentation).

Hypervisors / Virtualization

Experience supporting VMware and/or Hyper-V 

VM performance + storage troubleshooting, snapshots, host issues.

Backup / Disaster Recovery

Experience with MSP-grade backup platforms (e.g., Veeam, Datto, Acronis, MSP360, etc.).

Backup verification, restore testing, DR planning, ransomware-aware practices.



RMM / PSA

Hands-on experience with at least one PSA and one RMM (examples below).

Ability to manage workflow, priorities, and documentation at MSP standards.

Examples (not required all):

PSA: ConnectWise Manage, Autotask, HaloPSA, Freshservice/Jira Service Mgmt

RMM: NinjaOne, ConnectWise Automate, Datto RMM, Kaseya, N-able



Nice-to-Have

PowerShell automation (M365 user/admin tasks, remediation scripts).

Security tooling exposure (EDR,
 security, basic SIEM).

Azure IaaS / hybrid environments.



What We’re Looking For

Ownership mindset: you take problems to completion.

Strong customer communication: concise, calm, and clear.

Documentation-first: fixes are repeatable and understandable.

Can lead technically without ego; coaches others effectively.



Compensation

Competitive, based on experience and interview performance.

Please include your expected monthly rate.



How to Apply (Required)

Please provide:



Resume/CV



A 30sec - 1 minute voice or Loom recording answering:

Your MSP background



Your strongest Microsoft area (real example)

A complex escalation you solved (steps + outcome)

List your RMM/PSA tools and how long you used each

Your PC specs, headset/mic confirmation, and internet speed



Confirm you can work CST 8:00am–4:00pm

title: Operations Generalist
description:
TMA Laser Group is a national drop-ship distributor of printing, office, and medical supplies. We've been in business for 15 years and run as a small, fully remote team of about 10 people. We're a sales-driven organization — everything we do ultimately comes back to one goal: keeping customers happy and retained.



We're building out a new backend system to make our sales team more efficient and our operations more organized, and we're looking for someone sharp to work closely with me on that from day one — testing functionality, catching bugs, flagging gaps, and thinking critically about whether the system actually works the way our operations need it to. No coding required, but you do need to think like an owner: notice what's broken, question what doesn't make sense, and care about getting it right.



From there, this role is designed to grow. As you get a feel for how the business runs, you'll cross-train across our core operations — order processing, logistics and package tracking, vendor management, and eventually customer service — and take on real ownership as we figure out together where you add the most value. This isn't a narrow, single-task role; we need someone who can genuinely move across the business and handle whatever the day calls for.



What you'll be doing early on:



Working directly with me testing our new backend system — looking for bugs, broken workflows, and gaps between what the system does and what our operations actually need

Learning our order processing and sales workflows in depth

Cross-training in logistics and package tracking, ensuring orders reach customers reliably

Learning our vendor network and helping keep product catalogs current

Taking on other operational tasks as needed — we're a small team and need someone who can flex



What you'll grow into:



Direct customer communication — responding to inquiries, handling complaints and returns, and helping resolve issues in a way that keeps customers loyal

Potential ownership of a core function — order processing, logistics, vendor management, or customer service — depending on where you're strongest



What we're looking for:



Strong initiative — someone who identifies what needs attention and acts, rather than waiting for direction

Sharp attention to detail and genuine analytical thinking (not just following steps)

A real desire to understand how the business runs, not just complete tasks

Strong written and spoken English and clear, confident communication

Comfortable operating with ambiguity and shifting between responsibilities

Solid computer skills — Google Workspace, MS Office, Excel

Reliable availability 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time



Compensation: Starting at $1,000/month, with opportunities for increases as you take on additional responsibilities and prove your fit for the role.



Growth: This role is built to expand — including into customer-facing work — as you prove yourself and show where you shine.

title: Architectural Photography Editor
description:
About the role:

I'm an architectural and interior photographer based in Australia looking for a skilled photo editor to join my workflow long-term. Work involves editing high-end residential and small multi-residential property images for real estate and design clients. Style is moody, ambient, and restraint-led — not the bright/punchy real estate look.



Core tasks:



Blend multi-exposure bracketed shots (interior/exterior) using manual layer masking in Photoshop — this is NOT simple HDR merge/tone-mapping, needs hand-masked blending for natural, believable light

Balance window exposures, sky replacement where needed

Fine-tune colour grading to match a consistent house style

Perspective/verticals correction

Basic retouching: removing cords, bins, reflections, sensor spots, minor distractions

Deliver consistent, colour-accurate exports at specified sizes/formats



Required skills:



Advanced Photoshop skills — specifically manual luminosity/layer masking (not just auto-blend or HDR plugins)

Strong understanding of light and exposure blending for architecture/interiors

Experience editing real estate or architectural photography specifically

Sharp eye for straight lines, symmetry, and clean composition

Reliable, fast turnaround, good communication in English



To apply, please include:



Before/after portfolio samples

Typical turnaround time per image/batch

Rate per image or per hour

title: Business Operations Analyst / Industrial Engineer / Assistant to the CEO

Full-Time | Remote | Philippines

 inbox and identify messages requiring attention or action.

s on behalf of the CEO when appropriate.

* Track outstanding requests, commitments, follow-ups, and action items.

* Help ensure important issues do not get missed and are followed through to completion.

* Support the CEO with operational, financial, administrative, and strategic matters as required.



What We Are Looking For



Industrial Engineering graduates are strongly preferred, although exceptional candidates from Business Analytics, Management Engineering, Finance, Accounting, Operations Management, or similar analytical fields may also be considered.



You should have:



* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.

* Excellent written and spoken English — CEFR C1 or C2 preferred.

* Excellent professional
 communication skills.

* Strong Excel and/or Google Sheets skills.

* Good numerical and financial understanding.

* Ability to research unfamiliar topics independently.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Good judgment and discretion when handling confidential business information.

* Ability to prioritize urgent and important issues.

* Ability to work independently without needing detailed instructions for every task.

Financial Literacy



You will be expected to understand basic business finance, including:



Revenue, gross profit, margins, expenses, cash flow, accounts receivable/payable, inventory, budgeting, break-even analysis, and return on investment.



Accounting, bookkeeping, QuickBooks, management accounting, or financial-analysis experience is a strong advantage.



Technology



You should be comfortable using:



* Excel / Google Sheets

* Google Workspace

* Gmail

* ChatGPT and other AI tools

* Online research tools

* Business and project-management software

We are seeking an experienced Credentialing, Licensing & Contracting Specialist to take full ownership of our credentialing, licensing, payer enrollment, and regulatory compliance processes across multiple healthcare entities.

This is a mission-critical role. Maintaining active provider enrollments, licenses, and regulatory certifications directly impacts our ability to deliver patient care and receive reimbursement. Key Responsibilities

Provider Credentialing & Enrollment

Compliance Management

• Own and maintain a comprehensive compliance calendar for all provider and facility expirations.

• Monitor licenses, DEA registrations, CLIA certificates, malpractice insurance, board certifications, and payer revalidations.

• Proactively escalate upcoming expirations at least 90 days in advance.

• Continuously improve credentialing and compliance workflows.

Qualifications

Required

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in U.S. healthcare provider credentialing, payer enrollment, or payer contracting.

• Hands-on experience with CAQH, PECOS, and Availity.

• Experience submitting credentialing applications to commercial insurance payers and government programs.

• Strong understanding of Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payer enrollment processes.

• Excellent written English communication skills.

• Exceptional organizational and time management skills.

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

• Availability to work Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time.

• Reliable home office with high-speed internet, backup internet, and backup power.

• HIPAA Certified or willing to obtain certification immediately upon hire.

Preferred

• Multi-state provider licensing experience.

• Experience with CLIA regulations or laboratory compliance.

• Exposure to payer fee schedule review or contract negotiation.

• Experience supporting multiple healthcare entities or organizations.

What We're Looking For

The successful candidate is:

• Detail-oriented and highly organized.

Turn Your Voice Into Your Biggest Asset



Are you the person who can get a "no" and still walk away with a callback? Do you thrive on the thrill of a great pitch and love closing the gap between a cold lead and a booked appointment? We're looking for a Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller who's ready to bring energy, persistence, and persuasion to a growing, fast-paced commercial real estate team.

Every call you make has the potential to turn into a deal, and every deal you help set up is a direct reflection of your skill on the phone. Commercial deals move differently than residential — longer relationships, bigger stakes, and owners or decision-makers who expect a caller who sounds like they know the space.

If you're confident, quick on your feet, and genuinely enjoy the game of turning "not interested" into "let's talk," we want to hear from you.



What You'll Do

Pull and build targeted call lists using county records, CRE data platforms, and public/private property databases

Identify and qualify off-market and undervalued commercial properties based on owner motivation, property condition, and financial indicators

Gather key property details: lease type (NNN, gross, modified gross), tenant occupancy/vacancy status, square footage, zoning, and ownership structure

What You Bring



1–2 years of experience in a call center handling international accounts, and/or real estate cold calling — commercial experience strongly preferred

Excellent English communication skills (neutral accent preferred)

Comfort speaking with business owners, investors, and brokers — not just residential homeowners

description:

About Maison Mnandi Africa



Maison Mnandi Africa is a growing African lifestyle e-commerce brand celebrating authentic African craftsmanship, heritage and contemporary living through artisan-made fashion, accessories and home décor.



Our website is newly launched with no established online sales or consistent purchasing traffic yet, so you will be joining us at ground zero.



We are looking for a hands-on, commercially minded E-Commerce Growth & Operations Specialist who can help us build a stable customer base by attracting qualified traffic, improving conversion and progressively growing online sales.

1. Shopify & Conversion Optimisation



Manage and continuously improve our Shopify store to increase sales. Optimise product and collection pages, mobile experience, merchandising, navigation, trust signals, cross-selling and the overall customer journey.



2. Traffic & Customer Acquisition



Develop and execute strategies to attract qualified purchasing traffic through relevant channels such as Meta, Google, Pinterest and organic search. Test products, audiences, campaigns and landing pages to identify what generates customers profitably.



3. SEO & Content



Improve product and collection SEO, conduct keyword research and build our organic search visibility.



Research, write, optimise and publish two high-quality SEO-led blog articles per month that support both brand storytelling and customer acquisition.



4. Klaviyo & Customer Retention



Manage and optimise our existing Klaviyo setup, including flows, forms, segmentation and
 campaigns.



Monitor performance and make data-driven updates when necessary to improve conversion, recover potential lost sales and encourage repeat purchases. We are not looking for someone to unnecessarily rebuild systems that are already working.



5. Performance & Reporting



Monitor key e-commerce metrics including traffic, conversion rate, AOV, CAC, revenue, ROAS and organic growth, and provide a concise weekly update on performance, learnings and next priorities.



Requirements



* 3+ years of hands-on Shopify/e-commerce experience.

* Strong understanding of CRO and online buyer behaviour.

* Practical experience with Klaviyo.

* Strong SEO and keyword research knowledge.

* Experience generating customer traffic through Meta, Google, Pinterest and/or organic search.

* Strong analytical skills and understanding of e-commerce metrics.

* Excellent written English and ability to create high-quality SEO/blog content.

* Ability to work independently, take initiative and execute without constant supervision.

* Comfortable working with an early-stage e-commerce store from ground zero.



Experience with fashion, accessories, home décor, artisan products or premium/luxury e-commerce is highly desirable.



Compensation & Growth Opportunity



$450 USD monthly retainer for approximately 10–12 focused hours per week, plus 5% uncapped commission on qualifying net sales revenue.



The commission structure is designed to directly reward successful revenue growth — as the business grows, so does your earning potential.



Qualifying net sales revenue and commission terms will be clearly defined in the contractor agreement, including the treatment of refunds, cancellations, taxes and other exclusions.



The role will begin with an initial 3-month contract, followed by a performance review. Strong performance may lead to a longer-term partnership, increased retainer and expanded responsibilities as the business grows.



How to Apply



Start your application title/subject line with the word MNANDI. Applications without this will not be considered.



Please include:



1. Portfolio & Results



Share 2–3 Shopify/e-commerce stores you have personally worked on.



Briefly explain what you were responsible for, what you implemented and any measurable improvements in sales, conversion, traffic, SEO,
 revenue, CAC or ROAS.



We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience helping new or early-stage stores establish their first consistent sales.



2. Quick Store Assessment



Visit 
 and tell us in 3–5 sentences:



What are the TWO things you would prioritise first to help Maison Mnandi Africa begin generating consistent online sales — and why?



We are not asking for a free audit. We want to understand how you think and prioritise.



3. Ground-Zero Strategy



Imagine you join a newly launched Shopify store with:



No established sales, limited purchasing traffic and little meaningful advertising data.



What would you prioritise in your first 30 days?



Keep your answer practical and concise.



4. Experience

Shopify | CRO | Klaviyo | SEO | Meta | Google | Pinterest



Tell us which areas you are strongest in and which you have personally managed.



5. Resume / Professional Profile



Provide your current resume, LinkedIn profile or professional profile showing your relevant experience.



What Success Looks Like



You are joining us at the beginning.



Our goal is to build:



Qualified Traffic → First Customers → Repeat Customers → Consistent Sales → Sustainable Growth



We are not interested in vanity metrics such as impressions, followers or website sessions without commercial results.



We are looking for someone who can help turn Maison Mnandi Africa into a consistently selling e-commerce business and who is excited by the opportunity to say:

title: Travel Agency Bookkeeper - Cards, Amadeus, Collections (Sun-Thu)
description:
DO NOT APPLY ON THIS PAGE. Open the link at the bottom and record. A resume sent here will not be read.



We are a travel office in Israel. We book flights, hotels, cars, and apartments. Ticketing already has a desk. This seat is the money: cards, banks, Amadeus commissions, customer collections, and Amex points rebates.



If you have only done payroll, expenses, or "I enter receipts in QuickBooks," do not apply. You must have already worked the money side of a travel agency (or airline / OTA / GDS desk).



The work week follows our office: Sunday to Thursday, about 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM Philippine time. You work Sundays. Your weekend is Friday and Saturday.



WHAT YOU WILL MANAGE



1. CREDIT CARDS

Look through every card charge. Confirm it is accurate and that there is a customer payment (or a known open balance) against it. A charge with no matching file is an open item the same day, not "we'll see."



2. AMADEUS — AMERICAN AND ISRAELI

We run two Amadeus worlds. You check both:

- Did we receive the commission from the company?

- Did the customer actually pay us?

A ticket that flew with no commission, or a commission with no customer money, is your catch.



3. BANK ACCOUNTS

Look through the bank accounts and make sure it all adds up. Weekly rec. A stranger can follow the trail. Differences are not rounded away.



4. AMEX TRAVEL + POINTS TICKETS

When we buy a ticket with points through Amex Travel, you track the whole loop:

- The points seller got paid

- The ticket was issued

- The rebate came back

How it works here: a $1,000 ticket is 100,000 points. Then 35 percent is supposed to be refunded. That rebate can take up to 2 weeks. When nobody is watching it, it eats hours and we lose money. You watch it. You chase it. You do not let a rebate sit.



5. COLLECTIONS

Customers who owe us. You follow up until the balance is paid, promised with a date, or flagged to the owner with a reason.



6. POINTS COLLECTION

Same energy as collections, for points: rebates, missing deposits, sellers not paid, 35 percent that did not post. You run after it.



7. OPEN BALANCES

You send the open-balance list. Who owes what, on which file, since when. The sales desk should not have to ask you for this.



8. COST DATA

Pull cost data out of the system. What we paid the airline, the hotel, the car company, the points seller, the card.



9. COST ANALYSIS

Not just pull the number. Say what things actually cost us after rebate, after commission, after fees. So we know which bookings made money.



10. CHEAPER SERVICES

Look at the services we use (car rentals and the rest) and find ways to get them cheaper. Bring a better rate or a better vendor, with the math.



YOU DO NOT OWN

- Setting guest prices or giving discounts

- Issuing tickets (we already have an Amadeus issuer)

- Moving money without a written owner approval

- Hoping the 35 percent rebate "shows up"



REQUIREMENTS

- You have done travel-agency money work as your actual job: cards vs bookings, customer balances, supplier costs. Name the agency.

- You have opened Amadeus (or another GDS) to check a file, a commission, or a sales report. You do not need to issue tickets. You do need to read the money.

- You have personally finished bank recs. Every week. Without being chased.

- You have chased money: collections, missing rebates, or "the vendor said they paid us." You follow up.

- Fluent English, spoken and written. You will
 open balances. We will hear you before we meet you.

- Reliable computer, fast internet, backup internet, backup power

- Two references from travel-finance, agency back-office, or collections work



A PLUS

- Amex Travel, pay-with-points, or any points desk where a rebate posted days later and you were the one who noticed

- Both ARC (US) and BSP (Israel / international) commission reports

- QuickBooks Online or Xero

- You have cut a car-rental or hotel cost by shopping it, not by guessing



HOW WE HIRE

You will record your voice on a real money scenario and send a redacted sample of your own work. We do not interview people we have not heard.



HOW TO APPLY

Open this link and complete the recording form (about 20 minutes):


/philippines/travel-bookkeeper



If you already recorded, send a message here with your full name and the word RECORDED so we can match you. That is the only message that gets a reply.

description:
Performance Marketing Specialist

Paid Media, Strategy & Growth — Remote, Philippines



We are a growing performance marketing agency looking for an experienced marketer who can help us create better results for our clients and become an important part of the company as we grow.



Most of our current clients are B2B companies, primarily in Europe, but the role is not limited to B2B. As the company grows, you may also work with B2C clients and different industries.



Our approach to marketing is simple:



We don't sell arbitrary packages. We focus on the client's goal and build the strategy required to achieve it.



We don't believe that “5 ads per month” or “10 creatives per month” automatically creates value.



Sometimes the right solution may require one strong campaign.



Sometimes it may require 30 new creatives, a new landing page, different positioning, new targeting or an entirely different strategy.



The question is always:



What is the client trying to achieve, and what do we need to do to get there?



This is not a junior position



You should already know what you're doing.



We're looking for someone with at least 3 years of relevant digital/performance marketing experience who can contribute knowledge and ideas from the beginning.



You should not need to be taught the fundamentals of paid advertising.



In your area of expertise, we actually want you to know more than we do.



We want to be able to say:



“Here is the client. Here is their goal. Here is the budget and the situation. What do you think we should do?”



We will discuss strategy together, challenge ideas and make decisions together.



But over time, you should be able to take increasing ownership without needing someone involved in every audience, headline, campaign structure or optimisation decision.



Your input matters.



Your main responsibility: performance marketing



Paid media and performance marketing will be the core of your role.

LinkedIn Ads

Ad copy and headlines

Basic creative production

Landing-page optimisation

Tracking and performance analysis



You should be particularly strong with LinkedIn Ads and Meta Ads.



You should also understand Google Ads and be able to work with the platform, although we are not specifically looking for a Google Ads specialist.



Knowing where to click inside an advertising platform is not enough.



We care much more about whether you understand:



Why an offer should work

How it should be positioned

Which audiences should see it

What should be tested

What the data is telling us

Why performance is changing

What to do when something isn't working

How to turn advertising spend into the result the client actually wants

Landing pages and broader marketing work



Because we are still a growing company, this will naturally be a broader role than working inside Ads Manager all day.



You should be comfortable helping with landing pages and occasional website work.



Most landing-page work will currently be done in Webflow.



WordPress experience is useful, but it is not currently a requirement.



You may also occasionally help with:



Canva creatives

Ad copy

Headlines

Simple graphic content

AI-assisted content

Minor website changes

Occasional simple video content



You are not expected to be a professional graphic designer, video editor and web developer at the same time.



Your primary job is still marketing and performance.



Tracking and analytics



You should understand the fundamentals of proper tracking.



Experience with areas such as the following is expected:



GA4

Google Tag Manager

LinkedIn Insight Tag

Meta Pixel

Conversion events

UTM tracking

Basic attribution

Performance reporting



You don't need to be an analytics engineer.



But if you're responsible for performance, you need to understand whether the data you're making decisions from can actually be trusted.



Who we're looking for



You should have:



3+ years of relevant experience

Strong hands-on paid advertising experience

Demonstrated experience generating measurable results

Experience working with Western companies

Preferably experience with European companies or European markets

Strong written and spoken English

Strong strategic thinking

The ability to work independently

Good judgement

Ownership of your work

Reliable communication

The ability to explain why you made a decision

A reliable computer

A reliable internet connection



We will pay for the software, systems and tools required to perform your work.



You are not expected to personally pay for company software.



We want to see what you've actually done



Years of experience alone don't tell us very much.



If possible, we would like to see examples of previous campaigns, strategies or client work.



You don't need to disclose confidential client information.



We are interested in questions such as:



What was the client's objective?

What was the approximate advertising budget?

Which platforms did you use?

What strategy did you choose?

Why did you choose it?

What wasn't working?

What did you change?

What happened afterwards?

What results did you achieve?

What would you do differently today?



We care more about understanding how you think than seeing an impressive screenshot without context.



How we work

Results over performative busyness



We care about:



Outcomes, ownership and deadlines rather than activity for activity's sake.



We are not interested in monitoring whether someone appears online every minute of the working day.



We are interested in whether:



The work is completed properly

Deadlines are respected

Client budgets are respected

Performance is moving in the right direction

Problems are communicated early

You take responsibility for your work



Freedom comes with responsibility.



As trust and results increase, so will your autonomy.



Mistakes are allowed



People make mistakes.



That is part of working.



A mistake itself is not necessarily the problem.



What matters is what happens afterwards.



When something goes wrong, we want to understand:



What happened?

Why did it happen?

How do we fix it?

How do we make sure the same mistake doesn't keep happening?



What we do not want is a problem being hidden until the last possible moment.



If you are stuck, need something, can't complete something, don't understand something or believe something is going wrong:



Say it early.



Most problems are much easier to solve before they become emergencies.



Honest communication



We value honesty and respectful disagreement.



If you believe an idea is bad, say so.



Explain why.



We do not want someone who simply agrees with everything.



At the same time, we follow a simple principle:



Disagree and commit.



We can disagree openly while discussing a decision.



But once a decision has been made, we both commit to it and do our best to make it succeed — even if one of us originally preferred another option.



Respect goes both ways.



AI is welcome



You are welcome to use AI.



We actively believe AI can help with:



Research

Copywriting

Brainstorming

Analysis

Creative ideas

Production

Improving workflows



Use it when it makes your work better or faster.



But you still own the final output.



“AI generated it” is not an excuse for poor-quality work.



Client portfolio



We believe in quality over account volume.



The goal is not to give one marketer 40–50 clients and ask them to keep everything alive.



The number of clients you manage will depend on factors such as:



Complexity

Advertising spend

Required workload

Strategy

Creative requirements

Landing-page work

Reporting requirements



A large account may require significantly more attention than several smaller accounts.



We will therefore manage workload based on what is realistically required to do good work.



Working arrangement

First 3 months



The role starts as a freelance engagement.



Expected workload:



Approximately 25–30 hours per week.



Monthly compensation:



DKK 4,000 per month



Currently approximately ₱38,900 per month, depending on exchange rates.



The initial period allows both sides to determine whether the collaboration works well.



If it clearly isn't working, neither side is expected to continue simply to reach the end of the three months.



Availability during the initial period



During the first months, while we learn how to work together, we expect you to normally be reachable when needed between:



09:00–12:00 Danish time



We understand the time difference and there can be reasonable flexibility.



As we become comfortable working together, the arrangement can become increasingly asynchronous.



Longer term, communication may primarily consist of messages and a regular weekly meeting.



The general expectation will be that messages requiring a response are normally answered no later than the next working day.



Full-time opportunity



If the initial collaboration works well for both sides, the intention is to transition the role into full-time employment through an Employer of Record (EOR) in the Philippines.



This would normally happen after approximately three months.



Expected full-time workload will normally be around:



40 hours per week.



We care more about quality, responsibility and results than unnecessarily tracking every individual hour.



Once transitioned to full-time employment, this will be an exclusive position.



You should therefore only apply if you would genuinely be willing and able to stop other ongoing client work and work full-time with us if the permanent position is offered.



Compensation progression

Initial freelance period



First approximately 3 months:



DKK 4,000/month



Approximately ₱38,900/month at current exchange rates.



Approximately 25–30 hours per week.



Full-time employment



After a successful initial period and transition to EOR employment:



DKK 4,500 gross/month



Currently approximately ₱43,800 gross/month, depending on exchange rates.



Performance bonus



After approximately 6 months, you will become eligible for a performance-based bonus, paid quarterly.



Your bonus will be directly connected to the results generated across the client portfolio you are responsible for.



The purpose is simple:



Better measurable performance should create better compensation.



The bonus will be based on the measurable results of the client accounts you are responsible for, rather than simply on the number of campaigns launched or tasks completed.



This may include factors such as lead quality, cost efficiency, conversion performance, account growth and the overall value created for the client. The exact calculation will depend on the type of accounts you manage, because not every client has the same goals, budget or sales process.



The bonus is intended to reward sustained performance, not one unusually good week or a result caused by factors outside your control. We will therefore look at performance over time and take the relevant context into account.



If you consistently produce strong results, improve account performance and take on greater responsibility, the bonus can become a meaningful part of your total compensation. In other words, the role is not limited to a fixed salary where exceptional performance makes no financial difference.



The specific targets, measurement period, eligibility requirements and payment process will be explained during the hiring process before any full-time employment agreement is entered into.



Longer-term salary progression



For someone who continues performing at the expected level, takes ownership and successfully grows with the company, the planned base salary progression is:



DKK 8,000 gross/month + performance bonus



Currently approximately ₱77,800 gross/month + bonus, depending on exchange rates.



This progression is expected after approximately 12–18 months, depending on performance, responsibility and development in the role.



Growth and responsibility



We are still a growing company.



That means we cannot promise you a specific corporate job title five years from now.



What we can say is that strong performance, trust and ability can lead to significantly more responsibility.



As the company grows, there may be opportunities to:



Take ownership of larger accounts

Take responsibility for more strategy

Help shape how we approach performance marketing

Build internal processes

Potentially help guide future team members



We prefer giving capable people more freedom rather than creating unnecessary layers of bureaucracy.



Hiring process



The process will generally include:



Application

Initial interview

Discussion of your previous work and marketing approach

Selected candidates may complete a paid assessment

Final discussion and decision



The assessment will take approximately one hour and focuses on work style, personality and how you approach decisions and collaboration.



Only selected candidates who progress through the interview process will be asked to complete it.



The assessment is paid.



Don't match every requirement?



Apply anyway.



If this role sounds like you but you don't tick every single box, we'd still encourage you to apply. Strong judgement, ownership and demonstrated ability matter more to us than matching a checklist perfectly.



We are looking for someone who:



Thinks

Challenges ideas

Takes responsibility

Communicates honestly

Wants to produce genuinely good work

Wants increasing freedom as trust develops

Wants their compensation to grow alongside their contribution



If that sounds like you, we'd like to hear from you.



Important notice



Any currency conversions shown in this job posting are approximate and may change due to exchange-rate movements.



We reserve the right to correct any errors, inaccuracies or unintended omissions in this job posting.

title: Leasing Specialist
description:
Leasing



Job Type: Full-TimeWork 

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM Eastern Time, with a 30-minute break

Salary: $1,000



Leasing Job Overview:

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Leasing professional with strong lead engagement and leasing conversion experience to manage a high volume of inbound and outbound leads and guide prospective residents through the leasing funnel. The ideal candidate is a confident, high-performing communicator who can take ownership of lead engagement, respond quickly to inquiries, conduct proactive follow-ups, and consistently work toward improving lead-to-tour and lead-to-application conversion rates. This role requires someone who is comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment and can effectively manage a large volume of leads while maintaining strong customer engagement, accurate documentation, and consistent follow-up.



Key Responsibilities

Serve as a primary point of contact for prospective residents through inbound calls,
s, online inquiries, and other lead sources.

Make high-volume outbound calls to new and existing leads to maximize engagement and tour scheduling opportunities.

Respond promptly to new leads and missed calls to minimize lead loss and maximize conversion opportunities.

Proactively follow up with prospects throughout the leasing funnel to maintain engagement and move leads toward the next step.

Qualify prospective residents based on rental criteria, property availability, and overall property fit.

Clearly explain property information and the self-guided showing process to prospective residents.

Schedule and coordinate property tours with qualified prospects.

Follow up with prospects after tours to encourage completed applications.

Re-engage missed, inactive, or previously contacted leads to recover potential leasing opportunities.

Maintain accurate lead records, notes, follow-up activities, and statuses within company systems.

Use AppFolio, Rently, and Zillow to manage, track, and engage with prospective residents.

Collaborate with the APM and Marketing teams to ensure accurate information regarding property availability, listings, and lead follow-up.

Monitor individual performance and identify opportunities to improve lead engagement and conversion results.

Manage a high-volume lead pipeline while maintaining professionalism, responsiveness, and quality interactions.

Performance Expectations: Success in this role will be measured primarily by lead engagement and conversion performance, including:

Leads successfully engaged and followed up with

Leads converted to scheduled property tours

Tours converted to completed applications

Speed and consistency of lead response and follow-up

Effective recovery of missed or previously unresponsive leads

Overall lead engagement and conversion performance



Required Skills & Qualifications

Proven experience in lead engagement, leasing, leasing conversion, inside sales, or a similar high-volume customer-facing role

Demonstrated ability to manage a high volume of leads and calls

Strong hands-on experience with AppFolio required

Experience with Rently required

Experience with Zillow required

Strong inbound and outbound calling experience

Excellent phone presence with the ability to build rapport quickly with prospective residents

Strong verbal and written communication skills

Goal-oriented with a strong focus on performance, conversion, and results

Highly organized with strong follow-up discipline

Strong attention to detail and accurate documentation skills

Ability to prioritize and manage multiple leads simultaneously

Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of lead engagement activities

Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume, performance-driven environment



Preferred Qualifications

Experience in a residential property management or leasing environment

Proven track record of strong lead-to-tour or lead-to-application conversion performance

Experience with missed-call recovery and lead re-engagement

Familiarity with other property management or lead engagement platforms



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Marketing Operations & Content Coordinator
description:
About the Role

InvestNJoy Capital is a Texas-based real estate investment company focused primarily on multifamily investments. We are building a more sophisticated investor marketing, communications and capital formation platform.

We already have support for advanced CRM architecture, GoHighLevel automation and systems

development. This role is different. We are looking for an exceptionally organized, resourceful person with excellent written and spoken English who can help us execute the marketing, content, research and day-to-day work required to keep the system moving.

You may receive:

1  A five-minute voice note from one of the principals.

2 A meeting transcript.

3 Rough bullet points.

4 An existing investor report.

5 A list of contacts that needs to be researched.

6 A marketing campaign that needs to be loaded into GoHighLevel.

7 A newsletter that needs to be drafted and scheduled.

8 A long video that needs to become several shorter pieces of content.

Your job is to take incomplete inputs and turn them into organized, finished work. We are not looking for someone who needs every task explained step by step.

We want someone who can understand the objective, use AI and other tools intelligently, ask good questions when necessary, and get things done.

Exceptional English Is Required

This is one of the most important qualifications for the position.

1 Communicate comfortably in spoken English with U.S.-based executives.

2 Understand nuanced business conversations and instructions.

3 Write professional
s and newsletters.

4 Turn rough thoughts into clear written communication.

5 Edit AI-generated writing so it sounds natural and credible.

6 Recognize when content sounds generic, overly promotional or obviously AI-generated.

Much of our audience consists of successful business owners, executives, professionals and sophisticated real estate investors. Our communication needs to reflect that.

Primary Responsibilities

Content & Executive Communication

1 Turn voice notes, meeting transcripts, rough notes and ideas from company leadership into polished content.

2 Draft investor
s and newsletters.

3 Draft LinkedIn posts and other social content.

4 Repurpose longer content into multiple shorter pieces.

5 Assist with investor updates and educational content.

6 Edit AI-generated writing extensively before it is used.

7 Maintain a content calendar.

8 Help develop a consistent voice for the company and its principals.

Marketing Operations

1 Build and schedule
 campaigns.

2 Load content into GoHighLevel and other marketing systems.

3 Maintain marketing calendars and campaign schedules.

4 Coordinate landing pages, forms,
s, graphics and other campaign assets.

5 Test links, forms,
s and workflows before launch.

6 Track whether campaigns and projects were actually completed.

7 Follow up on unfinished items without needing to be reminded.

CRM & Database Operations

You do not need to be an advanced GoHighLevel developer. We will have technical support for advanced CRM architecture and automation. You should, however, be comfortable learning and operating a CRM.

1 Update and maintain contact information.

2 Apply appropriate fields, tags and segmentation.

3 Manage lists.

4 Upload and clean contact data.

5 Identify duplicates and incomplete records.

6 Maintain follow-up information.

7 Support investor and prospect pipelines.

8 Load
 and nurture content into existing workflows.

9 Test automations after they are built.

GoHighLevel experience is helpful, but advanced GHL experience is NOT required. We would rather hire an exceptional communicator and operator who can learn GoHighLevel than an advanced GHL technician who cannot write or communicate well.

Research & Data Enrichment

1 Research prospective investors, family offices, RIAs, capital partners and referral relationships.

2 Find and verify company and contact information.

3 Research organizations and investment criteria.

4 Enrich CRM records.

5 Build prospect and research lists.

6 Organize information in spreadsheets.

7 Use AI and research tools intelligently to accelerate this work.

Social Media & Basic Creative Work

1 Schedule and publish approved content.

2 Create professional basic graphics in Canva.

 marketing platforms

Schedule

We are based in Texas on U.S. Central Time. We need approximately 3-4 hours of daily overlap during the U.S. morning, with the remaining work able to be completed during Philippine working hours.

Compensation

Approximately $900-$1,200 USD per month, depending on experience, English communication,

demonstrated skill and schedule.

Exceptional candidates may command more. We are willing to pay more for someone whose work genuinely

saves executive time and consistently produces high-quality output.

Raw Notes From the Company Principal

We have not purchased another apartment property recently, and that’s intentional. There have certainly been properties available to buy, but owning more real estate isn’t automatically the same thing as creating value. Over the last couple of years, financing costs increased, insurance and property taxes became more expensive, and in a lot of markets seller expectations took longer to adjust than property-level performance. We’ve continued looking at opportunities, but we’d rather miss a deal than force one that doesn’t compensate investors appropriately for the risk. At the same time, we are investing significantly in our own infrastructure around investor relationships, technology, CRM and capital formation so that when the right opportunity does appear, we’re better prepared to move quickly and execute. We think the next phase of the market will create opportunities for disciplined buyers, but patience matters.

The audience is prospective and existing real estate investors.

1 Sound like it was written by a real business principal.

2 Be confident but not promotional.

3 Do not invent facts.

4 Do not sound like generic AI marketing copy.

5 Have a clear central message.

There is no single correct answer. We care much more about your judgment and finished writing than about which AI tool you used.

We are looking for someone who wants to become an important long-term member of a growing company. If you are exceptionally organized, communicate extremely well and enjoy turning ideas into finished work, we’d like to hear from you.

description:
Lead our visual identity and elevate our brand’s online presence when you join our team as a Senior Graphic Designer!



In this role, you’ll shape the visual narrative of our brand, using your creative vision and strategic thinking to design compelling graphics that captivate our audience and drive engagement.



We are an Amazon focused E- commerce company, selling products in the home & kitchen niche. We are looking for a creative and senior designer that has experience in designing all aspects involved in the business, and has a keen eye on designing listings that convert and sell. 



Key Responsibilities:

1. Own all visual design work for the brand across the Amazon ecosystem, including:

- Product listing images (main images, infographics, lifestyle renders, comparison charts)

- A+ Content and Brand Story modules

- Amazon Storefront design and updates

- Packaging design (box, inserts, labels, etc.)



2.Continuously audit and optimise visual assets by taking initiative to A/B test main images, infographics, and other creative elements to improve CTR and conversion rates.



3. Take direction from performance data and feedback to proactively iterate and improve designs across all ASINs.



4. Collaborate closely with marketing, product, and copywriting teams to ensure brand alignment across all visuals.



5. Translate product features and benefits into compelling, on-brand visual stories tailored for Amazon shoppers.



6. Stay current on Amazon design best practices, marketplace trends, and competitor visuals.



7. Use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney, Firefly) to speed up ideation, generate creative variations, or support design development.



8. Manage and organise all brand assets, ensuring consistency and proper file handling.



9. Maintain a high standard of quality control and attention to detail in all outputs.



10. Work efficiently on multiple projects in a fast-paced environment while meeting deadlines.



Essential Skills and Requirements:

- Proven experience as a Graphic Designer in an eCommerce environment, with a strong focus on the Amazon Marketplace (listings, A+ content, Brand Story, packaging, etc.).

- A strong, versatile portfolio showcasing a range of design styles—must include Amazon-specific work.

- Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, especially Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.

- Excellent communication skills and the ability to clearly present and explain design concepts and decisions.

- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high-quality output.

- Meticulous attention to detail, with a strong sense of visual consistency, typography, layout, and design systems.

- Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, Firefly, or other AI-assisted platforms to support design ideation, content generation, or image creation.

- Experience with e-commerce platforms (e.g., Amazon Seller Central) and content management systems is a plus.



In order to apply, please do the following:

1. Mention the word 'PURPLE' at the beginning of your message/application - this will show us that you actually read this entire job post.

2. Send us your most recent work that you are proud of. This must be either an Amazon Listing that you designed, A+ content, packaging, or something along the lines of this. 

3. Confirm in your message to us that you are comfortable working UK Hours. Our team is UK based. While we have some flexibility, the core working hours will be around UK hours. 

4. Confirm you are ok with conducting trial tasks within 2-3 working days of us sending them to you. 

5 After the Trial tasks, you will have a video interview with our 2 founders. 

6. Outline in your application if you are comfortable using AI tools too and if you are already using in your day to day work.



Salary is negotiable depending on skills and experience.



Thank you and we look forward to your application!

title: ACCOUNT MANAGER & CLIENT OPERATIONS LEAD
description:
At Ascendia Group, our core thesis is simple: AI runs our operations; humans own our high-trust relationships. We specialize in digital growth for elite clinical and dental practices across North America. By leveraging automated systems, AI execution models, and data synthesis, we free our team from administrative busywork so they can focus on high-touch client management, strategic leadership, and rapid execution.



Role Overview



We are seeking an Account Manager & Client Operations Lead who combines high strategic quality judgment, exceptional client empathy, strong copywriting skills, and rigorous operational discipline.



In this role, you will take ownership of day-to-day client communications, act as a project manager enforcing deliverable calendars across remote specialists, write and review website/email content, enforce strict pre-launch QA gates, and serve as the core operational buffer for executive leadership.



Key Responsibilities



Client Account Ownership & Communications: Act as the primary point of contact for dental/clinical accounts via WhatsApp,
, and scheduled video calls. Lead client onboarding from contract sign-off to campaign launch. Review AI-generated monthly reporting narratives and deliver polished client updates. Act as first responder for routine client inquiries and requests.



Project Management & Deliverable Scheduling: Maintain and own a centralized master calendar tracking every client deliverable, milestone, and campaign launch. Proactively follow up with web developers, SEO specialists, copywriters, and ad managers to ensure on-time delivery.



Website Content Development,
 Marketing & Content QA: Draft and refine website copy, landing page messaging, and
 sequences aligned with client brand voice. Serve as the quality editor for all website copy, ensuring messaging accuracy, conversion focus, and zero errors before going live.



Operational Intake & Multi-Jurisdictional QA Gates: Enforce strict "Build-Ready" intake standards (requiring 100% complete assets before assigning work to tech teams). Oversee quality checks and AI linter pipelines for dental/healthcare advertising compliance (ADA, RCDSO, HIPAA, PIPEDA) and platform policy standards (Google Ads Healthcare & Meta Advertising Standards).



Team Coordination & Workflow Discipline: Maintain daily Trello board pipeline accuracy across Web Dev, SEO/GBP, Paid Ads, and Creative teams. Ensure every assigned card contains explicit acceptance criteria.



Leadership Support & Other Duties: Execute additional operational, administrative, content, or project management tasks as assigned per leadership to support agency growth and founder extraction.



Qualifications & Core Capabilities



3+ Years Agency Experience: Proven track record as an Account Manager, Client Delivery Lead, Copywriter/Content Specialist, or Agency Operations Specialist in a remote digital marketing agency.



Content & Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal English communication. Hands-on experience drafting website copy,
 marketing sequences, and editorial reviewing.



Project Management Discipline: Demonstrated ability to build master client calendars, track deliverables, and hold remote team members accountable to deadlines.



Healthcare & Ad Policy Familiarity: Familiarity with North American dental advertising regulations, patient privacy rules (HIPAA/PIPEDA), and healthcare ad policy restrictions on Google and Meta.



AI-Native Mindset: High comfort working alongside AI-driven operations (using Claude, ChatGPT, etc., for narrative drafting, workflow automation, and quality checks).



Platform Proficiency: Experience using GoHighLevel (GHL), Trello, WordPress, Agency Analytics, CallRail, Google Workspace, WhatsApp, and Zoom.



Flexibility & Availability: Core availability during EST operating hours, with flexibility to handle occasional time-sensitive client communications via
 or WhatsApp when required.



Probation & Progression Terms



90-Day Probationary Period: This role begins with a 90-day probationary period to evaluate workflow fit, communication responsiveness, deliverable execution, and quality control.



Performance Review & Pathway: Upon successful completion of the 90-day probation, a formal performance review will be conducted to evaluate transitioning to a full-time role (40 hours/week), expanding your account portfolio, and revising compensation accordingly.



How to Apply & Submission Guidelines



To be considered for this role, please submit your application with the following two requirements:

Applications submitted without an intro video link will be automatically ignored.

We are seeking an organized, detail driven Virtual Assistant to handle foreclosure and REO tasking across multiple client portals. Accuracy is crucial in this role. This position supports properties from assignment through closing and requires strong follow through, deadline management, and the ability to work independently within structured systems. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in portals, following task checklists, and maintaining compliance without constant oversight.



Primary responsibilities include completing all required tasks in REO and foreclosure portals, maintaining daily updates and status changes, monitoring deadlines and escalation requirements, and accurately uploading documents, photos, bids, and reports. You will be responsible for maintaining compliance across all client instructions and identifying missing or incorrect items before they become issues. This role also includes coordinating with field staff and vendors, ordering inspections, occupancy checks, preservation services, and repair bids, and following up as needed. Inspections and bids must be reviewed for completeness and obvious discrepancies before submission. You will assist with BPO tasking and organization, including managing photos, comparable data, and required documentation.



Additional responsibilities include coordinating utility turn ons and shut offs, requesting HOA payoff statements and resale disclosures, assisting with title related items such as deeds, tax information, and lien data, supporting MLS data entry and updates when needed, and maintaining accurate internal records and tracking.
