title: Customer Service and Scheduling Coordinator
description:
Customer Service & Scheduling Coordinator

Just Right Electric — Greater Phoenix, AZ It's just right, every time.





About Us

Just Right Electric is a family-owned electrical service company serving the Greater Phoenix area. We're licensed and bonded, we take extreme pride in our work, and our team is built of like-minded people on the same growth-mindset path. We invest in training, we run on real systems, and we expect everyone here to keep getting better.



We're looking for a reliable, organized, goal-driven, fluent English-speaking Customer Service & Scheduling Coordinator to be the first voice our customers hear.



This is the most important seat in the company. When someone calls us, they're either stressed — the power is out, a breaker keeps tripping, something smells hot, or they are ready for their next home update. How you handle that call d
 whether they trust us with their home.





What You'll Own:

On the phone-



Answer incoming calls promptly and professionally, following our intake form on every call

Make stressed customers feel heard, calm, and taken care of

Book the call using an assumptive close, not a "would you like to schedule?"



On the schedule-



Schedule and coordinate service appointments around technician availability and drive time

Communicate schedule changes, cancellations, and job updates to both customers and technicians

Coordinate with techs so schedules and job details are always accurate.



On the pipeline-



Follow up on every new lead and track every response — nothing goes cold

Track and reconcile leads from Google Local Services Ads (LSA), Thumbtack, and other sources

Maintain the sales/lead pipeline so no opportunity is missed

Follow up with customers after completed services.



In Housecall Pro (HCP)-



Create and manage customers, jobs, appointments, notes, and schedules

Keep lead sources, customer records, and job statuses accurate and current

Follow company SOPs and keep clean records.





What We're Looking For:

Required



Fluent English — clear speech, strong phone etiquette, proper grammar in writing

Empathy and patience, especially with customers dealing with urgent electrical issues

Strong organizational and multitasking skills; detail-oriented under pressure

Reliable, proactive, and able to work independently without being chased

Comfortable learning and using scheduling, CRM, and communication software

Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, and a quality headset (remote applicants)



A Plus:



Housecall Pro (HCP) experience

Customer service, scheduling, dispatch, or home-services/electrical industry background

Experience managing leads from Thumbtack, Google LSA, or similar platforms



The Right Person:



Can answer the phone with confidence, make customers feel heard and taken care of, keep the schedule organized, follow up on every lead, keep Housecall Pro accurate, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. If you need someone standing over you to do that, this isn't the right fit — and that's okay.





How to Apply:

Read this part carefully. Incomplete applications are not reviewed. We'd rather see one thorough application than fifty quick ones — and how you handle these instructions tells us most of what we need to know.



Send all four items: 



CSR Application — [Your Full Name]

1. Your Resume

PDF preferred.

2. Two Voice Recordings (Required)

Record yourself out loud answering two mock customer calls, using the Just Right Electric Intake Form below. Speak the customer's part and your part, or have a friend read the customer lines — either is fine. Just don't read it silently or type it out.



Audio or video both work. MP3, M4A, or a private/unlisted video link. 2–4 minutes each.



Start each recording by saying your full name and which call it is.



Call #1 — "My house has no power." A homeowner calls. The power is out in their whole house. They're frustrated and a little scared. Work the intake form: get their information, ask the safety questions, cover the trip charge, and book the call.



Call #2 — "I want an EV charger installed." A homeowner just bought an electric vehicle and wants a charger installed in their garage. They want to know "how much." Work the intake form: gather what our estimator needs, cover the trip charge, and book the visit.



We're listening for: tone and warmth, clear English, whether you actually follow the form, how you handle the price question, whether you ask about safety on Call #1, and whether you ask for the booking instead of hoping for it.



We are not listening for electrical knowledge. You don't need to know a thing about electricity to nail these — you need to follow the form and take care of the person on the other end.

3. Five-Point Essay (Required)

Write a five-point essay — one clear section per point, roughly 150–250 words each — covering:



Why we should hire you. What specifically do you bring to this seat?

Why you're a good fit for our team. We're family-owned, growth-minded, and direct with each other. Where do you fit in that?

A time you turned an upset customer around. What happened, what you did, and how it ended.

How you stay organized. Walk us through your actual system for making sure nothing falls through the cracks when 20 things are moving at once.

What "growth mindset" means to you. Give us a real example of something you've worked to get better at — and what you want to get better at next.



Write it yourself. We read a lot of these, and AI-written essays are obvious and get set aside.

4. Three Quick Answers

Your availability and time zone



Housecall Pro experience: yes / no / some — be honest, we'll train

What Happens Next

Strong applications get a live phone interview. We move fast on the right person.





Just Right Electric — Customer Intake Form

Use this on both recordings. Follow it top to bottom.

Step 1 — Greeting

"Thank you for calling Just Right Electric, this is [your name] — who do I have the pleasure of speaking with today?"

Step 2 — Let Them Tell You What's Going On

Ask, then listen. Don't interrupt. Take notes.



"Okay [name], tell me what's going on."



Then confirm it back so they know you heard them:



"So what I'm hearing is [repeat it back] — did I get that right?"?"



Step 3 — The Trip Charge (First 30 Seconds — Don't Bury It)

Say it upfront, calm and certain. No apologizing, no softening.



"[Name], I want to be upfront with you so there are no surprises. To get a licensed electrician and a fully stocked truck out to your door, there's a $99 trip charge. That covers getting us there. If any diagnostic work is needed to find the problem, your electrician will quote you that separately and get your okay before he touches anything. And if you move forward with the repair, that $99 comes right off your job. Fair enough?"



Handle the pushback, then move straight to booking. Never negotiate the trip charge.

Step 4 — Book It (Assumptive Close — Give Two Choices)

"Great — I've got [today/tomorrow] between [window] or [next day] between [window]. Which works better for you?"



Do not ask "would you like to schedule?" Give the two choices and book it.

Step 5 — Customer Information

Full name

Best callback number (confirm by repeating it back)

 address (spell it back)

Service address + gate/cross street/access notes

Home or business? Own or rent?

Preferred contact method

Step 6 — Job Details

For a "No Power" call, also ask:



Is the power out in the whole house, or just part of it?

Do your neighbors have power? (Utility outage vs. our problem)

Have you looked at your breaker panel? Is the main breaker tripped or off?

Any GFCI outlets with a tripped "reset" button — garage, bathrooms, kitchen, outside?

Did anything happen right before it went out — a storm, a new appliance, a big load, any work done recently?

Anyone in the home who's medically dependent on power?

How old is the home? Do you know your panel brand or size?



For an "EV Charger" call, also ask:



What vehicle — year, make, and model?

Do you already have the charger, or do you need us to supply one? Which brand/model?

Where do you want it — garage, driveway, carport? Inside or outside?

Roughly how far is that spot from your electrical panel?

Single-story or two-story? Is the panel inside or outside?

Are you in an HOA, and is this a house, condo, or townhome?

What's your timeline — is the vehicle already here?



Then set the expectation and book:



"Perfect. EV charger installs are custom to your home, so we'll send a licensed electrician out to look at your panel and the run to your parking spot, and he'll build you a written estimate on site — options and pricing, all in writing before anything gets done."

Step 7 — Lead Source (Never Skip This)

"One last thing — how did you hear about us?" Google / Google LSA / Thumbtack / Referral (who?) / Repeat customer / Yard sign / Truck / Social / Other

Step 8 — Confirm & Set Expectations

"Alright [name], I've got you down for [day, date, window] at [address]. You'll get a confirmation text and
, and your electrician will call or text when he's on his way. Is there anything else going on at the house you want him to look at while he's there?"



Close warm:



"You're all set, [name]. Thanks for calling Just Right Electric — we'll take good care of you."







Just Right Electric | 
 | (623)
| 

Licensed & Insured

It's just right, every time.

Mental Health Prescribing of Ohio is a trauma-focused group practice in Montgomery, Ohio, with psychiatric services provided. We're hiring a virtual medical assistant to support our psychiatric nurse practitioners with prior authorizations, medication refills, and clinical documentation. This is a clinical support role, not a general VA position. You'll work closely with our NPs daily.

Prior authorizations

Medication refills

EHR documentation and chart maintenance

Keep charts current and clean in IntakeQ.



Patient messaging

Direct new patients to schedule online. Triage portal messages: route clinical questions to the NP, handle non-clinical ones directly.



Lab order tracking

Order labs, follow up on results, flag anything abnormal for the NP.



Pharmacy coordination

Resolve discrepancies, refill requests, and formulary issues directly with pharmacies.

- Must have hands-on experience with with our EHR, IntakeQ. This isn't negotiable. If you haven't used IntakeQ, please don't apply.

- Must have previously worked in this exact role — prior auths, refills, and care plan support for a psychiatric or behavioral health practice. We're not able to train someone into this role.

- Previous experience in psychiatric or behavioral health specifically. General medical assistant experience isn't a substitute.  You should already be comfortable with psych medications, refill protocols, and the prior auth process for behavioral health.

- Excellent written and spoken English

title: Short-Form Content Creator - TikTok / Reels / Shorts | Plix.GG
description:
Plix.gg is a browser gaming platform with 72,000+ games and 300K+ monthly visitors.



We're looking for a creator who genuinely understands TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, what people are watching, what formats are trending, what sounds are being used and how to turn an idea into a video people actually want to finish.



This is NOT an editing-only role.



You will research trends, find ideas, choose games, record gameplay or real-world footage and edit finished short-form videos.



We handle uploading and posting. You do not need to manage our social accounts.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who actively uses TikTok, Reels and Shorts and pays attention to:



• Current content trends and formats

• Trending music and sounds

• Hooks that stop people scrolling

• Editing styles that are working right now

• Gaming and internet culture

• What other gaming creators are doing

• Why some videos perform and others don't





You should actively research what is currently working and develop concepts independently.

Most importantly, you need good creative judgment.

Not every browser game is interesting enough to carry a video by itself.

Sometimes gameplay is enough.

Sometimes the stronger video is built around a gaming setup, laptop, phone, IRL situation, meme, challenge, POV, trend or relatable idea.



→ Your job is to know the difference.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ CONTENT CAN INCLUDE



• Single-game videos

• Multi-game videos and lists

• Gameplay

• Challenges

• Memes

• POVs

• Gaming setup / desk setup videos

• Laptop, monitor and phone footage

• Gaming room / RGB setup footage

• IRL videos filmed at home, schools, cafés, malls, outdoors, etc.

• Voiceover or no voiceover

• Trend-based concepts

• Videos built around a joke, situation or trend instead of only gameplay



If you have a good-looking gaming setup, desk, room, laptop or another visually interesting environment, we want you to use it.



For example:



→ Open with a good-looking gaming setup

→ Hook: "3 browser games I play when I'm bored"

→ Transition into the games



We want variety.



We do NOT want the same template repeated every day. But we can try good templates that did not work more times.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ WHAT YOU DO



• Research TikTok, Reels and Shorts for trends, formats, sounds and ideas

• Follow gaming creators and relevant competitors

• Find games on Plix.gg worth making content about

• Develop your own concepts and hooks

• D
 whether a video should be gameplay, IRL, setup-based, meme, POV, challenge, list, trend or another format

• Record clean gameplay

• Film attractive real-world or gaming-setup footage when needed

• Edit 10–40 second short-form videos

• Choose suitable music, trending sounds and SFX

• Add captions and on-screen text

• Test different opening hooks

• Use performance feedback from previous videos to improve future concepts



You do not need to show your face or use your own voice.



You can if you want to, but it is not required.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ OUTPUT



5–7 finished videos per week.

Videos can vary significantly in format and production effort.

Some can be simple gameplay videos.

title: Credentialing Specialist
description:
## About the role



We are a growing physician-owned pain management group operating multiple clinic locations and an ambulatory surgery center. We need an experienced credentialing professional to own the full provider credentialing lifecycle — not a generalist VA who will learn credentialing on the job.



This is a detail-heavy, follow-up-driven role. Applications sit in payer queues for months, licenses expire quietly, and a single missing signature can hold up an entire enrollment. The person who succeeds here is relentless about chasing paperwork and keeps meticulous records without being asked.



## What you'll do



**Primary source verification and background screening**

- Verify state medical licenses, DEA registrations, and controlled substance registrations directly with issuing boards

- Run and document NPDB queries, OIG/LEIE and 
 exclusion checks, and board certification verification (ABMS/AOA)

- Verify education, training, and complete employment history — including obtaining written explanations for any gaps

- Coordinate criminal background checks, drug screens, and reference/peer review letters

- Confirm malpractice claims history and maintain current certificates of insurance



**Credentialing and enrollment**

- Prepare, submit, and track initial credentialing and re-credentialing applications

- Maintain CAQH ProView profiles, including quarterly attestations and document re-uploads

- Manage Medicare (PECOS), Medicaid/AHCCCS, and commercial payer enrollments, revalidations, and demographic updates

- Maintain accurate NPPES/NPI records, group affiliations, and payer rosters across all locations

- Track application status weekly and escalate stalled files with documented follow-up



**Ambulatory surgery center support**

- Build and maintain medical staff credentialing files for the ASC, including initial appointment and biennial reappointment packets

- Ensure files meet accreditation and Medicare Conditions for Coverage standards (AAAHC, Joint Commission, or AAAASF)

- Prepare credentialing packets for medical executive committee and governing body review

- Maintain privilege delineation forms and current privilege rosters



**Expirables and data integrity**

- Maintain a master expirables tracker (licenses, DEA, BLS/ACLS, COI, board certification, attestations) with advance reminders at 120/90/60/30 days

- Keep provider demographic information consistent across all payers, directories, the practice management system, and internal rosters

- Produce a weekly status report showing what's pending, what's blocked, and what's expiring



**Follow-up**

- Call and
 payers, licensing boards, prior employers, and schools to chase outstanding items

- Follow up with our own providers to collect signatures, documents, and responses

- Log every contact — date, person, reference number, outcome, next step



## Requirements



- **2+ years of hands-on US provider credentialing experience** (please state the number of providers you have credentialed and for what type of organization)

- **Direct experience credentialing at or for an ambulatory surgery center** — this is required, not preferred

- Working knowledge of CAQH, PECOS, NPPES, and at least one payer portal (Availity, Navinet, or similar)

- Familiarity with credentialing software (Modio, Verifiable, MD-Staff, IntelliSoft, Symplr, or comparable)

- Excellent written and spoken English — you will be on the phone with US payers and licensing boards

- HIPAA training and a signed confidentiality/business associate agreement

- Strong, quiet home office: reliable computer, minimum 25 Mbps internet, backup internet, backup power (UPS or generator), noise-cancelling headset

- Comfortable working independently with weekly check-ins rather than daily supervision



## Nice to have



- CPCS or CPMSM certification

- Experience with Arizona payers (AHCCCS, BCBSAZ, Banner, Health Net Access, Mercy Care)

- Experience with pain management, anesthesia, or surgical specialty credentialing

- Experience building a credentialing tracker from scratch



## How to apply



Applications that don't follow these instructions won't be reviewed.



1. Start your message with the word **PRIVILEGES** so we know you read the posting.

2. In 3–5 sentences, describe the most difficult credentialing file you've worked on and how you resolved it.

3. Tell us: how many providers have you credentialed, at what type of facility, and which credentialing software you used.

4. List your available hours in Arizona time and your monthly rate expectation.

5. Attach or link your resume.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief paid skills exercise (reviewing a sample provider file and identifying what's missing or expired) and a video interview.

title: SEO Associate
description:
THIS IS A SALARIED, EMPLOYEE OF RECORD OPPORTUNITY



WHAT TO EXPECT:

Wonderist Agency is a full-service marketing agency that supports 1,000+ dentists around the country. We pride ourselves on ditching the old fashioned marketing model of stock photos and templated sites. We strive to tell our clients' stories with bespoke brands, impactful photo and video shoots, and stunning website design (Here is a great example of our work: 
)

We're a team of over 70+ passionate marketers headquartered in sunny San Diego, with a growing global team. While many companies simply check the required boxes when it comes to culture, a well-balanced team and positive office culture has been the core of our success from the start. We are a social team at heart, and that is one constant that hasn't changed with all the movement this economy and industry has seen. We genuinely enjoy spending time together, and we work hard to make sure that's true whether you're in the office or across the world.

We celebrate new ideas and prioritize a culture of trust and respect where team members can grow and take risks. Each quarter we host events under our four cultural pillars; health & wellness, personal & professional development, social good, and social. We are proud to have been named one of San Diego Business Journal's Best Places to Work in 2018, 2021, 2022 and 2023, made the Inc 5000 Regionals Fastest Growing Companies 2021, 2022 and 2024, made the San Diego Business Journal's Fastest Growing Private Companies list in 2019, 2020, 2022, and 2023, made the Inc Best Workplaces list in 2024 and made the Inc. 5000 for the last 5 years (
)!

If you work at Wonderist, you likely enjoy a challenge, appreciate autonomy, actually care about clients, and are looking for a team that you can enjoy being part of.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The SEO Associate supports the day-to-day execution of SEO campaigns across our dental client base. Working closely with U.S.-based specialists, you'll handle tracking and analytics setup for new accounts, keyword research, on-page optimization, technical fixes, and local SEO — the hands-on, on-site work that gets campaigns launched correctly and keeps them moving.

This is a role for someone who wants to build real SEO depth. You'll work across a wide range of client sites, learn from senior specialists daily, and see the direct impact of your work in the data.

This is a fully remote role supporting a U.S.-based team. Clear, proactive written communication matters as much as technical skill.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Tracking & Analytics Setup

Set up Google Analytics 4 for new accounts — create the property and data stream, and configure conversion events for form submissions, calls, chat, and booking.

Install and configure Google Tag Manager, and confirm there is exactly one container and one property on the site.

Set up Google Search Console — verify ownership, submit the XML sitemap, request indexing, and link the property to GA4.

Verify every installation before sign-off using Tag Assistant and GA4 real-time — confirming the correct IDs are firing and events are recording.

Set up client dashboards and integrate data sources in Agency Analytics.

Troubleshooting

Diagnose tracking issues — tags not firing, events not recording, duplicate containers or properties, and conversions that stop reporting.

Investigate sudden drops in traffic or conversions to determine whether the cause is a tracking failure or a genuine performance change.

Resolve access and permission issues across Google properties, and coordinate with clients or internal teams to get what's needed.

Keyword Research & On-Page Optimization

Research and select target keywords for client websites, accounting for search intent, volume, and competitive difficulty.

Map keywords to the right pages and flag gaps where a target keyword has no page to rank.

Optimize website pages — meta titles and descriptions, header structure, and image alt text.

Build internal links that connect service pages, location pages, and existing pages in a way that reflects the site's architecture.

Technical SEO

Identify and fix basic technical issues including broken links, missing tags, duplicate content, and missing alt attributes.

Run and interpret site crawls, and flag anything beyond your scope to the assigned specialist.

Monitor indexation and crawl health in Search Console, and raise issues early.

Coordinate with web developers to implement changes that require developer access.

Local SEO

Support Google Business Profile optimization — profile fields, services, service descriptions, categories, and photos.

Maintain listing accuracy across directories and resolve sync errors or duplicate listings.

Verify business name, address, and phone details are consistent everywhere they appear.

Performance Reporting

Track keyword rankings, organic traffic, and conversions across your assigned accounts.

Share concise, regular performance updates with the U.S. team — what moved, what didn't, and what you think is behind it.

Flag meaningful declines early rather than waiting for a scheduled review.

Collaboration & Additional Responsibilities

Communicate clearly and proactively with U.S.-based team members and project leads.

Coordinate with web developers and designers to get changes implemented.

Escalate anything requiring a strategic judgment call to the assigned specialist rather than guessing.

Contribute to cross-team projects, process improvements, and new initiatives as assigned.

Take on new responsibilities and special projects as business needs evolve, with opportunities to learn and grow.

CORE COMPETENCIES:

Communication: Writes clearly, concisely, and proactively in English. Shares updates before being asked and raises blockers early.

Attention to Detail: Catches a missing meta description, a broken internal link, or a tag that isn't firing before it affects performance or data.

Technical Aptitude: Comfortable setting up and verifying tracking, reading a crawl report, and working in a CMS without hand-holding.

Process Discipline: Follows documented processes consistently, and flags when a process doesn't fit the situation.

Organization & Time Management: Handles work across multiple client accounts and deadlines without dropping threads.

SEO Fundamentals: Solid working knowledge of on-page, off-page, and technical SEO — enough to work independently on defined tasks.

Problem-Solving: Diagnoses the actual cause rather than treating the symptom, and focuses on practical, actionable solutions.

Initiative: Takes ownership of assigned accounts and looks for improvements nobody asked for.

PERSONALITY MUSTS:

Our perfect fit is someone who is a problem solver who understands the difference between “yes, and…” and “yes, but…”. You should have a hungry, scrappy personality with a positive attitude and aims to deliver. Working in the client service industry can mean going the extra mile, and we need someone who is always willing to rise to the occasion for our clients and puts forward beautiful work that exceeds client expectations. Someone who is detailed and organized, driven and displays vigor and comes ready to play every day. Confidence, self-discipline, and a congenial, curious mind are things we love and admire.

The ideal SEO Associate is curious, detail-oriented, and genuinely interested in why rankings move. You verify rather than assume — you'd rather spend the extra ten minutes confirming a tag is firing than trust that it is. You're comfortable working independently in a remote role, you communicate without needing to be chased, and you'd rather ask a clarifying question than ship something you weren't sure about. A positive attitude, hunger to grow, and willingness to take ownership are a must.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

1–3 years of hands-on SEO experience, agency or in-house.

Excellent written and verbal communication in English — clear, concise, and proactive.

Hands-on experience setting up Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager, including configuring conversion events.

Experience with Google Search Console setup and verification.

Working knowledge of SEO best practices across on-page, off-page, and technical.

Experience with Ahrefs and/or SEMrush.

Experience with Agency Analytics.

Experience with Webflow or a comparable CMS.

Reliable high-speed internet connection.

Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow documented processes.

BONUS POINTS FOR APPLICANTS WITH:

Basic HTML/CSS knowledge for small on-site SEO edits

Healthcare or dental marketing experience

Google Business Profile and local SEO experience

Yext, Local Viking, or listings management experience

Screaming Frog or comparable crawling tools

Schema markup experience

GoHighLevel or comparable CRM experience


 or comparable project management tooling

Experience using AI tools in an SEO workflow

description:
Job Title: STR – Guest Relations & Operations Specialist

Schedule: Monday–Thursday and Saturday, 10:00 AM–9:00 PM Eastern Time, with a 1-hour lunch.

Hours: 40–45 hours per week expected; up to 50 hours when business needs require it, with approval.

Pay: $6–$8 USD per hour depending on experience, communication ability, judgment, and property-management experience.



About Us:

Key Getaways is a premier property management firm founded by a former futures trader who traded the chaos of the Chicago markets for a passion-driven mission: creating first-class travel experiences for families. We specialize in transforming vacation rentals into high-performing assets across national markets, currently anchored in the Smoky Mountains of Tennessee. 



Our culture is built on the "family-style" values of kindness and leadership, yet we operate with the precision and scalability of a high-growth tech company. We are a lean, execution-focused team that rejects micro-management in favor of individual ownership, and we are looking for a visionary partner to help us build the systems that will support our goals.



Accountability:

1. Guest Experience Ownership

*Own guest communication from pre-arrival through checkout, including questions, concerns, complaints, and urgent issues.

*Respond quickly, professionally, and empathetically while protecting the company and property owner’s interests.

*Use sound judgment to resolve routine guest issues independently and escalate higher-risk situations with a recommended solution.

*Follow issues through to completion rather than simply handing them off.

2. Maintenance & Vendor Coordination

*Serve as the primary coordinator when a guest reports a maintenance, housekeeping, pool/hot-tub, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, lock, internet, or other property issue.

*Contact the appropriate maintenance person or vendor, clearly communicate the problem, coordinate access, and track the issue until resolved.

*Keep guests informed while work is underway and confirm the repair or service was completed successfully.

*Source new vendors when necessary and help maintain a dependable vendor network in each market.

*Identify repeat property issues and bring patterns to management’s attention.

3. Operational Ownership & Decision-Making

*Take ownership of assigned operational issues from discovery through resolution.

*Make informed decisions with limited information while balancing guest satisfaction, urgency, cost, and owner impact.

*Escalate thoughtfully with context and proposed solutions—not just problems.

*Document important i
, actions taken, vendor outcomes, and follow-up items.

4. Process Improvement & Systems

*Identify recurring guest or operational problems and recommend ways to prevent them.

*Help create and improve SOPs for guest communication, maintenance escalation, vendor dispatch, refunds/credits, and emergency situations.

*Maintain accurate notes and task tracking so another team member can quickly understand the status of an issue.

*Help improve workflows as Key Getaways grows.

5. Team Communication & Leadership Readiness

*Communicate proactively with management and other team members about urgent issues, risks, and unresolved items.

*Work effectively with cleaners, maintenance technicians, pool/hot-tub companies, handymen, and other vendors.

*Support onboarding and training of future guest-relations team members as the company grows.

*Model accountability, professionalism, urgency, and high-quality work.



Tasks:

*Monitor and respond to guest messages across Airbnb, Vrbo, direct bookings, and the property-management system.

*Handle same-day guest needs including check-in problems, access issues, missing items, cleanliness concerns, amenity questions, and property malfunctions.

*Troubleshoot issues remotely when possible and dispatch the correct vendor when on-site help is needed.

*Coordinate maintenance and vendor schedules, provide access information, and follow up until completion.

*Keep guests updated during active issues and document the final resolution.

*Review open operational tasks and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

*Communicate significant i
, potential refunds, property damage, safety concerns, or owner-impacting issues to management.

*Help identify reliable replacement vendors and obtain pricing when needed.

*Review upcoming arrivals for known property issues that could affect the next guest.

*Assist with operational projects and process improvements during lower-volume periods.



Expectations:

1. Required Traits

*Excellent written and spoken English; communication quality is critical.

*Strong ownership mentality—you see an issue through to resolution.

*Calm and professional under pressure, including when guests are upset.

*Resourceful problem solver who can make reasonable decisions independently.

*Strong follow-up skills and ability to manage several open issues at once.

*Comfortable communicating firmly but respectfully with vendors and holding them accountable.

*High attention to detail and accurate documentation.

*Reliable during scheduled hours and responsive to time-sensitive guest issues.

*Comfortable working in a fast-changing small-business environment.

*Attention to detail is mandatory: secret code = KGGROS0826

2. Leadership Mindset

*Treats guest and maintenance problems as issues to solve, not simply messages to forward.

*Looks for root causes and ways to prevent recurring problems.

*Takes initiative without waiting for step-by-step instructions.

*Can respectfully challenge a vendor, cleaner, or teammate when work is incomplete or below standard.

*Wants increased responsibility as the company and guest-relations function grow.

3. Tools (Experience Preferred, Not Required)

*Airbnb and Vrbo

*Guesty or another vacation-rental property management system

*Breezeway or similar maintenance/operations software

*Slack

*Airtable

*Google Workspace

*Dialpad or similar phone/text system

*AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude for drafting, troubleshooting, and process improvement

4.Nice-to-Have

*Previous guest-services, hospitality, vacation-rental, hotel, or property-management experience.

*Experience coordinating maintenance technicians, cleaners, contractors, or vendors.

*Experience handling difficult customers and resolving complaints.

*Experience managing multiple properties or multiple simultaneous service issues.

*Prior informal or formal leadership experience.

*Experience creating SOPs or improving operational workflows.



Salary (Dollar Rate):

Position & Length: Remote contractor; initial 12-month engagement with the opportunity to continue indefinitely.

Rate of Pay: $6–$8 USD/hour depending on experience.

Scheduled Hours Minimum: 40 hours per week; hours must be tracked.

Scheduled Hours Maximum: Up to 50 hours per week; hours above the normal schedule require approval.

Agreed Schedule: Tuesday–Thursday and Saturday, 10:00 AM–9:00 PM Eastern Time, with a 1-hour lunch.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description:
The Company:



This search is being conducted on behalf of Accordant Capital, a Chicago-based family office and growth investment firm. Accordant was named to reflect the firm's commitment to alignment and partnership with entrepreneurs, emphasizing congruency between the goals of operators and the resources the firm provides. Accordant partners with growth-oriented entrepreneurs and CEOs who are seeking more than capital. The firm provides access to leadership talent, growth expertise, and a proven services playbook that enables founders to focus on what they do best — serving their markets in new and innovative ways. Because Accordant rarely raises outside capital, it can focus entirely on aligning its expertise and investment horizon with the needs of its operating companies. 



Accordant has a long history of success in multiple industries. Its largest operating platform is MPHQ, serving the $30 billion healthcare compliance market, including market-leading brands MedPro Waste Disposal, HazPro Waste Disposal, and MP1 Solutions. MPHQ provides a growing suite of innovative services including regulated medical waste disposal, OSHA workplace safety, HIPAA certification, HR compliance training, pharmaceutical waste management, and secure document destruction to over 30,000 clients nationwide. 



In addition to MPHQ, Accordant's diverse and growing operating company portfolio includes Mend Strategies, Modern Amenities, AIMS Group, and Break Through Closing — each reflecting the firm's approach of partnering with founders to scale businesses through strategic growth, operational excellence, and talent development. 



Position Overview:

The SDR is a full-cycle sales role responsible for opening new doors for MPHQ — Accordant Capital's healthcare compliance platform — and converting outbound conversations into qualified opportunities and closed business. You will prospect into US provider offices, navigate to decision-makers, understand their compliance needs, position the Company's value, handle objections, and close business. 



Success means consistent activity, strong conversion, disciplined pipeline management, and month-over-month quota attainment. You are a seller, not a script reader — comfortable creating conversations from cold outreach, asking strong discovery questions, listening before recommending, handling rejection, and asking for the close. 



Key Responsibilities:



Outbound Prospecting

• Make high-volume outbound calls into assigned US provider-office lists using targeted data and approved calling cadences. 

• Navigate gatekeepers and reach office managers, practice administrators, owners, and other decision-makers professionally. 

• Execute multi-touch outreach across calls and approved sales-engagement channels so viable accounts are not abandoned after a single attempt. 

• Prioritize accounts and activities based on ICP, likelihood to engage, and pipeline potential. 



Consultative Selling

• Open calls as conversations, not pitches, and earn the prospect's attention through relevant questions. 

• Understand how the practice manages compliance today, who they use, what it costs, and where the pain points are. 

• Translate compliance and waste requirements into clear, practical language for busy healthcare decision-makers. 

• Recommend solutions based on the prospect's needs and be transparent when Accordant is not the right fit. 

• Build relationships that create future opportunities even when the initial answer is no. 



Selling & Closing

• Position Accordant Capital, MedPro & MP1 Solutions around cost savings, compliance coverage, and service reliability based on what matters to the prospect. 

• Handle price, incumbent-vendor, timing, and other objections without unnecessarily discounting value. 

• Present promotional and incentive-based offers accurately and consistently. 

• Carry qualified opportunities through the full sales cycle to signed agreement, escalating larger or more complex deals according to the defined path. 

• Meet or exceed monthly targets for qualified opportunities, net-new customers, and revenue. 



Pipeline & CRM Discipline

• Respond to inbound leads quickly and qualify them against agreed criteria when assigned. 

• Keep accounts, contacts, activities, opportunities, and next steps current in the CRM the same day. 

• Own and prioritize your pipeline based on likelihood to close and expected value. 

• Complete follow-up according to the defined cadence and maintain accurate opportunity stages and close dates. 



Coaching & Team Contribution

• Participate fully in team huddles, call coaching, role plays, and call reviews. 

• Apply coaching feedback immediately and demonstrate measurable improvement. 

• Share effective discovery questions, objection responses, talk tracks, and prospect insights with the team. 

• Represent Accordant Capital professionally in every customer interaction and support occasional client-facing events or networking activities as needed. 



Required Qualifications:

• 2+ years in outbound B2B sales or another quota-carrying, phone-based sales role. 

• Demonstrated success with high-volume outbound cold calling and net-new account acquisition. 

• Demonstrated closing experience — not solely appointment setting or lead qualification. 

• Comfort with consultative selling: asks strong questions, listens actively, diagnoses needs, and recommends appropriately. 

• Strong spoken and written English with a warm, confident, professional phone presence for a US audience. 

• Experience using a CRM and sales-engagement or sequencing tools; Salesforce, HubSpot, or GoHighLevel experience preferred. 

• Comfort with dialers and call-recording/coaching tools such as Gong or equivalent.

title: Head of Sales Development (SDR/LDR)
description:
The Company:



This search is being conducted on behalf of Accordant Capital, a Chicago-based family office and growth investment firm. Accordant was named to reflect the firm's commitment to alignment and partnership with entrepreneurs, emphasizing congruency between the goals of operators and the resources the firm provides. Accordant partners with growth-oriented entrepreneurs and CEOs who are seeking more than capital. The firm provides access to leadership talent, growth expertise, and a proven services playbook that enables founders to focus on what they do best — serving their markets in new and innovative ways. Because Accordant rarely raises outside capital, it can focus entirely on aligning its expertise and investment horizon with the needs of its operating companies. 



Accordant has a long history of success in multiple industries. Its largest operating platform is MPHQ, serving the $30 billion healthcare compliance market, including market-leading brands MedPro Waste Disposal, HazPro Waste Disposal, and MP1 Solutions. MPHQ provides a growing suite of innovative services including regulated medical waste disposal, OSHA workplace safety, HIPAA certification, HR compliance training, pharmaceutical waste management, and secure document destruction to over 30,000 clients nationwide. 



In addition to MPHQ, Accordant's diverse and growing operating company portfolio includes Mend Strategies, Modern Amenities, AIMS Group, and Break Through Closing — each reflecting the firm's approach of partnering with founders to scale businesses through strategic growth, operational excellence, and talent development. 



Position Overview:

The PH Head of Sales Development will build MPHQ's outbound sales engine from the ground up — Accordant Capital's healthcare compliance platform — and own the revenue it produces. This leader will recruit and ramp a high-performing team, establish the sales motion, and create the operating discipline required to scale from an initial pilot pod to a 10+ rep organization. 



The ideal leader has done this before, can bring proven talent, and can demonstrate a track record of turning outbound teams into predictable revenue engines. You are a builder, not a caretaker — someone who has launched an outbound sales function from scratch, recruited high-performing sellers, and built the operating system that turns activity into predictable revenue. 



Key Responsibilities:



Build the Program

• Design and stand up the Company's outbound sales motion from zero — including ICP, targeting, messaging, cadences, qualification, objection handling, technology, QA, reporting, and operating rhythm. 

• Recommend the right team structure and pilot size, backed by data, and define the conditions for scaling to 10+ reps. 

• Build a repeatable full-cycle motion where reps prospect, qualify, handle objections, and close, with clear escalation for larger or more complex deals. 

• Partner with Technical/Data and Marketing on list quality, vertical targeting, lead generation, and sales enablement. 

• Design the SDR incentive and commission structure with HR and Finance and align it to qualified pipeline, closed-won revenue, and company economics. 



Build the Team — Hire, Train, Retain 

• Own hiring for the team — define the rep profile, run the interview loop, and maintain a high bar for experienced sellers. 

• Recruit and ramp an initial 5-person pilot pod, then scale based on demonstrated production and unit economics. 

• Tap your own bench and network of proven SDRs, BDRs, inside sales reps, or closers who can accelerate time-to-productivity, subject to the Company's standard hiring process. 

• Build a repeatable onboarding and ramp program that shortens time-to-first-opportunity and time-to-quota. 

• Establish a rigorous coaching rhythm using live calls/recordings, with regular feedback on discovery, active listening, gatekeeper navigation, objection handling, and closing. 

• Own retention and performance management, keeping top producers engaged and accountable. 



Own Revenue & Outbound Production 

• Own team targets for qualified opportunities, net-new customer acquisition, closed revenue, and quota attainment. 

• Build and execute outbound calling cadences into US provider offices — physician, dental, long-term care, veterinary, and other non-acute practices. 

• Ensure reps can position the Company's value on cost savings, compliance coverage, and service reliability, and handle price and incumbent-vendor objections. 

• Personally inspect the sales motion and intervene where activity, conversion, or close rates break down. 



Pipeline, Process & Enablement 

• Create and maintain call guides, discovery frameworks, objection-handling guides, and playbooks. 

• Oversee call monitoring and QA to ensure consistent, professional, compliant customer interactions. 

• Use CRM, sales-engagement/sequencing, dialer, call-coaching, and reporting tools to drive transparency and accountability. 

• Monitor pipeline health, stage conversion, time-to-close, and bottlenecks; turn findings into specific process changes. 

• Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting. 



Performance, Reporting & Unit Economics 

• Track daily, weekly, and monthly KPIs — dials, connects, conversations, qualified opportunities, conversion, closed revenue, and quota attainment. 

• Own the sales funnel from activity through revenue and establish clear baseline conversion metrics. 

• Measure and improve unit economics, including cost per qualified opportunity, cost per acquisition, revenue per rep, and payback. 

• Use performance data to determine when to adjust the people, process, proposition, or investment level before scaling. 

• Provide concise, actionable reporting to US executive leadership and participate in strategic reviews. 



Required Qualifications:

• 5+ years in B2B outbound and consultative sales with a documented record of quota attainment, including hands-on prospecting and closing. 

• 3+ years leading SDR, inside sales, or comparable outbound teams. 

• Required: demonstrated experience building and scaling an outbound sales function from zero — not simply managing an established team. 

• Documented track record with specific, quotable results from a team built and scaled to consistent quota attainment. 

• Personally recruited and ramped sales talent; able to explain the rep profile, sourcing strategy, hiring bar, and time-to-productivity. 

• Existing network or bench of proven sales talent that can be activated for the initial team is strongly preferred. 

• Strong command of CRM, sales engagement/sequencing, dialer, call-recording/coaching, and reporting tools; able to independently build cadences, scripts, QA, and performance reporting. Salesforce experience preferred. 

• Data-driven operator who can diagnose where conversion breaks down and adapt the playbook accordingly. 

• Consultative selling philosophy — leads with discovery, listens before recommending, and can coach this approach rather than simply enforce scripts. 

• Exceptional spoken and written English with a warm, credible phone presence for a US audience. 

• Executive presence, high energy, entrepreneurial mindset, and comfort operating in a fast-paced, quota-driven environment. 

• Reliable remote work setup with stable high-speed internet, headset, and backup power/internet; full overlap with US business hours (CST). 



Nice-To-Have:

• Experience selling into US non-acute healthcare practices. 

• Experience selling compliance, waste, insurance, SaaS, BPO, or other recurring B2B services. 

• Experience designing tiered SDR incentive and commission plans. 

• GoHighLevel or Salesforce experience building campaigns, pipelines, automations, and reporting. 

• Existing network in US healthcare compliance, practice management, or adjacent vendor ecosystems. 

• Experience representing a company at conferences, roundtables, or industry events. 



Compensation & Benefits:

title: Real Estate Acquisitions VA
description:
Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist (Remote)



About Us

Price Real Estate Investments is a multi-market U.S. based real estate investment company focused on acquiring off-market properties directly from homeowners. We specialize in building strong relationships with sellers, negotiating with them, and closing deals virtually. Our team is fully remote, but our impact is nationwide — and we’re growing quickly.



We’re looking for an experienced Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist to join our acquisitions team. This role is critical to our business: you’ll be speaking directly with homeowners, negotiating terms, and guiding sellers through the contract signing process. If you’ve personally made offers to sellers and closed contracts over the phone, this is an opportunity to put your skills to work in a high-energy, professional environment.



Compensation

$10/hour USD base pay



Plus Monthly Contract Bonuses for getting offers accepted:

• Bronze: 2 signed contracts = $500 bonus

• Silver: 3 signed contracts = $1,000 bonus

• Gold: 4 signed contracts = $1,500 bonus

• Platinum: 5+ signed contracts = $2,000 bonus



On-target earnings can range from $2,500–$3,500+ per month depending on performance. Pay dates are on the 1st and 15th of each month.



We believe in rewarding results. Our top performers earn meaningful bonuses based on closed contracts and consistent production.



Schedule

Full-time, Monday to Friday

9:00 AM – 6:00 PM CST

Remote position, work from your own secure setup



What You’ll Be Doing

- Engage with homeowners (seller leads), build authentic rapport, and manage conversations with professionalism

- Follow a proven acquisitions script while sounding natural and confident

- Ask strong follow-up questions to uncover seller motivation and property condition

- Make verbal offers, negotiate price and terms, and walk sellers through agreements using DocuSign

- Handle objections effectively and push deals forward toward signed contracts

- Maintain organized notes, offers, and seller updates in our CRM

- Collaborate closely with the acquisitions team and leadership



What It Takes to Succeed Here

- Relentless Follow-Up: Sellers don’t always respond the first time — or the second. You know how to stay persistent with calls, texts, and follow-ups until you get an answer. Nothing slips through the cracks on your watch.

- Extreme Attention to Detail: Every call, every note, every update gets logged correctly in the CRM. You don’t miss details, and you take pride in keeping your pipeline organized. If you’ve ever been called meticulous or “on top of everything,” this is where you’ll shine.

- Closer’s Mentality: You’re not just reading a script — you know how to listen, build rapport, and guide sellers toward a decision. You thrive on negotiation, handle objections with confidence, and create win-win agreements that get signed.

- Driven by Results: You measure success by contracts closed. You hold yourself to high standards and push to hit — and exceed — your targets consistently. You’re motivated by performance and driven by the satisfaction of closing successful deals.

- Resilient Problem-Solver: Whether it’s a tough seller, a pricing objection, or a complicated situation, you don’t freeze — you find solutions and move the deal forward. Challenges are part of the role, and you thrive in solving them under pressure.



Requirements

- Minimum 2+ years of experience in real estate acquisitions or seller negotiations

- Proven track record of closing real estate deals and securing signed contracts

- Excellent English communication skills (spoken and written)

- Confidence and professionalism on the phone; ability to build trust and rapport quickly

- Familiarity with real estate terms like ARV, repairs, inspection, contingencies, etc.

- Strong work ethic, coachability, and ability to follow scripts while sounding natural

- Proficiency with CRMs and outbound dialers

- Reliable high-speed internet, updated computer, and a quiet workspace



What We’re Looking For

- A confident, friendly, and persuasive communicator who thrives on results

- Someone who is organized, detail-oriented, and relentless in follow-up

- A professional with the drive to close contracts and grow with a fast-moving team



Why Join Us?

- Competitive pay with structured bonuses

- Real opportunities for growth in a professional investment company

- Work remotely with a team that supports your success

- A chance to close real deals, make a real impact, and develop long-term career skills in acquisitions



At Price Real Estate Investments, acquisitions is the heartbeat of our business. You’ll be in the front seat, driving growth and learning the strategies that power real deals across multiple U.S. markets.



How to Apply: (Read Carefully – Incomplete Applications Will Be Ignored)

-
 us at: 

- Subject line: Real Estate Acquisitions Application – OJPH

- Attach your resume with relevant real estate or sales experience

- Include a 1–2 minute audio or video introduction about yourself and experience.



Only applicants who follow all instructions will be considered.

title: Order Processing & Customer Retention Specialist
description:
Type: Full-Time | Monday–Friday

Work Schedule: Must be available during U.S. 8AM - 5PM Eastern Time

Reports To: Logistics Manager

Company: Engineer Supply



When applying for this position please answer the 2 questions below: 



Order/Customer Scenario:



A customer placed an order that was expected to ship within 3–5 business days. The vendor now tells you the item is backordered for 4 weeks, and the customer is upset and wants to cancel. Explain step-by-step how you would handle the order and communicate with the customer. What would you do to try to save the sale?

Voice Recording:



Please submit a 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself and explain why you believe you would be a good fit for this position.



Role Overview



Engineer Supply is seeking an Order Processing & Customer Retention Specialist to manage customer orders from entry through fulfillment while helping protect the customer relationship throughout the process.



This role is responsible for processing orders accurately, following up with vendors, keeping customers informed on delays or backorders, and helping reduce cancellations by offering solutions and alternative options when needed.



This position is ideal for someone who is highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and customer-focused.



Key Responsibilities:



Order Processing:



Enter and process customer orders accurately

Review pricing, freight, taxes, shipping, and billing details

Track open orders and help ensure they move through the system properly

Maintain accurate records in internal systems

Must be proficient in Excel



Customer Communication & Retention:



Communicate with customers regarding order status, delays, and backorders

Provide clear and timely updates throughout the order process

Help reduce cancellations by offering solutions and alternative products when appropriate

Escalate customer issues to management when needed



Vendor & Fulfillment Coordination:



Follow up with vendors regarding lead times, delays, and backordered items

Coordinate with vendors and internal teams to keep orders moving

Monitor partial shipments, backorders, and fulfillment issues

Help resolve order problems before they become escalations



Process & Team Support:



Help improve order processing workflows and SOPs

Support accuracy, consistency, and accountability within the department

Work closely with internal team members 



Success in This Role Looks Like:



Orders are processed accurately and on time

Customers receive proactive communication and support

Delayed or at-risk orders are actively managed

Fewer cancellations and fewer order-related issues

Strong follow-up and ownership from start to finish



Qualifications:



Experience in order processing, customer service, operations, or inside sales support

Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

Strong phone,
, and customer communication skills

Experience with order management systems preferred

Stone Edge experience is a plus (training will be provided)

Must be highly proficient in Excel

Must be comfortable speaking with U.S.-based customers and vendors

Must have a stable internet connection, quiet work environment, and ability to work independently



Preferred Traits:



Strong English communication skills

High attention to detail

Reliable follow-up habits

Confident handling customer issues and delays professionally



Why Join Engineer Supply:



Engineer Supply is a growing organization serving professionals in surveying, construction, engineering, and precision measurement industries. This role is important to protecting both the customer experience and company revenue by ensuring orders are handled with care, urgency, and accountability.

title: Property Management Customer Service ($300 Per Week)
description:
Property Management Customer Service Representative (Remote)



Self-Storage & Warehouse Properties | Full-Time | Long-Term



We own and operate three self-storage and warehouse properties in Florida and are looking for a full-time Property Management Customer Service Representative to become a key part of our team.



This isn't a typical customer service role.



Every phone call or
 leads to work that needs to be completed—from preparing leases and setting up payments to coordinating repairs and following up on overdue accounts. You'll be responsible for keeping every customer request and operational task moving until it's fully resolved.



If you're someone who takes ownership, follows through, and enjoys seeing things to completion, we'd love to hear from you.



Schedule



Full-time (40 hours per week)

Monday–Friday

9:00 AM–5:00 PM or 10:00 AM–6:00 PM US Eastern Time

Remote



What You'll Do



You'll manage customer interactions from first inquiry through move-in and ongoing account support.



Your responsibilities include:



Answer phone calls and
s from prospective and existing customers

Help customers choose the right storage unit or warehouse space for their needs

Prepare leases and guide customers through the rental process

Set up payment arrangements and maintain accurate customer accounts

Follow up professionally on overdue balances

Coordinate local contractors for maintenance and repairs

Confirm repair work has been completed and documented

Prepare and send lien notices according to company procedures and deadlines

Track every open task through completion using our task management system

Maintain accurate records and ensure nothing falls through the cracks



What We're Looking For



Required Experience



We're looking for someone with previous experience in one or more of the following:



Property management

Self-storage operations

Leasing offices

Rental administration

HOA administration

Residential or commercial property coordination



You should have experience working with leases, tenant payments, and customer accounts—not just answering customer service calls.



The Right Person for This Role



You'll be successful if you:



Naturally follow through until every task is complete

Stay organized while managing multiple ongoing priorities

Pay close attention to details, deadlines, and documentation

Are comfortable speaking with US customers over the phone

Can confidently handle conversations about overdue payments while remaining professional and respectful

Communicate clearly in both spoken and written English

Enjoy solving problems rather than passing them to someone else



Technical Requirements



You must have:



Reliable computer

Quality USB noise-cancelling headset

Hardwired Ethernet connection (Wi-Fi alone is not sufficient)

Backup internet connection

Quiet, professional workspace with minimal background noise



Work Environment



We provide structured training and detailed written procedures for nearly every process. You'll be supported with documented systems, but you'll also be trusted to take ownership of your work and see every task through to completion.



What We Offer



Competitive hourly pay based on experience

Paid training

Stable, long-term employment

A small, established company with clear processes and expectations

Well-documented SOPs and ongoing support



Please Note



This is a full-time position requiring availability during US Eastern business hours.

We use time-tracking software and are transparent about it from the beginning. We measure productivity and accountability, not micromanagement.

We are seeking someone committed to this role as their primary full-time position.



How to Apply



Please include:



Your resume

A short voice recording introducing yourself

Briefly describe a time you had to follow up repeatedly with others to get an important task completed

Tell us which property management, leasing, or rental systems you've used and what your responsibilities were in those systems



We're looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates professionally, and finishes what they start. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Brand Designer
description:
**About Manukora**



Manukora is a global wellness brand, leading the fast-growing US Mānuka honey category. We're on a mission to preserve the power of Mānuka and deliver it to the world in pure, functional formats at uncompromising quality, purity and potency.



Born in the wilds of New Zealand, we harvest one of the planet's rarest natural resources: raw Mānuka honey. This creamy caramel super honey contains unique antioxidants, prebiotics, and a special antibacterial compound called "MGO."Established in 2015, we are a founder-led, family-owned business headquartered in New Zealand with operations globally in the United States and Europe. Manukora is a certified B Corporation, working with locally-based master beekeeping partners to produce the highest quality Mānuka, leading through ethical beekeeping practices and investing in our bees, their environment and the communities that surround them.



We are a team of beekeepers, herbalists, food scientists, and wellness professionals working to deliver this one-of-a-kind honey and reimagine the immune and digestive wellness categories.



**The Role**



You'll work directly with our Senior Design Lead, turning ideas into scroll-stopping digital and marketing work: campaigns, paid social,
, web, and everything in between. If you love continuing to evolve legacy brands (not just decorating them), this role is for you.



What you'll do



- **Brand identity & visual language** - evolve and protect our premium identity across every digital touchpoint, keeping the brand distinctive and consistent as we scale

- **Social media creative** - concept and design scroll-stopping paid and organic social that performs

- **Digital campaign production** - bring campaigns to life across
, web, landing pages, and digital ads, from concept through final assets

title: Meta & Google Media Buyer
description:
**Position:** Meta & Google Media Buyer  

**Type:** Full-Time, Remote  

**Schedule:** Must have some overlap with U.S. Eastern Time



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced **Performance Media Buyer** to manage and optimize paid advertising across **Meta and Google** for a portfolio of growing consumer brands.



This is a hands-on role. You will be responsible for the day-to-day management of campaigns, monitoring performance, testing new strategies and creative, managing budgets, and identifying opportunities to improve ROAS and overall profitability.



We are looking for someone who is highly analytical, organized, proactive, and comfortable managing meaningful advertising budgets.

- Prepare clear weekly reporting on performance, learnings, and next steps

- Identify trends and opportunities within advertising data

- Maintain organized campaign naming, tracking, and account structure

- Stay current on changes to Meta and Google advertising platforms



### What We're Looking For



- **3+ years of hands-on media buying experience**

- Strong experience with both **Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads**

- Experience working with **e-commerce / consumer product brands**

- Demonstrated experience managing and scaling significant advertising budgets

- Strong understanding of **ROAS, CAC, CPA, CTR, CPM, CVR, AOV, MER, and LTV**

- Experience with **Shopify** and e-commerce attribution

- Strong understanding of creative testing and how creative impacts paid media performance

- Comfortable analyzing large amounts of performance data

- Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills

- Excellent attention to detail

- Strong written and spoken English

- Ability to work independently and communicate proactively



### Bonus Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



- Amazon advertising

- TikTok Ads

- YouTube Ads

- GA4

- Google Merchant Center

- Shopify Plus

- Klaviyo

- Looker Studio / Power BI

- Attribution platforms

- Consumer products sold through both **DTC and major retailers**



### What Success Looks Like



We don't want someone who simply keeps campaigns running.



We want someone who is constantly asking:



**What is working? What isn't? Why? What should we test next? Where should we increase spend? Where should we pull back?**



You should be able to look at an advertising account, understand what is driving performance, identify problems, and develop a clear plan for improving results.



The right person will eventually become a trusted owner of paid media across multiple brands and work closely with our internal marketing and creative teams.



### To Apply



Please include:

- An example of a campaign or account you significantly improved

- Your experience with Shopify

**Please also answer this question:**  

*If you took over an e-commerce Meta account spending $100,000 per month and ROAS had declined by 25% over the previous 60 days, what are the first five things you would investigate?*



That last question is important. **I'd absolutely include it in the overseas listing.** It'll help you immediately separate actual media buyers from applicants who have learned the terminology but haven't really managed accounts.

title: Certified Medical Coder / Coding Auditor — Orthopedic & Spine Physician Claims
description:
We are looking for an experienced U.S. medical coder / coding auditor with strong experience in orthopedic, spine, and musculoskeletal physician coding.



Our company, MedCode Pro, helps physicians and procedural clinics identify CPT codes, modifiers, add-on codes, and documentation requirements that may have been missed during billing.



We are performing audits where we review approximately 60 days of clinic claims and compare the billed codes against the supporting clinical notes. The focus will be orthopedic and spine-related physician services, including clinic visits, procedures, injections, and operative notes.



This role is ideal for someone who can read provider documentation and determine what codes are supported, what may have been missed, and what documentation is needed to support the recommendation.



Responsibilities

- Review de-identified orthopedic and spine-related clinical notes, procedure notes, operative reports, and claim/superbill data



- Compare documented services against codes that were actually billed



- Identify potential missed CPT codes, add-on codes, modifiers, HCPCS codes, and ICD-10-CM opportunities

- Review E/M coding where relevant, including documentation support and modifier use

- Flag documentation gaps where a code may be possible but not fully supported

- Identify potential undercoding, overcoding, bundling, unbundling, or compliance risks

- Provide a clear coding rationale for each recommendation

- Summarize findings in a structured audit format



Specialty Focus

We are especially interested in experience with:

- Orthopedic surgery

- Spine surgery

-Musculoskeletal procedures

- Pain-related spine procedures

- Injections and procedure coding

- Imaging-guided procedures, if applicable

- E/M coding for orthopedic clinics

- Modifiers commonly used in physician billing

- Add-on codes and bundled procedure logic



Required Qualifications

Experience with U.S. physician/professional fee coding



Experience coding or auditing orthopedic, spine, or musculoskeletal claims



Strong understanding of CPT, ICD-10-CM, HCPCS, and modifiers



Ability to read clinical documentation and determine what codes are supported



Experience reviewing clinic notes, procedure notes, operative reports, claims, or superbills



Strong written English



Detail-oriented and able to explain coding rationale clearly



Comfortable working with spreadsheets or structured audit templates



Preferred Qualifications

CPC, CCS-P, CPMA, or similar certification

title: Interventional Radiology Medical Coder / Auditor — Peripheral Vascular (CIRCC preferred) — Remote
description:
About us

MedCode Pro is a medical-coding and revenue-integrity company. We audit operative notes against what was billed and paid, find coding errors in both directions (undercoded revenue and compliance risk), and help specialty practices bill cleanly and defend their claims. We're expanding into interventional radiology — specifically lower-extremity peripheral vascular intervention (angioplasty, stent, atherectomy, IVL) — and we need an experienced IR coder/auditor to be our subject-matter expert for this specialty.



Please note this will be Part-time contract to start (10–20 hrs/week), with room to grow into full-time



What you'll do

• Review de-identified IR operative/procedure notes and determine the correct CPT code set — this is the "answer key" our whole quality process is built on.

• Audit claims for both missed revenue and compliance exposure (over-coding, unbundling, medical-necessity gaps).

• Apply the current lower-extremity endovascular revascularization coding rules correctly — territory-based coding (iliac, femoral/popliteal, tibial/peroneal, inframalleolar), the highest-service-wins bundling within a vessel, initial + additional-vessel add-ons, IVL add-ons, and NCCI edits.

• Check interventions against Medicare LCD / medical-necessity criteria for PAD/critical limb ischemia (rest pain, tissue loss, ABI, failed conservative therapy).

• Review codes proposed by our software (we use an AI-assisted coding engine — you are the human expert who accepts, rejects, or corrects each suggestion) and give feedback that improves the system.



You must have

• Active certification: CIRCC strongly preferred (Certified Interventional Radiology Cardiovascular Coder). CPC, CCS, or RCC also considered if paired with real IR/vascular experience.

• Hands-on experience coding or auditing lower-extremity endovascular revascularization — you can explain, without looking it up, why angioplasty + stent in the same vessel is one code, not two.

• Working knowledge of NCCI edits, RS&I/catheterization bundling, and modifier use (RT/LT, -59/-XU).

• Familiarity with peripheral-vascular medical-necessity / LCD requirements.

• Comfort reading full operative notes and handling de-identified data professionally (HIPAA awareness).

• Reliable internet, clear written English, and attention to detail.



Nice to have

• Experience in an office-based lab (OBL) or ASC setting, and with the technical-component / device (HCPCS C-code) side.

• Prior work as an auditor (not just a production coder).

• Experience with the newer restructured LE revascularization code family.



How to apply — please follow these steps or we won't review your application:

1. Start your message with the word "VASCULAR" so we know you read the full post.

2. List your certifications (with numbers/expiry) and briefly, your IR/peripheral-vascular coding experience.

3. Answer this short coding test (2–4 sentences, show your reasoning):

Right lower extremity. In the right external iliac artery, balloon angioplasty was performed and then a stent was placed (straightforward lesion). In the right common femoral artery, balloon angioplasty alone was performed (straightforward). Access was via a right common femoral puncture; no tibial or below-ankle work was done. Which CPT codes would you report for the professional claim, and briefly why?



We read the reasoning more than the exact numbers. Strong applicants will hear back within a few days.
