title: Call cold/ lead follow-up
description:
# REAL ESTATE COLD CALLER / LEAD REACTIVATION SPECIALIST — PROJECT/GIG



I am looking for an **experienced Cold Caller / Lead Reactivation Specialist** for a short-term project working through an existing database of older and cold real estate leads.



**This is initially a project/gig and not a permanent position. However, if your work produces beneficial results, there is potential for this to turn into an ongoing part-time position.**



The goal of this project is simple: **reconnect with older leads, determine whether they are still interested in buying or selling real estate, update their information in the CRM, and schedule qualified appointments on my calendar.**



## RESPONSIBILITIES



* Make outbound calls to existing cold and older leads

* Send follow-up text messages when appropriate

* Re-engage previous buyer and seller leads

* Determine whether they are still interested in real estate

* Determine whether they are looking to buy or sell

* Identify their current timeframe and motivation

* Schedule qualified appointments on my calendar

* Follow up with leads who are not ready immediately

* Update every contact attempt and conversation in the CRM

* Add clear and accurate notes

* Update lead status/stage and contact information

* Identify wrong numbers, disconnected numbers, duplicates, and outdated contacts

* Create appropriate follow-up tasks

* Keep the CRM/database organized as leads are worked

* Provide reporting on calls, conversations, follow-ups, qualified leads, and appointments scheduled



## EXPERIENCE REQUIRED



**Previous cold-calling experience is required.**



Real estate cold-calling experience is a plus but is not required.



**No cold-calling or sales training will be provided.** You should already know how to:



* Make outbound calls confidently

* Speak naturally and professionally

* Get past the initial resistance of a cold lead

* Follow a script without sounding like you are reading

* Ask appropriate qualifying questions

* Handle common objections

* Identify motivation and timeframe

* Know when a lead needs additional follow-up

* Transition naturally into scheduling an appointment

* Document conversations accurately in a CRM



You must have **clear, easily understood spoken English and strong conversational skills**, as you will be speaking directly with U.S.-based consumers.



## EQUIPMENT & CALLING SYSTEM



You must have:



* Reliable high-speed internet

* Reliable computer

* Quality headset/microphone

* Quiet and professional calling environment

* Stable internet connection suitable for outbound calls



**The CRM and calling/dialer system will be provided.** You will be added to my existing CRM/calling system as needed for this project.



Previous experience using a CRM and/or call dialer is expected.



## PERFORMANCE



This project will be evaluated based on the quality of the work and results, including:



* Leads attempted

* Contact/conversation rate

* Follow-ups generated

* Qualified buyer or seller opportunities identified

* Appointments scheduled

* Accuracy of CRM notes and contact updates

* Proper lead-status management

* Quality of conversations and follow-up



**If the work is beneficial and produces results, this gig may turn into an ongoing part-time position.**



## HOW TO APPLY



Please use **REAL ESTATE COLD CALLER** as the subject line.



Please answer ALL of the following questions:



**1. What is your desired hourly rate?**



**2. How many years of cold-calling experience do you have?**



**3. Have you previously cold-called real estate leads?** If yes, explain what type of leads you contacted and what you were responsible for.



**4. Tell me about your current or most recent cold-calling position.** What type of business did you work for, and what were your responsibilities?



**5. Approximately how many outbound calls did you make per day or per hour?**



**6. What results did you personally achieve?** If available, provide actual numbers such as conversations, qualified leads, appointments scheduled, or conversion rates.



**7. What CRM systems have you personally used?** Please explain what you actually did inside the CRM.



**8. What call dialers, VoIP systems, or CRM calling systems have you previously used?**



**9. After speaking with a lead, what information do you normally document in the CRM?**



**10. How would you handle an older lead who answers the phone and immediately says, “I'm not interested”?**



**11. How do you determine whether a lead should be scheduled for an appointment, followed up with later, or no longer actively pursued?**



**12. Are you comfortable making both outbound calls and follow-up text messages?**



**13. What are your normal working hours and time zone? What hours are you available during U.S. Eastern Time?**



**14. Are you currently working with any other clients?** If yes, approximately how many hours per week?



**15. How do you track your working hours?** Please include the program or method you use and how you document time spent calling, texting, following up, and updating the CRM.



## REQUIRED CALL SAMPLE



**16. Please submit a 1–2 minute video recording so I can hear your natural speaking voice, communication style, and how you would communicate with one of my leads.**



For this exercise, imagine you are contacting an older lead in my real estate database who previously expressed interest in buying or selling a home.



Use the following as a starting point:



> **“Hi, Mr./Ms. [Last Name], this is [Your Name]. I'm working with Alicia Brown, and we're reaching out to some of her previous contacts to update her records. I wanted to check in and see if you're still considering buying or selling real estate.”**



From there, **continue the conversation naturally.**



If the person says yes, demonstrate how you would determine:



* Whether they are buying or selling

* Their current timeframe

* Whether anything has changed since they previously spoke with Alicia

* Whether they would like to schedule a time to speak with Alicia



If they are not ready yet, demonstrate how you would determine an appropriate time for future follow-up.



**You do not have to repeat the script word-for-word. I prefer that you sound natural and conversational rather than simply reading a script.**



**Do not use an AI-generated, AI-enhanced, or altered voice.**



Your recording will be evaluated based on:



* Clarity of spoken English

* How easily you can be understood

* Natural conversational ability

* Confidence

* Tone and pacing

* Professionalism

* Ability to ask appropriate follow-up questions

* Ability to transition naturally toward scheduling an appointment



Please provide an accessible Google Drive, Loom, unlisted YouTube, or similar link.



**Applications without the required call sample may not be considered.**



## IMPORTANT



This is **not an entry-level cold-calling position**.



I will provide the leads, CRM/calling system, business-specific information, and script/talking points. However, **I will not provide training on how to cold call, overcome basic objections, qualify prospects, or conduct a sales conversation.**



You should already have these skills and be prepared to begin working with minimal direction.



**This is initially a short-term gig/project. If your work is beneficial and produces results, there is potential for the opportunity to continue as a part-time position.**

title: Acquisition & Operations Coordinator
description:
About the Role

We are a U.S.-based real estate investment and private lending company seeking a reliable, organized Acquisition & Operations Coordinator.

Your primary responsibility will be helping us find, research, qualify, and track real estate investment opportunities. You will also maintain our CRM and make sure leads are properly followed up and moved through the acquisition process.

This is not a sales position. You will not initially be responsible for negotiating property purchases or closing deals. The position may grow into outreach and greater acquisition responsibility over time.

Primary Responsibilities

1. Acquisition & Lead Generation

• Identify potential investment properties using established criteria.

• Research properties, owners, and potential leads.

• Assist with off-market lead generation and list research.

• Review and qualify leads using our investment criteria and checklists.

• Gather missing information needed to evaluate opportunities.

• Prioritize promising opportunities for review.

• Track leads and follow-up activities through the acquisition process.

2. CRM & Pipeline Management

• Enter and maintain accurate lead and property information in the CRM.

• Track lead status, next steps, and follow-up dates.

• Keep acquisition and relationship pipelines organized and current.

• Identify overdue follow-ups and incomplete information.

• Prepare simple pipeline and activity reports.

• Help ensure qualified opportunities do not get lost because of missed follow-up.

Preferred Experience

Experience with some of the following is preferred:

• U.S. real estate investing or wholesaling

• Real estate lead generation and qualification

• CRM and pipeline management

• HubSpot or another professional CRM

• Property and owner research

• PropStream or similar property-data platforms

• Google Workspace and AI tools such as ChatGPT

You do not need experience with every tool. We value the ability to learn, research, follow processes, and work independently.

What We’re Looking For

• Reliable and detail-oriented

• Good internet research skills

• Comfortable working with CRM systems and technology

• Able to follow written procedures and checklists

• Able to manage assigned work without constant supervision

• Willing to ask questions when something is unclear

Important

This position supports a real estate investment business rather than a traditional Realtor sales business.

Experience with Realtors, listings, transaction coordination, or real estate marketing is welcome, but we are especially interested in candidates with experience in:

Lead Generation → Research → Qualification → CRM → Follow-Up → Acquisition

Schedule

Approximately 20 hours per week, with some availability during U.S. Eastern Time.

We are looking for someone interested in a long-term position with the opportunity for increased responsibility and hours as the business grows.

How to Apply

Please answer these questions:

1. Have you worked for a U.S. real estate investor, wholesaler, acquisition company, or similar business? Briefly describe what you did.

2. Which CRM systems have you used, and what did you do inside them?

3. What experience do you have with lead generation, lead qualification, or property research?

4. What tools have you used to research U.S. properties or property owners?

5. Please provide a short voice or video introduction in English.

Begin your application with the words “Acquisition First” so we know you read the entire posting.

title: Remote Title Examiner – Michigan
description:

We are seeking an experienced Title Examiner with strong knowledge of Michigan real estate title practices to join our team in a fully remote capacity. Research and analyze public records to establish an accurate chain of title

Examine deeds, mortgages, liens, judgments, easements, releases, restrictions, and other recorded documents

Identify defects, discrepancies, gaps, and potential issues affecting title

Review and interpret legal descriptions and property records

Prepare title examination reports and/or supporting documentation

Conduct searches using DataTrace

Follow established title examination procedures and client requirements

Communicate title issues and findings clearly to the appropriate team members

Maintain accuracy and productivity while working independently in a remote environment



Required Qualifications

Proven professional experience as a Title Examiner

Hands-on experience examining Michigan titles

Strong understanding of Michigan title records, recording practices, and real estate documents

Experience researching chains of title and identifying title defects

Hands-on experience with DataTrace is required

Strong attention to detail and accuracy

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Strong written communication and organizational skills

Reliable internet connection and ability to work effectively in a fully remote environment



Preferred Qualifications

Experience working for a title insurance company, title agency, abstract company, or related real estate services organization

Experience with additional title production or title search software

Familiarity with title commitments, preliminary reports, and title clearance processes

Experience handling a high volume of title searches while maintaining accuracy



Why Join Us?

100% Remote

Work with an established U.S. title/real estate organization

Opportunity to work with a professional team specializing in title and escrow services

Long-term opportunity for the right candidate

Collaborative remote work environment



Important

Please apply only if you have actual professional experience as a Title Examiner and have worked with Michigan properties. Experience with DataTrace is required for this position.

When applying, please highlight your Michigan title examination experience, years of title experience, and DataTrace experience.

title: Executive Business Partner & Project Manager
description:
The Compliance Services Organization didn’t exist. We built it.



MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation’s largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we’re actively building — and leading. 



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice’s behalf. 



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We’re changing that — and we’re looking for people who want to help build what comes next. 



Our technology: We’re actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. 



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. 



Position Overview: 

This role exists to keep the execution engine of the organization running. The Executive Business Partner & Project Manager sits inside the President and CEO's meeting cadence, owns follow-through on every action item across the business, and provides the calendar and scheduling backbone that keeps both executives' time in sync. Success looks like nothing falling through the cracks: every decision reaches a documented conclusion, every open loop is tracked to closure, and every meeting opens with a clear readout of what's done, what's pending, and what's overdue. 



Key Responsibilities:

•Codify outcomes into a clear record of what was d

•Open each meeting with a status readout covering closed items, open loops, and anything past due 



•Provide calendar and scheduling support for the President and CEO to prevent conflicts and eliminate overlap 



•Coordinate cross-functionally between executive leadership and the development/operations teams, and support the transition of legacy operating practices into AI-supported workflows 



•Partner with product managers and cross-functional leaders across the business to align priorities and drive follow-through, extending beyond the immediate development team. 



•Balance strategic and tactical execution — operate at the level of executive intent while also driving the granular, day-to-day follow-through needed to close items out. 



•Exercise discretion and sound judgment when handling confidential or sensitive business information encountered through leadership meetings and communications. 



•Represent executive leadership's priorities and intent when following up with stakeholders, ensuring alignment without requiring constant direct input. 



•Additional tasks assigned 



Required Qualifications:

title: Marketing Agency Operations Manager — Full-Time Remote
description:
# Operations Manager / Client Success Manager — Full-Time Remote



**Company:** Detailer Ads

**Pay:** $1,250–$1,500 USD/month starting + performance bonuses

**Schedule:** 7 Days Per Week

**Location:** Remote

**Long-Term Pay Potential:** $2,000+/month as responsibilities and company grow



## About Detailer Ads



Detailer Ads is a fast-growing marketing agency that helps auto detailing businesses across the United States generate leads and book more jobs through paid advertising.



We currently manage 30+ active clients and are looking for a highly organized and responsible **Operations Manager** to take ownership of our day-to-day agency operations.



This is NOT a basic virtual assistant position.



We are looking for someone who can manage clients, manage team members, solve problems independently, keep projects moving, and make sure the agency runs smoothly without the owner needing to be involved in daily fulfillment.



Your primary goal:



**Make sure every client is taken care of, every task gets completed, and nothing falls through the cracks.**



---



# Schedule



This is a **full-time position with 7-day-per-week responsibility.**



Our clients operate businesses every day of the week, so we need someone who can monitor operations and client communication throughout the week.



### Monday–Friday



These will be your primary working days.



You will actively:



* Manage clients

* Manage the team

* Check projects

* Follow up on overdue tasks

* Coordinate campaigns

* Coordinate creatives

* Handle onboarding

* Resolve client issues



### Saturday–Sunday



Weekends will generally be lighter.



You will primarily:



* Check Slack/client messages

* Handle urgent client issues

* Make sure nothing important is being missed

* Follow up when necessary

* Check that campaigns and operations are running normally



You will not necessarily be doing a full workload every Saturday and Sunday, but you must be **reliable and reachable throughout the week.**



---



# Your Responsibilities



## 1. Client Communication



You will become the primary point of contact for our clients.



Clients communicate with us primarily through Slack.



You will:



* Respond to client questions

* Provide updates

* Follow up with clients

* Handle normal concerns

* Request missing information

* Follow up for video footage

* Communicate campaign updates

* Identify clients who may be unhappy or at risk of canceling



The owner should NOT need to answer routine client questions.



You should be able to handle most situations independently.



---



# 2. Manage Our Fulfillment Team



You will help manage our existing:



* Onboarding VA

* Video Editor

* Media Buyer



And future team members as the agency grows.



You are responsible for making sure everyone knows:



**What needs to be completed**



**Who is responsible**



**When it needs to be completed**



**What has the highest priority**



If someone misses a deadline, you follow up.



If something is blocking a client, you solve it.



The owner should not need to constantly check whether employees completed their work.



---



# 3. Manage New Client Onboarding



Every new client should move through our system:



Payment Received



↓



Onboarding Form Completed



↓



Meta Access Received



↓



GoHighLevel Setup



↓



Scripts Created



↓



Client Records Footage



↓



Footage Sent to Editor



↓



Ads Edited



↓



Campaign Built



↓



Campaign Live



Your responsibility is to make sure clients continue moving through this process.



No client should sit forgotten for several days because someone failed to follow up.



---



# 4. Manage Creative Production



You will coordinate between:



**Client → Video Editor → Media Buyer**



You will:



* Make sure clients receive scripts

* Follow up for video footage

* Organize submitted footage

* Assign editing priorities

* Monitor the editing queue

* Make sure videos are completed on time

* Review advertisements for obvious mistakes

* Send approved creatives to the media buyer



Our video editor should always know exactly what needs to be edited next.



---



# 5. Coordinate With Our Media Buyer



You do NOT need to personally run
 Ads.



However, you should understand the basics of Meta advertising.



You will communicate with our media buyer to ensure:



* Campaigns launch on time

* Clients receive leads

* Underperforming clients are identified

* New creatives are requested when necessary

* Campaign issues are addressed

* No advertising account gets forgotten



---



# 6. Keep Our Agency Organized



You will maintain our internal operations system.



Every client should always have a clear status.



For example:



???? ACTIVE



???? NEEDS ATTENTION



???? AT RISK



Or:



ONBOARDING



WAITING FOR ACCESS



WAITING FOR FOOTAGE



EDITING



READY TO LAUNCH



LIVE



NEEDS NEW CREATIVE



You should be able to answer:



**"What's happening with this client?"**



without needing to ask multiple people first.



---



# Tools We Use



Experience with these tools is preferred:



* Slack

* GoHighLevel

* Meta Business Manager

*
 Ads Manager

* ClickUp

* Google Drive

* Google Sheets

* Zapier

* Stripe



You do not need to already know every platform.



However, you MUST be comfortable learning software quickly.



---



# Who We're Looking For



We want someone who:



* Has previous marketing agency experience

* Has managed clients before

* Has managed remote workers before

* Has excellent written English

* Is comfortable communicating with U.S. clients

* Is extremely organized

* Responds quickly

* Can manage 30+ clients

* Can manage multiple priorities simultaneously

* Takes ownership

* Can solve problems independently

* Doesn't require constant instructions

* Notices problems before the owner does

* Can hold team members accountable

* Is dependable 7 days per week



Most importantly:



### We need someone who THINKS like a manager — not someone who simply waits for tasks.



---



# You Are NOT a Good Fit If:



* You need instructions for every decision

* You only want simple VA work

* You regularly disappear during working hours

* You don't like communicating with clients

* You avoid difficult conversations

* You struggle managing multiple priorities

* You miss deadlines

* You need constant reminders

* You blame other people when something goes wrong

* You are unavailable every weekend



---



# What Success Looks Like



After approximately 30–60 days:



Clients communicate with YOU instead of the owner.



Our onboarding VA reports to YOU.



Our editor reports to YOU.



Our media buyer coordinates with YOU.



Clients are followed up with automatically.



Creative projects stay organized.



Campaigns launch on time.



Problems get handled before they become emergencies.



The owner primarily focuses on:



* Sales

* Marketing

* Partnerships

* Growth

* Strategy



instead of client fulfillment.



---



# Compensation



Starting compensation:



**$1,250–$1,500 USD/month**



There will also be opportunities for monthly performance bonuses.



Compensation can grow toward:



**$1,750–$2,000+/month**



as you prove that you can successfully manage the operation and take more responsibility.



Performance will be evaluated based on:



* Client retention

* Client satisfaction

* Response times

* Onboarding speed

* Campaign launch speed

* Team deadlines

* Creative turnaround

* Number of overdue tasks

* Number of issues requiring owner involvement



The better the agency operates without the owner, the more valuable your position becomes.



---



# How To Apply



Start your application with:



**DETAILER**



If your application does not start with DETAILER, it will not be considered.



Please answer:



1. Tell us about your experience working for marketing agencies.



2. Have you ever managed 20+ clients simultaneously? If yes, explain.



3. Have you managed VAs, video editors, media buyers, or other remote employees?



4. What experience do you have with GoHighLevel?



5. What experience do you have with Meta/Facebook Ads?



6. What experience do you have with Slack?



7. What project management systems have you used?



8. Are you available to monitor operations and client communication 7 days per week?



9. What hours are you normally available?



10. What time zone are you located in?



11. What is your desired monthly salary in USD?



## Scenario #1



A client was promised their campaign would launch, but they haven't submitted the necessary footage after being reminded twice.



They message:



"Why aren't my ads running yet? I'm paying you guys and nothing is happening."



Explain exactly how you would handle this.



## Scenario #2



It is Monday morning.



* Your editor has 8 advertisements waiting

* 3 new clients need onboarding

* 4 clients haven't submitted footage

* 2 campaigns need new creatives

* One client says their leads are bad

* The media buyer is waiting for assets



Explain how you would organize and prioritize the day.



## Scenario #3



A client messages:



"These leads suck. If this doesn't improve I'm canceling."



What would you say to the client and what actions would you take internally?



---



# REQUIRED VIDEO



Please submit a **2–3 minute Loom video** with your application.



In your video tell us:



1. Who you are

2. Your agency experience

3. Your management experience

4. Why you're a good fit for this position

5. Why we should trust you to manage 30+ clients



Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.



You must have previous hands-on experience with Meta/Facebook Ads and be comfortable reviewing campaign performance, CPL, lead volume, delivery, creative performance, and basic troubleshooting. You will not be responsible for building every campaign yourself, but you will be responsible for making sure our campaign VA is following the correct process and identifying when an account needs attention.

title: Short form creative who can also edit
description:
I run a fast-growing personal brand in the sales space. Millions of views, and I need someone who can take my raw footage and turn it into scroll-stopping short-form content — start to finish.



This is NOT a button-pusher editing job. I need a creative first, editor second. Someone who watches raw clips and instantly sees the moment that matters, writes a hook that stops the scroll, and builds the story. If you can only cut what you’re told to cut, this isn’t for you.



What you’ll do:



    •    Take raw sales/door-to-door and coaching footage and find the money moments

    •    Write curiosity-driven hooks (the kind that make people HAVE to watch)

    •    Edit clean, fast-paced reels with captions, on the beat

    •    Bring ideas — I want a creative partner, not just hands



You must have:



    •    A real eye for what makes short-form go viral

    •    The ability to write hooks (this is the #1 skill)

    •    Editing skills in CapCut / Premiere / equivalent

    •    Fast turnaround and consistency



To apply — read carefully, most people won’t:



    1.    Start your message with the word VIRAL (if you don’t, I delete it — I need people who follow instructions).

    2.    Send me 3 examples of reels you edited where YOU wrote the hook. Tell me what the hook was and why it worked.

    3.    Send me 2 reels from other creators you think crush, and tell me WHY they work.

    4.    Final step: reply and I’ll send you one 2-minute raw clip. You send back (a) the exact hook you’d use and (b) how you’d cut the first 5 seconds. You do NOT need to edit the whole thing — I just want to see how your brain works.



If you can nail the hook on that test clip, we’ll talk money and this becomes long-term, full-time, with room to grow as I add more editors under you.

title: MCA SALES MANAGER / CLOSER TRAINER
description:
# ???? TRUPAY IS HIRING — MCA SALES MANAGER / CLOSER TRAINER



???? **Remote — Philippines**

???? **$3–$5 USD/hour + Commission & Team Overrides**

???? Independent Contractor

???? **Merchant Cash Advance / Business Finance**



TruPay is looking for an experienced **MCA Sales Manager / Closer Trainer** who knows how to close deals — but, more importantly, knows how to **teach other people to become successful closers.**



This is a hands-on leadership position.



We are building teams where:



**Opener → Closing Trainee → Closer → Team Lead → Manager**



Your job is to lead a **punctual, disciplined, productive team of openers** and teach them everything you know about moving an MCA opportunity from the initial conversation all the way through closing and funding.



## ???? COMPENSATION



**Starting hourly pay: $3–$5 USD/hour**, based on experience, demonstrated ability, and responsibilities.



PLUS opportunities to earn:



???? **5%–7% commission on qualifying deals you personally close and fund**



???? **1%–3% team override on qualifying funded production from agents/closers you train and develop**, subject to TruPay's applicable commission plan



The opportunity is designed so that managers are rewarded for **both their own production AND the success of the people they develop.**



The better your team becomes, the greater your opportunity to earn.



## ???? YOUR #1 MISSION: CREATE CLOSERS



We don't want a manager who simply tells people what to do.



### **We want a teacher.**



Your openers should become better every week because they're working with you.



You will teach them:



* How to properly qualify MCA opportunities

* How to conduct stronger sales conversations

* How to handle objections

* How to recognize a strong opportunity

* How to perform a proper live transfer

* How to follow up

* How to chase applications

* How to collect bank statements and required documents

* How to organize a complete application package

* How to work opportunities through the CRM pipeline

* How to prepare a file for underwriting

* How to understand lender requirements

* How to communicate with underwriting

* How to understand approved offers

* How to accurately present legitimate approved offers

* How to follow up and close

* How to move a deal toward funding

* Eventually, how to **teach someone else**



The goal is not to keep talented people as openers forever.



### Your success is measured partly by how many openers you turn into productive closers.



## ???? YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES AS MANAGER



You will be responsible for **Production + Training + Accountability + Leadership + Team Growth.**



You will:



* Lead your assigned opener/closer team.

* Be punctual and start your team on time.

* Hold daily team training.

* Coach using real opportunities and calls where permitted.

* Listen to agents' calls and provide actionable feedback.

* Demonstrate your own closing process.

* Answer questions from your team.

* Review difficult opportunities with closers.

* Monitor individual production.

* Monitor team production.

* Make sure CRM records stay updated.

* Identify people falling behind.

* Coach underperformers before problems become chronic.

* Recognize high-potential openers.

* Move qualified people into closing training.

* Develop closers into future Team Leads.

* Help recruit/build your team as it grows.

* Report production and problems to senior operations/underwriting.



## ⏰ PUNCTUALITY & ACCOUNTABILITY ARE REQUIRED



This is an hourly leadership position.



That means we expect managers to **actually lead during scheduled working hours.**



You must:



* Show up on time.

* Start team meetings on time.

* Keep your team accountable for attendance.

* Keep your team accountable for production.

* Be available to your agents for coaching.

* Maintain professional communication.

* Follow through on commitments.

* Lead by example.



If you expect punctuality and production from your team, **you must demonstrate both yourself.**



## ???? PRODUCTION RESPONSIBILITY



Managers are responsible for knowing their team's numbers every day.



You should know:



**How many transfers came in?**



**How many qualified applications were produced?**



**How many files are missing documents?**



**Which opportunities are stuck?**



**Which closers are hitting quota?**



**Which openers are improving?**



**Who is ready to begin closing?**



**What needs to happen next to move each qualified opportunity forward?**



You're not simply managing people.



### **You're managing production AND developing talent.**



## ???? WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



### MCA EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED.



You should have real experience with:



* Merchant Cash Advance (MCA)

* Business financing

* U.S. business owners

* MCA cold calling

* Qualification

* Applications

* Bank statements/document collection

* Closing

* Follow-up

* Working MCA opportunities through a pipeline



Previous experience as an **MCA Closer, Sales Manager, Team Lead, Floor Manager, or Trainer** is strongly preferred.



## ⭐ THE IDEAL MANAGER



You're probably a strong fit if you're:



* An experienced MCA closer

* A strong communicator

* Patient enough to teach beginners

* Competitive

* Highly punctual

* Organized

* Consistent

* Comfortable holding people accountable

* Able to motivate without babysitting

* Comfortable giving direct feedback

* Good at identifying people's strengths

* Excited about developing future closers

* Comfortable leading remote teams

* Able to explain *why* you do something instead of simply doing it yourself



Most importantly:



### **You should genuinely enjoy seeing someone you trained become successful.**



## ???? CAREER & TEAM-BUILDING OPPORTUNITY



We want to build leaders who create more leaders.



```text

MANAGER

   ↓

CLOSERS

   ↓

OPENERS

   ↓

CLOSING TRAINEES

   ↓

NEW CLOSERS

   ↓

NEW TEAM LEADS

   ↓

NEW TEAMS

```



You aren't being hired simply to manage today's team.



### **You're being hired to BUILD tomorrow's team.**



As the people you train become productive closers and eventually develop teams of their own, our compensation structure can reward qualifying production throughout the team you helped build.



## ???? HOW TO APPLY



Don't send us only a generic resume.



Send a **short introduction** telling us:



1. Your name and location.

2. How many years/months of **MCA experience** you have.

3. Your experience personally closing MCA deals.

4. Your experience managing or training agents.

5. Approximately how many people you've trained.

8. Why you believe you'd be a strong TruPay manager.



???? *
:**

— Van**

### ???? TRUPAY



**Don't just close deals.**



**Teach people to close.**



**Don't just manage a team.**



### **BUILD ONE.**

title: Remote CPA Accountant for UK Accounting Firm — Long-Term, Full Training

About us



I'm Keith, a UK Chartered Accountant (ICAEW), and I run a small, fast-growing accounting practice serving UK small and medium-sized businesses. We're modern, tech-forward, and genuinely client-focused, currently supported by three excellent Filipino accountants. As our client base grows, we're looking for another talented professional to join us remotely for the long term.



The role



We need a proactive, detail-oriented accountant who takes real ownership of client work — not someone who waits to be told what to do. Your work will include:



Bookkeeping, bank reconciliations, and journal entries

Preparing VAT returns and monthly management accounts

Annual statutory filings and financial reporting

Supporting our fractional CFO services — forecasting, analysis, and advisory

Speaking directly with clients where needed, by
 and Zoom



No UK experience? That's fine — we'll train you. You don't need to know UK VAT, Making Tax Digital, or UK compliance already. If you're a strong accountant with solid fundamentals, we'll teach you the UK side properly. What we can't teach is initiative, care, and the ability to make a client feel looked after — so those matter most to us.



Who we're looking for



A CPA or equivalent — this is essential

3+ years of solid accounting experience

Reliably available and alert during 10am–3pm UK time, Monday to Friday

Genuinely strong, warm communication — clients should enjoy dealing with you

Confident with accounting software (Xero and/or QuickBooks) and happy to learn more

Committed to this role for the long term, and reliably present during our UK hours



Hours and pay



Starts part-time (at least 20 hours a week now), growing towards full-time (40 hours) as we take on clients

Core availability 10am–3pm UK time, Monday to Friday, is required

From £8 per hour to start, with rises as your skills and UK knowledge grow

Paid monthly via Wise (you cover the transfer fee)

Discretionary bonus each Christmas



What we offer



100% remote, with flexible hours within your agreed UK availability

A friendly, respectful, tech-savvy team that actually enjoys the work

Real variety — a range of UK clients and financial challenges

Proper training and mentoring from an experienced UK Chartered Accountant

Genuine room to grow into reporting, forecasting, and advisory

A stable, long-term role in a business that's expanding

Real flexibility — as long as you're reliably present during our core UK hours, how you arrange the rest of your day is yours



How to apply



Fill in the short form here: 



What happens next: shortlisted applicants complete a brief spoken interview — a relaxed ten-minute phone conversation, done through your browser, no scheduling needed. We do this because a real conversation tells us far more than a written form, and it gives you the chance to show us who you are. After that, the strongest candidates have a Zoom interview with me, then a paid trial with the aim of a lasting partnership.



Please answer the form honestly and thoroughly. We're building something long-term, and we're looking for someone who wants to build it with us.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
The Role

We are looking for an experienced part-time Graphic Designer (approximately 4 hours per day)  with at least 2 years of experience specifically within the promotional products and branded merchandise industry.

This is a hands-on role combining creative design, production artwork, merchandise mockups, and client presentations.

You’ll work closely with our sales team to turn ideas into polished concepts that help our clients visualize their brands in fresh, stylish, retail-inspired ways.

Some projects will require creativity and concept development. Others will require speed and technical accuracy — such as vectorizing a logo, preparing embroidery artwork, or creating a quick client mockup.

We need someone who is comfortable doing both.



What You'll Do

• Create stylish, retail-inspired graphics for branded apparel and merchandise

• Develop creative merchandise concepts based on client brands, campaigns, events, and audiences

• Create quick and polished product mockups for our sales team

• Build attractive idea decks and client presentations featuring merchandise concepts

• Convert logos and artwork into clean, production-ready vector files

• Prepare or convert artwork for embroidery/DST production

• Clean up and recreate low-resolution client artwork

• Prepare production-ready artwork for screen printing, embroidery, heat transfer, and other decoration methods

• Apply client branding accurately across apparel, drinkware, bags, accessories, packaging, print, and other merchandise

• Follow client brand guidelines while still bringing fresh creative ideas to the table

• Work collaboratively with our sales team and respond quickly to design requests

• Organize and maintain design files so artwork can easily move from concept to production

What We're Looking For

Required:

• 2+ years of experience working specifically in promotional products, branded merchandise, or a closely related industry

• Strong Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop skills

• Excellent vector artwork skills

• Experience creating merchandise and apparel mockups

• Experience preparing production-ready artwork

• Understanding of common decoration methods and their artwork requirements

• Ability to create or work with embroidery/DST files

• Strong typography, layout, color, and composition skills

• Ability to build professional client-facing presentations or idea decks

• Strong creative taste with an understanding of current retail, apparel, merchandise, and design trends

• Ability to work quickly without sacrificing attention to detail

• Reliable high-speed internet suitable for video calls and transferring large artwork files

• Strong written English communication skills

• Ability to overlap with our U.S. business hours for an agreed-upon portion of the workday

Bonus Skills:

• Experience with Adobe InDesign

• Experience with CommonSku

• Experience creating custom graphics

• Experience with packaging or unboxing concepts

• Knowledge of promotional product suppliers and product categories

• Experience working directly with promotional product distributors or their sales teams

What Great Looks Like in This Role



You can receive a request like:

"Our client is hosting a summer sales meeting in Nashville. They want elevated merchandise their employees will actually use. Give us some ideas."

…and turn it into a polished presentation with great products, thoughtful branding applications, attractive mockups, and a cohesive visual direction.

At the same time, if our salesperson sends you a low-resolution JPG and says, "Can you vectorize this logo and mock it up on this hat?" you can turn it around quickly and accurately.

We value creativity, speed, communication, reliability, and great taste.



Portfolio Required

Please include a portfolio with your application.

We are particularly interested in seeing:

• Branded merchandise

• Apparel graphics

• Merchandise mockups

• Client presentations/idea decks

• Logo/vector recreation

• Embroidery-related artwork

• Retail-inspired graphic design

Please identify which portfolio pieces were created entirely by you and explain your role in any collaborative projects.

To Apply

Please submit:

1. Your portfolio

2. A brief description of your experience in the promotional products/branded merchandise industry

3. The promotional products companies or types of clients you have worked with

4. The design programs you use

5. Your experience with vector artwork and DST/embroidery files

6. Your typical working hours and time zone

7. Your available hours per week

8. Your hourly rate

9. Your internet speed (download/upload)

10. Your computer specifications

mbers

title: Video Editor – Social Media & Content (Remote, Project-Based)
description:
READ THE ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING.



WE DO NOT READ FORM-LETTER APPLICATIONS. Lazy, copy-paste submissions won't get you anywhere with us.



APPLICANTS WHO COMPLETE EVERY APPLICATION QUESTION — INCLUDING THE BONUS — ARE PRIORITIZED FOR A RESPONSE.



ABOUT ICE CREAM SUNSHINE

Ice Cream Sunshine is a good-vibes signature ice cream tour and special events company based in Chicago, Illinois. We take guests on curated walking tours through Chicago's neighborhoods, treat them to delicious ice cream at local shops, share fun facts about the city, and create joyful shared experiences along the way. Good vibes are the core of who we are — and that extends to every person on our team.



Beyond our tours, we're building an experience brand with a fast-growing content and social presence — ice cream reviews, tour highlights, and lifestyle content reaching audiences on YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and
.



GOOD VIBES ONLY COMPANY

We believe in good vibes, respect, value, appreciation, and fun as a company culture. We perform with excellence and have a good time along the way. Everyone on our team — full-time, part-time, or contractor — contributes to a culture people are proud to be part of. We celebrate birthdays, we laugh a lot, and we take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously.



THE ROLE

We're building an editing team that can help us consistently publish 18–21 high-quality videos per week (up to 3 per day) across our channels — without ever sacrificing story, pacing, or brand feel. You'll be editing content featuring our founder reviewing and reacting to ice cream, tour highlights, and behind-the-scenes footage, produced for both long-form and short-form formats.



This is a partnership, not a task. Our founder has a distinct, quirky, fun on-camera personality, and the right editor develops a genuine feel for that energy and brings creative instincts to every cut. You become the reason great content actually gets out the door, consistently and on time.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Edit ice cream review videos featuring our founder tasting, reacting to, and talking about products — tone is quirky, warm, and fun

- Produce long-form content (horizontal, 1–10 minutes) and short-form content (vertical, under 2 minutes for Reels, Shorts, and TikTok)

- Edit tour highlight and behind-the-scenes content from ICS events and tours

- Add captions, text overlays, transitions, music, sound design, and color grading that match our brand tone

- Deliver content optimized for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and

- Maintain overlapping availability with the team from 9:00 AM–5:00 PM CDT for collaboration

- Join our weekly team check-in, Tuesdays at 2:00 PM CDT

- Suggest edits, pacing changes, and creative ideas that improve retention and engagement

- Meet turnaround timelines reliably and communicate proactively on progress



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Proven video editing experience — portfolio or sample work required

- Strong proficiency in professional editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve preferred)

- Experience editing short-form vertical content for social media (Reels, TikToks, Shorts)

description:
Part-Time CPA — Periodic Financial Review (Remote)

As-needed engagement · Approximately monthly cadence · Fully remote



ABOUT DENTAL ASSISTED

Dental AssistEd is a Chicago-based occupational certificate program that trains and credentials dental assistants. We operate both a for-profit division and an affiliated nonprofit entity, and we're looking for a steady financial partner who can help us keep both in good order without requiring day-to-day bookkeeping support.



POSITION OVERVIEW

We're seeking a licensed CPA for a part-time, as-needed role focused on periodic “big-picture” financial check-ins rather than routine bookkeeping. Our books are already maintained in QuickBooks; we need an experienced set of eyes to review the numbers, confirm everything is accurate and compliant, and flag anything that needs attention before it becomes a problem. This is a great fit for a CPA who wants flexible, recurring part-time work without the demands of a full engagement.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Log in to QuickBooks roughly once a month to review transactions, reconciliations, and account balances for both the for-profit and nonprofit entities

• Spot-check for coding errors, misclassifications, or unusual activity and flag discrepancies

• Confirm the nonprofit entity's books properly separate restricted vs. unrestricted funds

• Provide a brief summary of findings and any recommended corrections after each review

• Perform a deeper review at quarter-end and year-end, and help ensure we're on track for tax filings and, for the nonprofit, annual filings such as Form 990

• Serve as an on-call resource we can reach out to with occasional financial or accounting questions



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Active CPA license in good standing

• Hands-on experience with QuickBooks (QuickBooks Online preferred)

• Comfort working across both standard (for-profit) and nonprofit/fund accounting

• Solid grounding in GAAP and general financial statement review

• Self-directed and comfortable with a low-touch, remote, as-needed arrangement

• Prior experience supporting small businesses, education providers, or nonprofits is a plus



SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION

Commitment: A few hours per month, with additional time at quarter-end and year-end

Location: Remote — all work can be done off-site



Compensation: Hourly, commensurate with experience (rate to be discussed)

Start Date: Flexible



HOW TO APPLY

Please send a brief note along with your resume and CPA license information to 
 us know your hourly rate expectations and your experience with nonprofit or fund accounting.

title: Shopify Expert Developer & E-Commerce Optimization Specialist
description:
Shopify Developer & E-Commerce Optimization Specialist



Remote, Philippines | Project-Based With Potential for Ongoing Work







Chicago-based fine jewelry house rooted in art, design, and culture. We are strengthening our direct-to-consumer business and looking for an experienced Shopify developer to improve the performance of our existing website.



This is not a redesign. We want to retain our visual identity while improving the customer journey, product discovery, SEO, conversion, and ease of website management.



The Role



This is a hands-on technical and e-commerce role. You will identify the improvements most likely to increase qualified traffic and sales, prioritize them within our budget, and personally implement the approved work.



We are not looking for a general website audit, an AI-generated list of recommendations, or someone who relies on installing multiple apps. We need a specialist who can work directly within Shopify, solve problems, improve the existing theme, and demonstrate measurable results.



The scope includes the homepage, collection pages, product pages, About Us pages, E journal, cart, and checkout journey.



Responsibilities

Review the existing Shopify theme, apps, catalog structure, navigation, mobile experience, site speed, SEO, analytics, and conversion journey

Identify and prioritize improvements according to revenue impact, urgency, implementation time, and cost

Personally implement approved changes within Shopify

Improve the existing theme without proposing an unnecessary redesign

Optimize navigation, product discovery, merchandising, calls to action, and mobile usability

Improve collection mapping, product tags, filters, metafields, naming conventions, and related-product recommendations

Strengthen product and collection pages to communicate essential information and support conversion

Improve the connection between brand storytelling, journal editorial content, and products

Resolve issues involving sizing, variants, availability, sold-out products, preorder, and made-to-order products

Improve technical and on-page SEO while protecting existing URLs and search value

Optimize page speed and image performance

Reduce friction across the cart and checkout journey

Verify Shopify analytics, GA4, Meta Pixel, and key conversion events

Establish baseline performance and measure the results of implemented changes

Test all work across mobile and desktop devices

Document changes and train the internal team to manage routine website updates

Required Experience

At least three years of hands-on Shopify development experience

A portfolio of live Shopify websites you personally improved

Strong knowledge of Shopify themes, Liquid, HTML, CSS, metafields, collections, product templates, and app integrations

Ability to modify and troubleshoot an existing Shopify theme

Experience organizing and optimizing a large product catalog

Understanding of conversion-rate optimization, mobile commerce, and technical SEO

Experience with Shopify analytics, GA4, Meta Pixel, and conversion tracking

Ability to evaluate whether a solution requires custom development, an app, or a native Shopify feature

Strong attention to detail and visual consistency

Excellent written and spoken English

Ability to work independently and provide clear, proactive progress updates

Availability for regular overlap with Chicago business hours



Experience with luxury, fashion, fine jewelry, or another high-consideration product category is strongly preferred.



What Success Looks Like

Approved improvements are implemented, tested, and functioning correctly

Customers can navigate collections and find relevant products more easily

Product information, availability, sizing, and purchasing options are clear

Mobile speed and usability improve

Brand and editorial content lead customers naturally toward product discovery

Add-to-cart rate, checkout completion, conversion, organic traffic, and revenue improve

The internal team can manage routine website updates without developer support

New apps and recurring costs are introduced only when clearly justified

Initial Project



The selected specialist will begin with a defined optimization sprint:



Review the website, analytics, theme, apps, and product structure

Establish baseline performance

Present a prioritized implementation roadmap based on impact, effort, and cost

Implement the approved high-priority improvements

Complete mobile and desktop testing

Verify analytics and conversion tracking

Document the work and provide a recorded handover

Report on performance following implementation



Strong performance may lead to ongoing Shopify development and optimization work.



How to Apply



Please include:



Two or three live Shopify websites where you personally implemented improvements

A clear description of what you personally coded or configured on each website

Before-and-after results, including conversion, speed, revenue, SEO, or usability improvements where available

An example of a Shopify problem you solved without adding another app

Your experience with collections, metafields, product templates, SEO, analytics, and conversion tracking

Your hourly rate or fixed-project pricing

Your availability and possible overlap with Chicago business hours





Applications containing only a generic agency introduction, an automated website audit, or recommendations without evidence of personal implementation will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a small paid Shopify task before the full project is awarded.

Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading. We're doing it with a technology-forward approach, actively developing the AI infrastructure that will make this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

The Manager, Billing & Financial Operations is the operational owner of MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions' non-CA financial transaction engine — the function that ensures every invoice goes out accurately, every payment gets applied, every vendor gets paid, and every manifest and billing record is reconciled and audit-ready.



This is a 1st-line management role for a detail-obsessed, process-driven leader who has run billing and collections teams before. You are not just doing the work — you are building the systems, the SOPs, and the team discipline that make the work run without constant supervision. You manage the specialists; you own the numbers; you report up to leadership with clean, confident data.

Billing Operations & Transaction Processing

• Ensure all billing records align with service agreements, contracts, and pricing structures — identifying and correcting discrepancies before they reach the client or vendor

Collections & Accounts Receivable Management

• Own the collections process: proactively work aging receivables, contact clients with outstanding balances through defined outreach workflows, and escalate chronic non-payers through the appropriate path

• Escalate issues and risks to leadership proactively — full transparency, clean data, solution-first framing

Assist prospects with scheduling, rescheduling, or canceling property tours.

Ensure every lead is associated with the correct property and accurately entered into AppFolio.

Maintain complete and organized notes for every prospect interaction.

Follow up consistently with prospective residents throughout the leasing process to reduce missed opportunities.

AI Leasing and Inquiry Triage

Monitor inquiries that cannot be resolved by the company's AI leasing assistant or automated workflows.

Review each escalated inquiry and determine whether to answer it directly or route it to the appropriate Property Manager.

Escalate sensitive, unusual, legal, screening-related, or policy-specific questions without making unauthorized decisions.

Identify frequently asked questions and recurring issues that should be added to the company's approved FAQ or knowledge base.

Work with management to improve standard responses and make automated leasing workflows more accurate and effective over time.

Phone and Communication Support

Communicate clearly, confidently, and professionally with prospective and current residents.

Capture complete caller information, identify the relevant property, qualify the inquiry, and document the interaction in AppFolio.

Route urgent or specialized matters to the correct team member and follow through until the handoff is completed.

Follow-Up and Operational Reporting

Monitor inquiries and tasks assigned to Property Managers and follow up when responses are overdue.

Track unresolved, high-priority, and time-sensitive leads to ensure they receive timely attention.

Produce practical daily or weekly reports on lead volume, response times, unresolved inquiries, scheduled tours, follow-up status, and conversion activity.

Identify gaps, delays, and recurring operational problems and communicate them to management.

Help create consistent processes that improve accountability across the leasing team.

Future Property Management Support

Assist with resident inquiries, lease-renewal follow-up, and resident satisfaction initiatives as needed.

Support maintenance coordination by documenting requests, assessing urgency based on approved guidelines, and routing work orders appropriately.

Follow up with residents, vendors, and Property Managers regarding open maintenance items when assigned.

Provide additional administrative and operational support to the property management team as the role develops.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

Hands-on experience using AppFolio for lead management, resident communication, task tracking, or property management operations.

Strong understanding of the residential leasing process, from initial inquiry through qualification, showing, application, and handoff.

Excellent spoken and written English, with the confidence to handle inbound calls professionally.

Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records across multiple properties and communication channels.

Sound judgment and the ability to distinguish between questions that can be answered using approved information and matters requiring escalation.

Strong follow-up, organization, time-management, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work independently, take initiative, and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Reliable internet connection, professional remote-work environment, and availability during required U.S. business hours.

title: Business Development & Revenue Systems Lead
description:
HireWolf is seeking a remote Business Development & Revenue Systems Lead to support prospecting, outbound outreach, follow-up, and the rebuild of the CRM, pipeline, and sales playbook from existing assets for a local lead-generation business. This role is designed for a sales professional who can run that motion independently, keep pipeline and reporting current, and escalate offer, pricing, targeting strategy, and close decisions to Leadership. After a year, this person has the model and existing sales assets organized, with CRM, outreach cadence, follow-up, proposal workflow, playbook, and weekly reporting in active use, and with qualified prospects contacted, conversations booked, proposals sent, signed clients, and visible progress toward break-even.



Engagement Model



This is a remote role with an expected workload of up to 40 hours per week, working with Leadership on daily direction, review, and feedback. The Business Development & Revenue Systems Lead must be available from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time for outreach, calls, and same-day follow-up. Strategy, offers, and priorities stay with Leadership at the start. Scope may expand only when business need, role capacity, performance, and leadership approval all support the change.



Responsibilities



- Research target niches, cities, service areas, and local businesses, then build targeted prospect lists.

- Run outbound campaigns by
, phone, and LinkedIn, personalizing each touch from the prospect, niche, market, and available proof.

- Follow up until each prospect is closed, paused, or disqualified, and log activity, responses, objections, next steps, and outcomes in the CRM.

- Book discovery and demo calls, and prepare Leadership with prospect context, materials, and open questions before each conversation.

- Draft proposals, one-page summaries, follow-up
s, and sales materials tailored to the prospect's business, niche, location, and needs.

- Move qualified prospects from first contact toward a signed client, including post-call notes, action items, and client handoff after a win.

- Rebuild CRM workflows, pipeline stages, lead statuses, follow-up reminders, and sales reporting from existing assets and Leadership direction.

- Turn existing scripts, proposal templates, FAQs, agreements, and outreach materials into a practical sales playbook.

- Document workflows for lead sourcing, research, outreach, qualification, demo preparation, proposal follow-up, client handoff, and reporting.

- Record which niches, cities, and customer profiles respond, track objections and buying signals, and recommend messaging, proof, offer, and material changes to Leadership.

- Use AI for research, drafting, personalization, and summaries, then review the output before it reaches a prospect or the CRM. Offer, pricing, and close decisions stay with Leadership.

- Protect prospect and client information in CRM records and sales files, and escalate data, access, or commitment issues to Leadership promptly.

- Execute assigned pipeline, outbound, follow-up, proposal, and CRM work only after the primary sales motion is functioning and Leadership assigns it.



Required Qualifications



- Experience owning outbound sales execution: prospecting, outreach, follow-up, and the rebuild of CRM and playbook from existing assets, running that motion independently, keeping pipeline and reporting current, and escalating offer, pricing, targeting strategy, and close decisions to Leadership.

- Ability to research local businesses by niche and city, read response and objection patterns, and turn those into targeting and messaging recommendations Leadership can act on.

- Judgment to d
 which prospects to pursue, when to pause or disqualify, and when an AI draft is accurate and specific enough to send.

- Familiarity with a CRM, spreadsheets,
, phone, and LinkedIn for outreach, pipeline tracking, and reporting; comfort using AI for research, list-building, drafting, personalization, and summaries; and willingness to learn the stack Leadership selects.

- Ability to operate with incomplete systems, dormant assets, and changing targeting, turning Leadership direction into daily execution and improving the process as results come in.

- Clear written and spoken English for outbound
, phone, LinkedIn, call prep with Leadership, proposals, and weekly reporting.



Preferred Qualifications



- Experience running outbound sales or appointment setting.

- Experience with local service businesses, local SEO, Google Business Profile, or lead-generation offers.

- Experience setting up CRM pipelines, stages, reminders, and sales reporting.

- Experience writing or improving sales scripts, outreach sequences, or proposal templates.

- Experience working with U.S.-based companies or buyers.

- Experience in a remote seat with limited day-to-day supervision.



Why This Role



Remote work on a required 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time schedule, up to 40 hours a week, for a sales professional who owns prospecting, outreach, follow-up, and the rebuild of CRM and playbook from existing assets.



Opportunity for continued work and expanded responsibilities when business need, role capacity, performance, and leadership approval all support the change.



Work with Leadership on daily direction, review, and feedback, with strategy, offers, and priorities set by Leadership at the start.



Hours



Expected workload is up to 40 hours per week, with required availability from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time for outreach, calls, and same-day follow-up.



Pay



Compensation will be based on experience, role fit, and agreed weekly scope.

title: Client Success Manager -- USA Marketing Agency
description:
JOB TITLE: Client Success Manager — Part-Time, Remote



We're hiring a Client Success Manager for a US-based marketing agency. You'll be the main point of contact for our clients — US business owners who count on clear communication, quick follow-up, and someone who really knows their account.



You'll manage a handful of clients at once, keep them informed, and be the bridge between them and our internal team. It's a real role with real responsibility, but we're a tight-knit team and we'll have your back.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Manage a book of client accounts as their main point of contact

- Send weekly performance updates and monthly reports

- Join and sometimes lead strategy calls

- Monitor ad results and catch issues before clients notice

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Comfortable on video calls with US business owners

- Proactive — you don't wait to be asked

GoHighLevel, Slack, Loom, Google Workspace, Meta Ads Manager (reading reports only). 

Experience with any is a plus. Cleaning or home services industry experience is a bonus.

Job description:

Position Summary

The Setup Loan Specialist is responsible for performing detailed quality control reviews on mortgage loan files to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with underwriting guidelines. This role also manages the loan pipeline from setup through funding and post-closing, ensuring all files progress efficiently and that processors meet key milestones at every stage. The position plays a critical role in verifying that borrowers meet eligibility requirements, including accurate income calculation and proper loan product selection, throughout the loan lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Conduct thorough reviews of loan files to confirm all required documentation is complete, accurate, and properly executed

Calculate and validate borrower income (including complex scenarios such as self-employed, variable income, and multiple income streams)

Analyze borrower income, assets, credit, and liabilities to ensure qualification per program guidelines

Verify loan data integrity against supporting documentation (e.g., income calculations, AUS findings, disclosures)

Ensure compliance with investor, agency, and regulatory requirements

Identify discrepancies, missing documentation, or red flags and communicate findings to loan officers/processors

Review automated underwriting system (AUS) findings and ensure conditions are addressed

Apply strong product knowledge to confirm appropriate loan program selection and eligibility (Conventional, FHA, VA, and other products)

Validate loan structure, including loan-to-value (LTV), debt-to-income (DTI), and product eligibility

Manage assigned loan pipeline from setup through funding and post-closing

Monitor processor performance to ensure all milestone deadlines are met across the full loan lifecycle (disclosures, submission, approval, conditions, closing, funding, and post-closing)

Proactively follow up with processors and cross-functional teams to keep loans on track, resolve bottlenecks, and escalate delays as needed

Ensure all final conditions, closing requirements, and post-closing documentation are completed accurately and on time

Maintain quality control checklists and audit trails for each file

Collaborate with processing, underwriting, closing, and post-closing teams to resolve issues efficiently

Stay current on mortgage guidelines, compliance regulations, and internal policies

Qualifications

1+ years of experience in mortgage loan processing, underwriting, or quality control

Proven ability to calculate and analyze borrower income accurately across multiple income types

Strong product knowledge, including Conventional, FHA, VA, and other mortgage programs

Knowledge of credit analysis, asset review, and loan structuring

Familiarity with AUS systems such as DU (Desktop Underwriter) and LP (Loan Product Advisor)

High attention to detail and strong analytical skills

Ability to manage a full pipeline and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment

Strong communication and problem-solving skills

Proficiency in mortgage LOS systems (e.g., Encompass, Calyx, etc.) and Microsoft Office

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in pre-underwriting or pre-funding QC

Knowledge of federal and state compliance regulations (TRID, RESPA, etc.)

DE/VA underwriting experience (a plus, not required)

Work Environment

Office or remote environment depending on company policy

Standard business hours with potential for overtime based on pipeline volume

Knowledge of compliance regulations (TRID, RESPA, HMDA).

Experience working with retail or wholesale channels.

Excellent written and spoken English communication skills (C1 Advanced or higher)

Availability to work during U.S. business hours (night shift)

A stable work-from-home setup, including high-speed internet, a reliable computer, and a quiet work environment

Starting Base salary: $1,100 - $1,500/month*

Step-Up Increase: Eligible for a salary increase after successful completion of a 90-day introductory period, based on performance and training milestones
