title: SEO & AEO Manager
description:
Company: Engage365

 Location: Remote — Philippines

 Hours: 12–15 hours per week to start

 Rate: $8–$10 USD/hour, depending on experience

 Schedule: Flexible, with some availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours

About Engage365

Engage365 is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency helping businesses grow through digital marketing, content, paid advertising, SEO, automation, and AI-powered solutions.

We recently completed a company rebrand and are now focused on significantly growing our own organic search presence across both traditional search engines and AI-powered search platforms.

We’re looking for an experienced SEO & AEO Manager who can take ownership of this initiative, develop the strategy, execute the work independently, and help us build a scalable SEO/AEO function over time.

About the Role

This is a hands-on, part-time position for someone who can independently own both SEO strategy and execution.

We are not looking for a general virtual assistant or someone who needs to be given a weekly checklist of SEO tasks.

We want someone who can review our website and performance data, identify opportunities, determine what should be prioritized, execute the work, monitor results, and proactively tell us what should happen next.

Management will provide business context, approvals, and resources when needed, but you will be the SEO/AEO expert and will own the day-to-day function.

Initially, the role will focus primarily on Engage365’s own SEO/AEO strategy.

If the internal program is successful, the role may expand over time into supporting SEO/AEO for Engage365 clients across a variety of industries.

Our Primary Goals



Increase qualified organic traffic

Generate more organic leads

Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords

Increase non-branded organic visibility

Build topical authority around our core services

Improve national search visibility

Improve visibility across AI-powered search and answer engines

Build a repeatable SEO/AEO process that can eventually scale to client accounts



What You’ll Own

SEO Strategy & Research



Conduct an initial SEO audit and establish current performance benchmarks

Develop a prioritized 90-day SEO/AEO roadmap

Conduct keyword, competitor, search-intent, and content-gap research

Identify high-intent commercial keyword opportunities

Develop strategies for both local and national search visibility

Build national/non-local keyword strategies where appropriate

Determine which service pages, landing pages, and content should be prioritized

Identify opportunities using Google Search Console, ranking data, competitor data, and business value

Continuously adjust priorities based on performance

Build and strengthen topical authority around Engage365’s services

On-Page SEO



Optimize page titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, images, and website copy

Improve page structure and search-intent alignment

Optimize existing service and landing pages

Identify opportunities for new commercial service and landing pages

Build and improve internal linking

Improve topical relationships between pages

Strengthen content architecture

Make recommendations that improve both rankings and user experience

Technical SEO



Monitor indexing and crawlability

Identify technical SEO issues

Monitor sitemap and indexing health

Identify broken links, redirects, duplicate content, canonical issues, and other SEO problems

Implement appropriate schema and structured data

Monitor Core Web Vitals and site performance from an SEO perspective

Review internal linking and site architecture

Identify migration or rebrand-related SEO issues when applicable

Clearly document larger technical issues for our development team when necessary

You are not expected to be a web developer.

You should, however, be able to identify technical SEO problems, handle reasonable SEO implementations independently, and clearly explain development requirements when additional support is needed.

Content Strategy & Optimization



Develop an SEO-focused content strategy

Identify topics based on search opportunity, competition, business value, and user intent

Build topical clusters around our services

Develop content that supports national and non-local search visibility

Create content briefs and outlines

Optimize new content before publication

Refresh and improve existing content

Ensure content satisfies search intent

Identify opportunities for commercial, informational, comparison, and decision-stage content

Use AI tools appropriately to improve efficiency while maintaining quality

Help ensure content sounds natural, useful, differentiated, and written for a U.S. audience

This is not primarily a high-volume blog-writing position.

Your responsibility is making sure our content strategy supports qualified organic growth and that the content we publish is strategically valuable and properly optimized.

AEO / GEO / AI Search Optimization

A major part of this role will be helping Engage365 adapt to the changing search landscape.

You will:



Develop and implement AEO/GEO strategies

Optimize content for AI-powered search and answer engines

Research opportunities to increase visibility in platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI experiences, Perplexity, and other emerging platforms

Structure content so important questions are answered clearly, directly, and accurately

Identify opportunities for FAQ, comparison, definition, service, and answer-focused content

Improve entity signals and topical authority

Implement appropriate structured data

Strengthen brand authority and trust signals

Identify opportunities for original insights, expert input, supporting data, and unique information

Monitor brand and competitor visibility across AI-search platforms where practical

Use available AI-visibility tools where appropriate

Test strategies and document what appears to improve AI-search visibility

Stay current on developments in AEO, GEO, and AI-powered search

Recommend new strategies as the industry evolves

We understand that AEO/GEO is an evolving field and that measurement is still developing.

We are not looking for someone who promises guaranteed rankings, AI citations, or placement in ChatGPT.

We want someone who understands how search is changing, stays informed, tests strategies, measures what can reasonably be measured, and applies what is working.

Authority & Off-Page SEO



Monitor our backlink profile

Research competitor backlinks

Identify high-quality backlink opportunities

Support authority-building strategies for national SEO

Identify relevant directories, citations, partnerships, editorial opportunities, and other authority-building sources

Conduct limited outreach when appropriate

Evaluate backlink quality rather than focusing on volume

Avoid spammy, low-quality, or potentially harmful link-building tactics

High-volume backlink outreach and full-scale digital PR are not the primary focus of this role, but you should understand how authority and referring domains contribute to competitive national SEO.

Analytics & Reporting



Monitor Google Search Console

Monitor GA4

Track keyword rankings

Track organic traffic

Track organic leads and conversions

Track non-branded search visibility

Monitor important commercial pages

Monitor pages gaining or losing visibility

Monitor referring domains and authority signals

Monitor AI/AEO visibility where practical

Maintain a record of SEO/AEO work completed

Use performance data to determine future priorities

You will provide a concise monthly report explaining:



What was completed

What changed

What is improving

What isn’t improving

Opportunities or problems identified

What you recommend prioritizing next

We don’t want a 40-page automated SEO report.

We want to clearly understand:

What we’re seeing → Why it matters → What we’re doing → What should happen next.

What Success Looks Like

We’re hiring this person to grow qualified organic visibility and lead generation for Engage365 while building a repeatable SEO/AEO process.

Over time, we expect to see measurable improvements in:



Qualified organic traffic

Non-branded search visibility

Rankings for high-intent commercial keywords

National organic visibility

Organic leads and conversions

Performance of important service pages

Overall technical SEO health

Topical authority

Quality referring domains

AI/answer-engine visibility where it can reasonably be measured

We understand that SEO takes time and do not expect immediate rankings or lead growth within the first few weeks.

We care about long-term business results, not simply publishing a certain number of articles or completing a certain number of SEO tasks each month.

Required Qualifications



Fluent written and spoken English — REQUIRED

Excellent English writing, editing, and communication skills

Ability to write and edit naturally for a U.S. audience

3+ years of hands-on SEO experience preferred

Experience independently managing SEO for a business website

Demonstrated experience developing and executing national SEO strategies

Experience competing for non-local and commercial search terms

Strong understanding of on-page SEO

Working knowledge of technical SEO

Strong keyword and competitor research skills

Strong understanding of search intent

Experience with Google Search Console

Experience with Google Analytics 4

Experience with SEMrush, Ahrefs, or comparable SEO platforms

Understanding of schema and structured data

Understanding of internal linking and website architecture

Understanding of SEO content strategy

Working experience with AEO/GEO and AI-powered search optimization

Experience implementing and evaluating AEO/GEO tactics

Familiarity with AI-search visibility measurement or tools

Comfortable using AI tools as part of an SEO workflow

Ability to research problems and make recommendations independently

Strong organizational and time-management skills

Ability to prioritize SEO initiatives based on expected impact rather than simply completing task lists

Nice to Have

Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required:



Digital marketing agencies

B2B or SMB marketing

Local SEO

WordPress or similar CMS platforms

Conversion rate optimization

Backlink research

Website migrations or rebrands

Digital PR or authority-building strategy

AI-search visibility tools

Marketing automation or AI-related businesses

The Person We’re Looking For

We want someone who is comfortable coming to us and saying:

“Here’s what I’m seeing, here’s why it matters, and here’s what I recommend we do next.”

Rather than:

“What SEO tasks would you like me to work on this week?”

You will have access to management for questions, approvals, business context, and resources, but we’re hiring you because you are the SEO/AEO expert.

You should be:



Proactive

Analytical

Strategic

Curious

Reliable

Detail-oriented

Organized

Comfortable working independently

Comfortable prioritizing competing opportunities

Willing to test and experiment

Interested in how AI is changing search

Comfortable challenging or improving an existing process when you see a better approach

Compensation & Schedule

This is a long-term, part-time independent contractor position.

Starting rate: $8–$10 USD/hour, depending on experience.

We expect approximately 12–15 hours per week to start.

There is potential for additional hours and increased compensation over time based on performance, results, and business needs.

Your work schedule can generally be flexible, although some availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours will be required for occasional communication and meetings.

How to Apply

Please
 your application directly to:



Use the subject line:

SEO & AEO Manager Application – [Your Name]

Your application must include:



A brief introduction about yourself and your SEO experience

Your resume

Your portfolio, if available

2–3 websites you have personally worked on and exactly what you were responsible for

One SEO result you’re particularly proud of, including what you did and the results achieved

At least one example of a national SEO campaign you personally worked on

What business or industry was it?

What market or geographic area were you targeting?

What were you personally responsible for?

What strategy did you implement?

What measurable results did you achieve?



The SEO tools you regularly use

Your experience with AEO/GEO and AI-search optimization

Specific examples of AEO/GEO tactics you have personally implemented

How you currently measure or evaluate AI-search visibility

Your experience using AI tools as part of your SEO workflow

Your current weekly availability

Your requested hourly rate

Please also briefly respond to this question:

If you took over SEO/AEO for a marketing agency that recently completed a full rebrand, had done very little SEO since the rebrand, and wanted to compete nationally for high-intent commercial keywords, what would you focus on during your first 30 days and why?Important

Fluent written and spoken English is required for this position.

To confirm that you’ve read the entire job posting, please begin your
 with the words:

Organic Growth

Applications that do not include a resume and the requested information may not be considered.

We’re looking for someone proactive, organized, dependable, and very strong at follow-through.This is not a traditional Virtual Assistant role where you wait each morning for a list of tasks. We want someone who can take ownership, think through next steps, keep track of loose ends, and make sure things actually get completed.



What You’ll Help With



* Managing calendars and scheduling meetings, appointments, and personal commitments

* Keeping track of deadlines, renewals, deliverables, and important dates

* Organizing and helping manage

* Drafting routine
s and following up on outstanding items

* Coordinating with accountants, lawyers, advisors, vendors, and other professionals

If one of us says, “I need to get my car serviced sometime soon,” we want someone who can figure out the next steps, coordinate with our schedule, organize the appointment, and make sure it gets handled.

* Are extremely organized and detail-oriented

* Follow through without repeated reminders

* Work well independently

* Have excellent written and spoken English

* Have good judgment and can prioritize effectively

* Are discreet and trustworthy

* Learn new software and systems quickly

Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Executive Personal Assistant, Senior Executive Assistant, or assistant to a founder/business owner is strongly preferred.



Experience working with a North American employer is an asset.

We strongly prefer someone who has already worked North American hours and is looking for one stable, long-term position.

1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your experience supporting executives, founders, business owners, or families

3. How many years you have worked remotely

4. Whether you have previously worked North American hours

**1. One of us tells you, “I need to get my car serviced sometime soon.” What would you do next?**



**2. It is Monday morning. We have an important meeting in two hours, a document due tomorrow, a flight later this week that has not been booked, several unread
s, and people waiting for replies. How would you prioritize the morning?**



**3. Tell us about a time you noticed something needed to be done before your employer asked you to do it. What did you do?**



We’re looking for someone capable, trustworthy, and genuinely interested in becoming a long-term part of how our family and businesses stay organized.

title: Publishing & Book Marketing Manager — Long-Term Fiction Series
description:
I'm looking for someone experienced with indie publishing and book marketing who can take over as much of that side of my business as possible so I can concentrate on writing.



The Perfection Cycle is a planned 10-book speculative-fiction series published under the pen name K.C. Finehope. Books 1–3 are completely finished and ready to publish, and Book 4 is well underway.



Book 1 is already set up on StoryOrigin with current review copies. The author website and MailerLite account are also set up, and I've previously published through Amazon KDP.



I don't need someone to teach me how to self-publish. I could learn the marketing side myself, but I don't want to spend my time doing that when I could be writing the next book. I'm looking for someone who already understands this business and can eventually run most of the publishing and marketing operation with minimal direction from me.



What I need



The immediate priority is getting Book 1 moving: StoryOrigin promotions, ARC/reviewer recruitment and follow-up, newsletter swaps, mailing-list growth, promotional opportunities, social media, and preparation for the KDP launch.



Books 2 and 3 are already finished, so this will quickly become series marketing rather than a one-book project.



Depending on your experience, I'd eventually like you to handle as much as possible of the following:



StoryOrigin and BookFunnel

ARC/review-team recruitment and management

MailerLite and
 marketing

Newsletter swaps and group promotions

KDP management

Metadata, categories and keywords

Launch and release strategy

Kindle Unlimited strategy

Pricing and promotions

Series read-through

Social media management and audience growth

Amazon Ads and Meta Ads

Promotional opportunities and outreach

Tracking results and adjusting the strategy based on what is actually working



You don't need to be an expert in every item on that list. I'd rather have someone be honest about what they know well and where they might eventually recommend bringing in outside expertise.



What matters most is that you understand indie publishing and book marketing, can work independently, and are comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting for me to provide a task list every day.



Why I want to move quickly



The series deals heavily with AI, synthetic companions, human/AI integration, labor displacement, relationships, and the social consequences of technological change.



Some things I originally wrote as speculative fiction are already beginning to happen in the real world. Reality is starting to catch up with the books, and I don't want them sitting on my hard drive while that happens.



That's one reason I already have three books finished before launching the series properly, and why I'm looking for someone who can start moving the marketing side forward while I continue writing.



Long-term opportunity



This isn't a one-book gig.



There are ten books planned, and I'm looking for someone who could potentially stay with the series for years. This will remain a part-time position, with the workload naturally increasing around launches and decreasing between releases.



Ideally, I want to reach the point where you run this side of the business and I write the books.



The posted hourly range is intentionally broad. For the right person, I'm open to discussing a compensation structure that includes meaningful long-term upside in addition to hourly pay. I'm interested in finding someone who wants to help build the series over time and benefit from its success, not simply complete a short-term assignment.



When you apply



Please tell me:



How much of the publishing and marketing operation described above you would be comfortable handling yourself.

With Books 1–3 ready and StoryOrigin already set up, what would you focus on first?

What experience you've had working with indie fiction authors, book launches, or ongoing author marketing.



You don't need to claim you can do everything. I'm much more interested in finding someone experienced, capable, reliable, and interested in building something long term than someone who checks every box.

title: Real Estate Acquisitions (+Bonuses!)
description:
Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist (Remote)



About Us

Price Real Estate Investments is a multi-market U.S. based real estate investment company focused on acquiring off-market properties directly from homeowners. We specialize in building strong relationships with sellers, negotiating with them, and closing deals virtually. Our team is fully remote, but our impact is nationwide — and we’re growing quickly.



We’re looking for an experienced Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist to join our acquisitions team. This role is critical to our business: you’ll be speaking directly with homeowners, negotiating terms, and guiding sellers through the contract signing process. If you’ve personally made offers to sellers and closed contracts over the phone, this is an opportunity to put your skills to work in a high-energy, professional environment.



Compensation

$10/hour USD base pay



Plus Monthly Contract Bonuses for getting offers accepted:

• Bronze: 2 signed contracts = $500 bonus

• Silver: 3 signed contracts = $1,000 bonus

• Gold: 4 signed contracts = $1,500 bonus

• Platinum: 5+ signed contracts = $2,000 bonus



On-target earnings can range from $2,500–$3,500+ per month depending on performance. Pay dates are on the 1st and 15th of each month.



We believe in rewarding results. Our top performers earn meaningful bonuses based on closed contracts and consistent production.



Schedule

Full-time, Monday to Friday

9:00 AM – 6:00 PM CST

Remote position, work from your own secure setup



What You’ll Be Doing

- Engage with homeowners (seller leads), build authentic rapport, and manage conversations with professionalism

- Follow a proven acquisitions script while sounding natural and confident

- Ask strong follow-up questions to uncover seller motivation and property condition

- Make verbal offers, negotiate price and terms, and walk sellers through agreements using DocuSign

- Handle objections effectively and push deals forward toward signed contracts

- Maintain organized notes, offers, and seller updates in our CRM

- Collaborate closely with the acquisitions team and leadership



What It Takes to Succeed Here

- Relentless Follow-Up: Sellers don’t always respond the first time — or the second. You know how to stay persistent with calls, texts, and follow-ups until you get an answer. Nothing slips through the cracks on your watch.

- Extreme Attention to Detail: Every call, every note, every update gets logged correctly in the CRM. You don’t miss details, and you take pride in keeping your pipeline organized. If you’ve ever been called meticulous or “on top of everything,” this is where you’ll shine.

- Closer’s Mentality: You’re not just reading a script — you know how to listen, build rapport, and guide sellers toward a decision. You thrive on negotiation, handle objections with confidence, and create win-win agreements that get signed.

- Driven by Results: You measure success by contracts closed. You hold yourself to high standards and push to hit — and exceed — your targets consistently. You’re motivated by performance and driven by the satisfaction of closing successful deals.

- Resilient Problem-Solver: Whether it’s a tough seller, a pricing objection, or a complicated situation, you don’t freeze — you find solutions and move the deal forward. Challenges are part of the role, and you thrive in solving them under pressure.



Requirements

- Minimum 2+ years of experience in real estate acquisitions or seller negotiations

- Proven track record of closing real estate deals and securing signed contracts

- Excellent English communication skills (spoken and written)

- Confidence and professionalism on the phone; ability to build trust and rapport quickly

- Familiarity with real estate terms like ARV, repairs, inspection, contingencies, etc.

- Strong work ethic, coachability, and ability to follow scripts while sounding natural

- Proficiency with CRMs and outbound dialers

- Reliable high-speed internet, updated computer, and a quiet workspace



What We’re Looking For

- A confident, friendly, and persuasive communicator who thrives on results

- Someone who is organized, detail-oriented, and relentless in follow-up

- A professional with the drive to close contracts and grow with a fast-moving team



Why Join Us?

- Competitive pay with structured bonuses

- Real opportunities for growth in a professional investment company

- Work remotely with a team that supports your success

- A chance to close real deals, make a real impact, and develop long-term career skills in acquisitions



At Price Real Estate Investments, acquisitions is the heartbeat of our business. You’ll be in the front seat, driving growth and learning the strategies that power real deals across multiple U.S. markets.



How to Apply: (Read Carefully – Incomplete Applications Will Be Ignored)

-
 us at:

- Include a 1–2 minute audio or video introduction about yourself and experience.



Only applicants who follow all instructions will be considered.

title: Full-Stack AI Developer — Complete Existing Platform

About the Project



Rezie is developing a specialized AI platform for the contractor and restoration industry.



We have an existing application, interface, database, and codebase. Some functionality is already working, but the platform still requires development, debugging, integration, testing, and deployment.



We are looking for an experienced full-stack AI developer who can take ownership of the existing codebase and complete the full production-ready platform within six weeks, according to our private requirements and acceptance criteria.



This is not an MVP or prototype project. The completed application must be reliable, secure, tested, and ready for real-world use.



Additional product details will be shared with qualified candidates during the interview process and after signing a confidentiality agreement.

Complete unfinished frontend and backend functionality.

Improve database reliability and data synchronization.

Complete AI, document-processing, and structured-output integrations.

Diagnose and fix existing application defects.

Connect all platform components into one reliable workflow.

Add validation, error handling, and automated testing.

Ensure updates do not break previously working functionality.

Deploy the completed application.

Provide technical documentation and a final code handoff.

Commit all completed work to the company-owned repository.

Timeline and Work Expectations



The complete project must be delivered within six weeks of the agreed start date.



Before development begins, we will establish a written milestone schedule with specific deliverables and acceptance criteria. The selected developer must:



Begin work promptly after receiving access and project documentation.

Meet the agreed weekly milestones.

Provide regular progress updates and working demonstrations.

Commit completed work to the company repository throughout the project.

Communicate technical risks or blockers immediately.

Reserve sufficient time for final testing, deployment, documentation, and handoff.



The six-week timeline will begin after the agreement is signed, access is provided, and the milestone requirements are confirmed. Any approved change to the project scope or timeline must be documented in writing.



Payment and Deliverables



The total project budget is $1,000 USD.



Payment will be divided across clearly defined deliverables. Each payment will be released after the corresponding functionality has been demonstrated, tested, committed to the company repository, and accepted.



Payment is based on completed and accepted deliverables rather than hours worked. Hard-coded demonstrations, temporary fixes, incomplete functionality, or solutions that only work for one test case will not be accepted.



The complete milestone structure, technical requirements, payment amounts, and acceptance criteria will be provided to the selected developer before work begins.



Full-Time Opportunity



A developer who successfully completes the project, produces reliable work, communicates consistently, meets the agreed timeline, and demonstrates strong technical ownership may be offered an ongoing full-time position with Rezie.



The project will allow both sides to evaluate long-term fit. A full-time offer is not guaranteed and will depend on project performance and company needs.



Required Experience

Full-stack web application development.

React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, or comparable technologies.

AI and LLM integrations.

Structured AI outputs and validation.

PDF, OCR, or document-processing systems.

Backend APIs, databases, and asynchronous workflows.

Automated testing and application debugging.

Experience taking over and completing an existing codebase.

Strong communication and independent problem-solving skills.

Demonstrated ability to deliver projects on an agreed schedule.
